missing_shipped.name: bean bag

missing_shipped.name: down bed

missing_shipped.name: bladderwrack

missing_shipped.name: butter churn

missing_shipped.name: cardboard fort

missing_shipped.name: cardboard roof

missing_shipped.name: cardboard wall
missing_shipped.description: A pile of cardboard boxes that have been filled with rags and junk and stacked together like bricks to form a wall.

missing_shipped.name: remains of a cyborg
missing_shipped.description: The deteriorated, heavily rusted remains of some sort of robotic knight.  Their form lies frozen on its knee, head bowed, hands gripped around the barrel of what must have once been a gigantic rifle stuck into the dirt in front of it.  Overgrowth splits the gaps of its plating; whoever this was, they must have died here a long time ago.

missing_shipped.name: crumbled remains of a cyborg
missing_shipped.description: A pile of rusted metal that resembles a collapsed statue more than it does the knight it once was.  Nothing beside remains, and at some point it too will disappear entirely.

missing_shipped.name: diesel generator
missing_shipped.description: Big and powerful generator, used for street works.

missing_shipped.name: empty spike
missing_shipped.description: A strange otherworldly spike that refracts light in strange ways.  The body no longer rests on it.

missing_shipped.name: exam chair

missing_shipped.name: metal ring
missing_shipped.description: A heavy metal ring sitting on the floor, surrounding a spot charred by residue that gives off an acrid, unfamiliar smell.

missing_shipped.name: locator antenna
missing_shipped.description: A tall metal pole solidly fixed to the roof.  It does not look activated but there's a small set of holes near its base, maybe something could be plugged in one to reboot the locator.

missing_shipped.name: portal enclosure
missing_shipped.description: A heavy metal ring attached to dozens of wires, charred by residue that gives off an acrid, unfamiliar smell.

missing_shipped.name: firefly terrarium
missing_shipped.description: While many survivors would have focused on trying to bring back electric lights, whoever lives here has apparently decided to make use of the changes wrought by the Cataclysm to provide light. missing_shipped.name: Marloss flower
missing_shipped.description: This flower looks mostly like the other flowers taken by the mushrooms, but its bulb is a brilliant cyan color.  It emits an aroma that is both overwhelming and strangely alluring.

missing_shipped.name: fog
missing_shipped.description: A misty cloud of water vapor.

missing_shipped.name: gazing ball

missing_shipped.name: obelisk

missing_shipped.name: mutant sapling

missing_shipped.name: sprout

missing_shipped.name: twitchy medical robot
missing_shipped.description: A lanky set of robotic limbs armed with surgical devices and construction tools.  The arms protrude from a barrel-like base, mounted upon small casters.  Even when idle, it moves like an insect grooming its antennae.  The scalpel is stropped against another arm.  The over-articulated grasper picks at the other tools.  The circular saw silently rotates, as if it were itself scanning the surroundings.  Embedded in the side of the device is a bulbous computer terminal, displaying several options, from standard medical services to advanced bionic surgery.

missing_shipped.name: operation table
missing_shipped.description: A hard metal table on wheels, with several auxiliary medical devices of unknown origin.  Several screens dangle from the edge, black in their idle state, but with several burned-in lines, as if it had seen continuous service for many years.

missing_shipped.name: clouded cylinder
missing_shipped.description: A massive cylindrical device.  Perhaps the exterior was once translucent, but it's now deeply clouded and yellowed, with filth grasping where the plastic-like material meets the floor and ceiling.  Behind the plastic is some sort of large, bulbous object, too obscured to make heads or tails of.  It's bolted down with extremely thick and heavy-looking hardware.

missing_shipped.name: climbing vines
missing_shipped.description: This floor-to-ceiling collection of vines is twisted and gnarled, like fraying, loose wires.  Its surface has a plastic sheen.

missing_shipped.name: pipe plant
missing_shipped.description: This looks like a squat collection of reeds.  Upon closer inspection, they are almost identical in shape to plumbing pipes, just made of a wood-like material.

missing_shipped.name: utility box
missing_shipped.description: This looks like a rusted metal utility box, painted dark green.  It's made up of two rectangular metal pieces, welded together in the center.  The weld itself has an organic, twisting pattern.  You cannot see what is inside, if anything.

missing_shipped.name: open utility box
missing_shipped.description: This looks like a rusted metal utility box, painted dark green.  Its two rectangular metal pieces have been opened up.  The interior is made up of oily, fleshy meat, with interspersed wires.  Nestled in the center is a rectangular depression, with connections for some sort of electronics.

missing_shipped.name: otherworldly boiler

In defiance of its apparent function, it has no exhaust vent; in its place is a hose twisted on itself several times, coiled in copper, and terminating in a bulbous back-mounted battery pack.

missing_shipped.name: nether lichen

missing_shipped.description: A set of photovoltaic power generators, which turns solar radiation into useable electricity.  While useful before the Cataclysm, they have become priceless tools, invaluable to any survivor.  This one uses more efficient monocrystalline solar panels.

missing_shipped.name: humming column

missing_shipped.description: A floor-to-ceiling cylinder wrapped neatly and tightly in thick copper wire.  It has no markings, but the cables connected to the base suggest that it generates or receives some kind of power.  Perhaps it once worked, but it is now still and silent.

missing_shipped.name: styling station
missing_shipped.description: A styling station, is a countertop with a mirror mounted above it and just enough room and cubbies to store a stylist's equipment on it.

missing_shipped.name: waterlogged bucket seat
missing_shipped.description: A waterlogged soft upholstered car seat, contoured to hold one person.  It has started to degrade after some time spent underwater.  Absolutely unrecoverable.

missing_shipped.name: lab workbench
missing_shipped.description: A padded surgical table mounted to a sturdy base.

missing_shipped.name: Torah Ark
missing_shipped.description: An ornately-carved cabinet designed to hold a Torah scroll.  This one is decorated with a tree motif, referencing Proverbs 3:18.

missing_shipped.name: warped utility shelf
missing_shipped.description: What was once a simple heavy-duty plastic and metal shelving unit has been cleaved into three pieces, now mysteriously floating in space in a stair-like pattern, disconnected entirely from each another.

missing_shipped.name: black glass armchair
missing_shipped.description: An armchair that was presumably once very plush and comfortable.  Now the overstuffed cushions are hard, cold, and slippery.

missing_shipped.name: black glass bathtub
missing_shipped.description: A tub made from black glass, with a frozen column of onyx pouring from the tap.

missing_shipped.name: black glass bed
missing_shipped.description: A black glass sculpture of a bed.  The rumpled covers are jagged, and splinter at the touch.

missing_shipped.name: black glass bench
missing_shipped.description: A long, low slab of black glass.  You can't tell if the fissures here and there on the surface are natural cracks, or carved names.

missing_shipped.name: black glass birdbath
missing_shipped.description: A glass pedestal and bowl.  Inside, frozen in the midst of washing itself in the black sand, is the delicate figure of a bird.

missing_shipped.name: black glass bookcase
missing_shipped.description: A heavy bookshelf, laden with books fused into the shelves and each other.  You can make out titles on the spines, but the alphabet they're written in is unfamiliar.

missing_shipped.name: black glass bookcase
missing_shipped.description: This bookcase is missing a book.

missing_shipped.name: black glass box
missing_shipped.description: A box of thin black glass.  Its edges are glisteningly sharp.

missing_shipped.name: black glass chair
missing_shipped.description: A simple glass chair.  The seat is very thin, and crunches ominously under any weight.

missing_shipped.name: black glass counter
missing_shipped.description: A thick cube of black glass.  On the surface, fused in place, are statues of utensils and miscellany.

missing_shipped.name: black glass cupboard
missing_shipped.description: A black glass cupboard.  The doors are fused shut, but it presumably contains glasses.

missing_shipped.name: black glass desk
missing_shipped.description: A glass desk.  There are a handful of shapes atop it that suggest pens, paper, and miscellaneous knickknacks that are too jagged to identify.

missing_shipped.name: black glass dishwasher
missing_shipped.description: A glass dishwasher, its door hanging open.  Inside, glass plates and utensils are half buried in black sand.

missing_shipped.name: incomplete plush doll
missing_shipped.description: A soft plush torso, empty of features, is lying on this sofa.

missing_shipped.name: black glass dresser
missing_shipped.description: A black glass cabinet with its doors slightly ajar.  Inside is a row of hangers bearing neatly folded and entirely rigid clothing.

missing_shipped.name: black glass dryer
missing_shipped.description: A mechanical dryer of black glass.  The door hangs open, and inside, you can see a jumble of what might once have been clothes, now smashed to pieces.

missing_shipped.name: black glass fireplace
missing_shipped.description: A fireplace of pitted glass bricks.  The fire inside has been frozen in glass at the moment it began to leap beyond the grate.

missing_shipped.name: ring of black stones
missing_shipped.description: A circle of smooth glass pebbles.  Inside are frozen tendrils of fire, slightly translucent.  It seems colder as you approach.

missing_shipped.name: black glass lantern
missing_shipped.description: A tall glass pole with a translucent shade atop it.  You know it could not possibly turn on, but in the corner of your eye, you think you might see a soft glow.

missing_shipped.name: black glass refrigerator
missing_shipped.description: A black glass refrigerator, its door hanging open.  Inside is a seamless surface with protrusions resembling fresh fruit and plastic bottles.

missing_shipped.name: black glass locker
missing_shipped.description: A tall glass cabinet.  Whatever was inside will stay that way; the door is seamless with the frame.

missing_shipped.name: black glass mailbox
missing_shipped.description: A glass sculpture of a mailbox.  The door is open; inside is a pile of envelopes, all razor-edged.

missing_shipped.name: black glass oven
missing_shipped.description: A glass sculpture of a gas oven.  Bristling from the burner is a crown of jagged shards in the rough shape of an uncontrolled fire.

missing_shipped.name: black glass garden
missing_shipped.description: A planter of dark glass.  Sharp, twisting glass sprouts emerge from the black soil within.

missing_shipped.name: black glass display rack
missing_shipped.description: A glass sculpture of a shelving unit.  The angled shelves are covered in jagged miscellany, most of which is firmly fused in place.

missing_shipped.name: black glass shower
missing_shipped.description: From the head of this shower descend a dozen streams of thin black glass, with frozen droplets strung from them like pearls.

missing_shipped.name: black glass sink
missing_shipped.description: A glass basin and tap.  The inside stops halfway down in sheet of concentric ripples, with the tiny spire of a splashing droplet at the center.

missing_shipped.name: black glass sofa
missing_shipped.description: A long bench, padded with cold glass cushions.

missing_shipped.name: black glass table
missing_shipped.description: A slab of smooth black glass on four stout legs.  In a few places, there is shallowly rounded mass, like liquid spilled on the surface.

missing_shipped.name: black glass toilet
missing_shipped.description: A toilet made of black glass.  The lid, perhaps mercifully, is fused shut.

missing_shipped.description: A device that replaces conventional battery connections with a connector port that can plug into a UPS.  Any device modified with this can be used without a battery as long as you have a charged UPS with you.

missing_shipped.name: battle axe
missing_shipped.description: A huge axe designed for warfare.  Though intended for use as a weapon, it can also be pressed into service as a rather clumsy woodcutting tool.

missing_shipped.name: battle axe
missing_shipped.description: A dull, cheaply-made replica of a huge axe designed for warfare.

missing_shipped.name: battle axe
missing_shipped.description: A huge axe designed for warfare.  Or it would be, but the axe heads aren't seated properly at all.

missing_shipped.name: belly band holster
missing_shipped.description: A wide elastic belly belt with a built-in holster for a pistol and a spare magazine.  It is very awkward to use without practice.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

missing_shipped.name: beam scatterer
missing_shipped.description: A set of optics made to fit on laser weapons, which will diffract the laser beam into several lower powered beams.  This increases point-blank damage, but greatly reduces range.

missing_shipped.name: bean bag
missing_shipped.description: A large cushion filled with beads often used as a seat.

missing_shipped.name: strange conduct
missing_shipped.description: This defies easy description, it feels solid but the surface is yielding.  Looking at it you are reminded of the horrors that crawl out of the holes in reality.

missing_shipped.name: bee stinger
missing_shipped.description: A six-inch stinger from a giant bee.  Makes a poor melee weapon.

missing_shipped.name: back-up beeper
missing_shipped.description: A safety device intended to warn passersby of a vehicle moving in reverse.  Usage of it now seems terribly unwise.

missing_shipped.name: cut bell pepper
missing_shipped.description: A chopped up bell pepper with the seeds removed.

missing_shipped.name: belt clip
missing_shipped.description: A belt clip that attaches to the grip or slide of a pistol to facilitate 'Mexican carry', the practice of carrying without a holster.  It does not offer any protection for the trigger, so users are strongly advised to carry with the chamber empty or select a firearm with a very heavy trigger pull.

missing_shipped.name: belt grinder
missing_shipped.description: A power tool used for grinding and shaping metal or even wood.  It consists of a motorized abrasive belt that spins at high speeds, allowing you to quickly polish, flatten, or overall remove material from surfaces.

missing_shipped.name: bench vise
missing_shipped.description: A heavy, metal vise bolted down to a work surface.  With its jaws and screw, it can tightly hold items, useful for a wide array of handiwork such as soldering, woodworking, welding, anything that can be aided by a firm grip.  Also has a small, flat metal surface, useful for light metalworking if needed.

missing_shipped.name: betavoltaic cell
missing_shipped.description: Harness the power of radiation in your own home!  It looks similar to a D-cell battery, but actually contains folded layers of radioactive material inside.  It can produce electricity for several years at a steady voltage… but it's barely enough to power a small LED, and these batteries were worth hundreds of dollars.  Mostly they're a good way to brag to your neighbors that you have a nuclear power source in your house.

missing_shipped.name: deep concealment holster
missing_shipped.description: An elastic band with numerous provisions for concealing a very small pistol close to the body.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

missing_shipped.name: bifocal contact lenses (daily)
missing_shipped.description: Small plastic case with two daily-use soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  They are a great replacement for wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>both nearsightedness and farsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>16 hours</color> of use.

missing_shipped.name: bifocal contact lenses (weekly)
missing_shipped.description: Small plastic case with two extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  They are a great replacement for wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>both nearsightedness and farsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.

missing_shipped.name: bifocal transition contact lenses (daily)
missing_shipped.description: Small plastic case with two transition daily-use soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution. The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>both nearsightedness and farsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>16 hours</color> of use.

missing_shipped.name: bifocal transition contact lenses (weekly)
missing_shipped.description: Small plastic case with two transition extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution. The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>both nearsightedness and farsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.

missing_shipped.name: big brass catcher
missing_shipped.description: A bag that hangs off the side of your gun and catches ejected casings so you don't have to pick them up.  This one is larger and made of canvas, so it can catch more casings before needing to be emptied.  Though the added convenience comes at the cost of being bulkier.

missing_shipped.name: bike basket
missing_shipped.description: A simple bike basket.  It is small and foldable.

missing_shipped.name: bike rack
missing_shipped.description: A collection of pipes, cams, and straps, mounted on the edge of a vehicle and used to support another vehicle for transport.  It must be mounted on a vehicle to be used.

missing_shipped.name: bone billet
missing_shipped.description: A thick, short bone, usually used in flintknapping for soft-hammer percussion.

missing_shipped.name: wooden billet
missing_shipped.description: A thick, short wooden stick, usually used in flintknapping for soft-hammer percussion.

missing_shipped.name: binoculars
missing_shipped.description: A pair of optics with a neck strap attached.  Useful for seeing long distances.  Wearing this item or carrying it in your inventory will double the distance around you that is mapped during your travels.  You could also use them to focus the sunlight.

missing_shipped.name: Adrenaline Pump CBM
missing_shipped.description: A stimulator system that is implanted alongside the adrenal glands, allowing the user to trigger their body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.

missing_shipped.name: Active Defense System CBM
missing_shipped.description: A bionic that projects a thin forcefield around the user's body.  Everything loses velocity when penetrating this field, which results in a reduced amount of dealt damage at the cost of user's bionic energy.  Bullets and stabbing attacks will lose more velocity than cutting attacks, and those in turn more than bashing attacks.

missing_shipped.name: Alarm System CBM
missing_shipped.description: A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert the user.  This is very useful during sleep, or if the user suspects a cloaked pursuer.

missing_shipped.name: Squeaky Ankles CBM
missing_shipped.description: A pair of defective bionics that make squeaking noises.

missing_shipped.name: Integrated AR System CBM
missing_shipped.description: This bionic module integrates augmented reality interface into user's eyes.

missing_shipped.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Arms CBM
missing_shipped.description: An advanced protective mesh that weaves into the user's flesh.  Provides passive protection at the cost of mild encumbrance, and can be used in conjunction with bionic martial arts.

missing_shipped.name: Protective Lenses CBM
missing_shipped.description: A bionic package that seals the user's eye sockets with highly-protective mirrored lenses and re-routes their tear ducts to their mouth.  When the user cries, they must spit out or swallow their tears.

missing_shipped.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Head CBM
missing_shipped.description: An advanced protective mesh that weaves into the user's flesh, protecting both their head and jaw regions at the cost of mild encumbrance.

missing_shipped.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Legs CBM
missing_shipped.description: An advanced protective mesh that weaves into the user's flesh.  Provides passive protection at the cost of mild encumbrance, and can be used in conjunction with bionic martial arts.

missing_shipped.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Torso CBM
missing_shipped.description: An advanced protective mesh that weaves into the user's flesh, protecting it from physical trauma at the cost of mild encumbrance.

missing_shipped.name: Battery System CBM
missing_shipped.description: A battery draining attachment to make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.

missing_shipped.name: Monomolecular Blade CBM
missing_shipped.description: A deadly foot-long blade made of advanced material that is installed inside the forearm, capable of being extended through the back of the user's wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent the user from holding anything else while extended.

missing_shipped.name: monomolecular blade
missing_shipped.description: A foot-long blade made from high-tech alloy and edged with bonded nanocrystals.

missing_shipped.name: Blood Analysis CBM
missing_shipped.description: Small sensors that are implanted in the user's heart, allowing them to analyze their blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

missing_shipped.name: Blood Filter CBM
missing_shipped.description: A filtration system that is installed in the heart and can actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs, with limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in the system will be affected.

missing_shipped.name: Cable Charger System CBM
missing_shipped.description: A complex port that is mounted above the hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a battery via jumper cable.

missing_shipped.name: Subdermal Carbon Filament CBM
missing_shipped.description: Thin armor made of carbon nanotubes, implanted just beneath the skin.  It reduces cutting, stabbing and ballistic damage.

missing_shipped.name: Chain Lightning CBM
missing_shipped.description: A chain lightning generator that emits a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake and jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.

missing_shipped.name: Bionic Claws CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of vicious, retractable claws that are implanted inside the user's fingers.  They do considerable cutting damage, but prevent the user from holding anything else while extended.

missing_shipped.name: bionic claws
missing_shipped.description: Short, sharp claws made from a high-tech metal.

missing_shipped.name: Internal Climate Control CBM
missing_shipped.description: A network of thermal piping which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures once activated.

missing_shipped.name: Cloaking System CBM
missing_shipped.description: A high-power system that uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make the user blend into their surroundings, rendering them fully invisible to eyes and optical sensors.  However, this doesn't prevent detection from other means such as infrared, sonar, etc.

missing_shipped.name: Close Quarters Battle CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of bionic processors and databanks, loaded with martial arts combat programs.  While active, the CQB module will improve the user's hand-to-hand combat skills, but prevents them from improving them through combat experience.

missing_shipped.name: Heart of The Warrior CBM
missing_shipped.description: The Cree'yn Cag'gii, a forgotten relic of the Exodii.  Legends say it continues beating long after its user expires.  Nevertheless, it would take constant bionic power to keep it beating at a physiologically appropriate level.

missing_shipped.name: Bionic-Induced Deformity CBM
missing_shipped.description: A jumble of broken metal pieces that were removed during reconstructive surgery.

missing_shipped.name: Wired Reflexes CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of bionic nerve stimulators that greatly enhance reaction times, granting a +2 bonus to dexterity while powered.  However, user will suffer penalties if unpowered.

missing_shipped.name: Expanded Digestive System CBM
missing_shipped.description: This module contains three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines which replace the user's corresponding organs.  Not only will these extract much more nutrition from food, but also increase the user's resistance to foodborne illness, and occasionally allow the digestion of rotten food.  Installing this CBM will correct any abnormalities in the user's digestive system.

missing_shipped.name: Acidic Discharge CBM
missing_shipped.description: A CBM that has been breached in several places.  Some acid is leaking from it.

missing_shipped.name: Electrical Discharge CBM
missing_shipped.description: A formerly-functional CBM that is now a mess of naked wires and burnt resistors.

missing_shipped.name: Electrical Drain CBM
missing_shipped.description: This CBM was wired incorrectly and would drain power from any system connected to it.

missing_shipped.name: Enhanced Hearing CBM
missing_shipped.description: While this bionic is active, the user's hearing will be drastically improved, allowing them to hear over three times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage the user's hearing.

missing_shipped.name: Integrated Circuitry Toolset CBM
missing_shipped.description: A soldering iron, multimeter, and set of fine screwdrivers implanted in the user's hands.  Contains all the tools required for manipulating bench-scale electrical circuits, and provides slight protection against electric shocks.

missing_shipped.name: Directional EMP CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of small parabolic EMP field generators that are mounted in the palm of the user's right hand.  They can be used to instantly fire a wide, but short-ranged blast which will disable electronics and robots.

missing_shipped.name: EMP Projector CBM
missing_shipped.description: A ranged EMP generator system that is implanted in the user's right arm and hand.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets, but mostly useless otherwise.

missing_shipped.name: Aero-Evaporator CBM

It will be difficult or impossible to squeeze through tight spaces, or to wear normal-sized clothing and armor.  The frame greatly increases your physical dexterity and strength, and is highly protective, but the internal parts of your head and torso will still be affected by temperature, you will still feel pain, and internal bleeding can occur with sufficient damage.

missing_shipped.name: Exodii Cyberframe 1b
missing_shipped.description: A very human-like Exodii Cyberframe. The frame increases your physical dexterity and strength, and is modestly protective, but the internal parts of your head and torso will still be affected by temperature and feel pain.  Internal bleeding can still occur with sufficient damage.

missing_shipped.name: Bionic Left Leg (Cyberframe 1a)

missing_shipped.name: Bionic Treads (Cyberframe 1a)
missing_shipped.description: Sturdy treads for replacing legs and feet on an Exodii Cyberframe.  They are in fact two side-by-size triangular mechanisms, split in the middle, and independently operated by telescoping knees, to facilitate lifting one tread at a time for carefully passing over obstacles, or climbing stairs or ladders.  One's former ankles and associated anatomy will be integrated into the servomotors.  Unlike bipedal human legs, these move faster over most terrain, but will severely hinder travel over obstacles and through water.  They are immune to temperature and pain and don't bleed.  While they are highly resistant to damage, their external moving parts are less well protected than a standard bionic leg with similar plate thickness.  Due to their size and heft, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

missing_shipped.name: Ocular Amplifiers CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of ocular amplifiers which greatly enhance the user's vision, granting a +2 bonus to perception while powered.  However, user will suffer penalties if unpowered.

missing_shipped.name: Telescopic Eyes CBM
missing_shipped.description: An array of high-powered, auto-focusing lenses that replaces much of the material in the user's inner eye.  This fixes any vision problems and allows for an increased vision range akin to binoculars.

missing_shipped.name: Facial Distortion CBM
missing_shipped.description: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, this bionic module lets the user alter their facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.

missing_shipped.name: Dielectric Capacitance System CBM
missing_shipped.description: A network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors, implanted throughout the user's body to protect from external electrical discharge.

missing_shipped.name: Electromagnetic Leak CBM
missing_shipped.description: A broken implant that sends electromagnetic impulses that reduce other implants' capacity to store charge.

missing_shipped.name: Taste Fouler CBM
missing_shipped.description: A broken and mis-wired module that would cause food and drink to taste terrible if installed.

missing_shipped.name: lab report (biology)
missing_shipped.description: A manila folder containing top-secret test data.  Most of it is unintelligible without knowing the jargon, and the contents have obviously suffered from the chaos in this place, but there are some intact pages you can make sense of.

missing_shipped.name: Fingerhack CBM
missing_shipped.description: A miniature electrohack, surgically embedded in a finger of the user's right hand.  This is an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like, but not computers.  Computer proficiency is important, and a failed use may cause damage.

missing_shipped.name: Calorie Tracker CBM
missing_shipped.description: A small medical implant that passively tracks your calorie expenditure and consumption.

missing_shipped.name: Flashbang Generator CBM
missing_shipped.description: A combination of LEDs and speakers that create a flash and sound comparable to a flashbang grenade, deafening and blinding nearby enemies.

missing_shipped.name: Cranial Flashlight CBM
missing_shipped.description: A small, but powerful LED flashlight that is mounted between the user's eyes.

missing_shipped.name: Gasoline Fuel Cell CBM
missing_shipped.description: A small gasoline fuel cell able to convert gasoline to bionic power.  It's connected to a heat exhaust and a diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders able to hold up to 500 mL of gasoline.  When implanted, the system incurs a moderate amount of torso encumbrance.

missing_shipped.name: Integrated Dosimeter CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of small radiation sensors that are implanted throughout the body, allowing the user to analyze their level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert the user whenever exposed to environmental radiation.

missing_shipped.name: Respirator CBM
missing_shipped.description: A complex respiration augmentation system that increases the user's maximal oxygen uptake and allows for underwater breathing akin to gills.  Will automatically activate if the user is drowning.

missing_shipped.name: Glowy Thing CBM
missing_shipped.description: It's a… thing?  And it glows, at least it did when it was installed.

missing_shipped.name: Terranian Sonar CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of precision sonar equipment, implanted in the user's feet to allow the detection of below-ground movement, buried traps, and unstable terrain.

missing_shipped.name: Heat Drain CBM
missing_shipped.description: While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage and recharging the user's bionic power reserves slightly.

missing_shipped.name: Thermal Dissipation CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of powerful heatsinks and supermaterials woven into the user's flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent external heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect the internal body temperature.

missing_shipped.name: Hydraulic Muscles CBM
missing_shipped.description: A hydraulic muscle support system that, when active, sets the user's strength to 20.

missing_shipped.name: Infrared Vision CBM
missing_shipped.description: A bionic module that extends the user's range of vision into the infrared, allowing them to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark and through smoke.

missing_shipped.name: Cerebral Booster CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of bionic coprocessors that are implanted in the user's brain, granting a +2 bonus to intelligence while powered.  However, user will suffer penalties if unpowered.  It takes over and replaces numerous cognitive functions once installed and cannot be removed.

missing_shipped.name: Itchy Metal Thing CBM
missing_shipped.description: You can't recognize what this is supposed to be, but you imagine it'd be a very awkward thing to have in one's body.

missing_shipped.name: Joint Servo CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of servomotors installed on the leg joints to provide power-assisted movement.  They are optimized for running, but walking also requires less effort while this bionic is active.  However, when it's offline it will hamper the user's movement.

missing_shipped.name: Oil Generator CBM
missing_shipped.description: A CBM that generates power out of kerosene or motor oil.  It is fairly efficient and can store up to 750 mL of fuel, but works somewhat slowly.

missing_shipped.name: Finger-Mounted Laser CBM
missing_shipped.description: A small, high-powered laser that is embedded in the user's fingertip.  This long-range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.

missing_shipped.name: Leaky Bionic CBM
missing_shipped.description: A mess of pierced pipes and broken seals, something unpleasant is leaking from it.

missing_shipped.name: Leukocyte Breeder System CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of bionic stimulators which augment the user's haematopoiesis system, allowing them to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is designed for continuous use and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.

missing_shipped.name: Finger Lighter CBM
missing_shipped.description: A powerful fire starter which extends from the tip of the left index finger.

missing_shipped.name: Fingerpick CBM
missing_shipped.description: An electronic lockpick that is embedded in a fingertip.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.

missing_shipped.name: Electromagnetic Unit CBM
missing_shipped.description: A powerful electromagnet that is implanted into the user's right hand, allowing them to indiscriminately pull all nearby magnetic objects towards them.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.

missing_shipped.name: Nictitating Membrane CBM
missing_shipped.description: Thin membranes that cover the user's eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.

missing_shipped.name: Enhanced Memory Banks CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of highly-advanced quantum storage drives used to enhance memory.  While active, they increase the rate that the user learns skills.  Once it is installed, it will partially replace the functionality of the hippocampus, and thus cannot be removed without risk of severe permanent amnesia and difficulty forming new memories.

missing_shipped.name: Metabolic Interchange CBM
missing_shipped.description: This module interconnects the user's digestive system and power supply, letting them replenish bionic energy by burning calories.

missing_shipped.name: Weather Reader CBM
missing_shipped.description: A multitude of scientific instruments and sensors collects environmental data.  The data are compiled and presented as a simple readout of the current weather.  It also passively tells the user their external temperature.

missing_shipped.name: WearMan CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of speakers implanted into the skull, able to pick up local radiowaves and play downloaded music.

missing_shipped.name: Integrated Multimeter CBM
missing_shipped.description: A set of electrical leads to be embedded in the user's fingers, connected to a multimeter unit in their hand.  Allows the user to measure voltage, resistance, and current using their fingertips, and provides slight protection against electric shocks.

missing_shipped.name: Repair Nanobots CBM
missing_shipped.description: A fleet of tiny, dormant robots.  While activated, they will flit about the user's body, repairing damage and stopping bleeding at the cost of power.

missing_shipped.name: Artificial Night Generator CBM
missing_shipped.description: When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius of the user through destructive interference.

missing_shipped.name: Implanted Night Vision CBM
missing_shipped.description: This bionic module modifies the user's eyes to amplify existing light, allowing them to see in the dark.

missing_shipped.name: Antigravity Leap Assist CBM
missing_shipped.description: An antigravity device designed to be implanted into the legs.  While it doesn't allow for real floating or flying, it does facilitate superhuman long jumps.

missing_shipped.name: Bone Marrow Bio-Factory CBM
missing_shipped.description: Specialized nanorobots that increase blood cell production at the cost of stored calories and bionic energy.

missing_shipped.name: Cyberbone Collar CBM
missing_shipped.description: A subdermal bone-like implant fit for the nape of the neck, with a mysterious nanotube sheet that ensheaths the throat.

missing_shipped.name: Cyberbone Collar CBM
missing_shipped.description: A subdermal bone-like implant fit for the nape of the neck, with a mysterious nanotube sheet that ensheaths the throat.

missing_shipped.name: Dimensional Anchor CBM
missing_shipped.description: Advanced technology that locks the body into its native dimensionality, protecting from unwanted teleportation and some other phase altering effects.

missing_shipped.name: Artificial Hair CBM
missing_shipped.description: Synthetic sphincters that control the extrusion and retraction of advanced nanotube hair technology, made to replace hair follicles, allowing one to control their hair length at will.

missing_shipped.name: Laser-Assisted Reading Device CBM
missing_shipped.description: This implant serves as a reading light and a short-distance laser scanner, allowing one to upload digital images of books straight into the brain's optic lobe and language centers.  When active, one can read slightly faster, and can read in the dark.

missing_shipped.name: Cranial EMF Shielding CBM
missing_shipped.description: A microscopically thin layer of some non-newtonian fluid for skull application.  It can protect from some types of electromagnetic fields.  Is it useful?  Maybe.

missing_shipped.name: Noisemaker CBM
missing_shipped.description: A malfunctioning bionic.  When installed, it occasionally emits a loud burst of noise.

missing_shipped.name: Bionic Nostril CBM
missing_shipped.description: This thing was up someone's nose, they're probably glad to be rid of it.

missing_shipped.name: Offensive Defense System CBM
missing_shipped.description: A thin forcefield gets projected around the user's body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect attacks, but rather delivers a strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.

missing_shipped.name: Sensory Dulling CBM

missing_shipped.name: .303 British FMJ, black powder

missing_shipped.name: .30 Carbine JSP, black powder

missing_shipped.name: .38 Special FMJ, black powder
missing_shipped.description: .38 Special ammunition with a 130gr FMJ bullet.  From its inception, the .38 Special round has been known for its accuracy and low recoil.  Because it was initially a black powder cartridge, .38 Special is very low pressure.

missing_shipped.name: .40 S&W FMJ, black powder
missing_shipped.description: .40 S&W ammunition with a 180gr FMJ bullet.  The .40 S&W round is descended from the 10mm Auto cartridge and maintains most of its predecessor's strengths while reducing recoil.  It was popular among law enforcement before the FBI switched to 9mm.

missing_shipped.name: .410 birdshot, black powder

missing_shipped.name: .410 slug, black powder

missing_shipped.name: .450 Bushmaster FTX, black powder
missing_shipped.description: .450 Bushmaster ammunition, loaded with a plastic-capped 250-grain Flex Tip bullet.  Born from discontent with the .223 Remington's weak stopping potential, the .450 Bushmaster round was crafted in line with the so-called 'Thumper' concept: an envisioned need for a large-bore, semi-automatic sporting cartridge capable of downing game in one shot.  Along with its elder sibling, the .50-caliber Beowulf cartridge, the .450 Bushmaster is one of a number of such high-caliber rounds and is compatible with appropriately converted AR-15-platform rifles.  This particular cartridge possesses a plastic-tipped projectile, which acts as an improved hollow point bullet with uniform and devastating expansion within wound cavities.

missing_shipped.name: .450 Bushmaster Xtreme Hunter, black powder
missing_shipped.description: .450 Bushmaster ammunition, loaded with a solid-copper 220-grain penetrator bullet.  Born from discontent with the .223 Remington's weak stopping potential, the .450 Bushmaster round was crafted in line with the so-called 'Thumper' concept: an envisioned need for a large-bore, semi-automatic sporting cartridge capable of downing game in one shot.  Along with its elder sibling, the .50-caliber Beowulf cartridge, the .450 Bushmaster is one of a number of such high-caliber rounds and is compatible with appropriately converted AR-15-platform rifles.  This particular cartridge is loaded with a solid-copper projectile: excellent at punching through thick barriers and delivering massive amounts of energy to anything unfortunate enough to be hit.

missing_shipped.name: .45 ACP FMJ, black powder
missing_shipped.description: .45 ACP ammunition with a 230gr FMJ bullet.  Due to a reputation for effectiveness, the .45 ACP round has been common for over a century.

missing_shipped.name: .45 Colt LFN, black powder
missing_shipped.description: .45 Long Colt ammunition with a 250gr lead flat nose bullet.  Originally designed for the Colt Single Action Army, and still used for modern reproduction revolvers.  This ammunition is loaded to be safer in antiques and for cowboy action shooting, and is thus less powerful than other, hotter loads.

missing_shipped.name: .45 Colt FMJ, black powder
missing_shipped.description: Jacketed .45 Long Colt ammunition with a 225gr bullet.  Originally designed for the Colt Single Action Army, and still used for modern reproduction revolvers.  The resource scarcity of the Cataclysm inspired someone to hand-reload this one with black powder, bringing the round closer to its original incarnation.  It's kind of poetic, when you think about it.

missing_shipped.name: .50 AE FMJ, black powder

missing_shipped.name: .50 Beowulf Xtreme Penetrator, black powder

Developed in 2001 as a powerful short- to medium-range chambering for AR-15 style rifles, this stout cartridge had gained some popularity as a hunting round before the Cataclysm.  With a blunt nose construction for better initial energy transfer, this 12.7mm-wide bullet's solid copper design allows it to punch through entry barriers while resulting in a larger wound column.

missing_shipped.name: .50 Beowulf XTP, black powder

Developed in 2001 as a powerful short- to medium-range chambering for AR-15 style rifles, this stout cartridge had gained some popularity as a hunting round before the Cataclysm.  This particular version of the cartridge is coated in a layer of polymer, encouraging commendable terminal ballistics, penetrative capabilities, and overall expansion from its 12.7x42mm projectile.

missing_shipped.name: 7.7x58mm Arisaka JSP, black powder
missing_shipped.description: This is a 7.7x58mm Arisaka cartridge loaded with a 174 gr soft point bullet, excellent against larger game and, now, zombies. Having acquired a following as a hunting cartridge before the Cataclysm, mainly due to the prevalence of captured or surrendered Japanese rifles, the round was more common than its older 6.5x50mm counterpart.

missing_shipped.description: A metal face mask designed to attach to a cap helmet to protect the lower half.  This one is made of tempered steel with gold inlays and a setting for a gemstone.  This isn't just surviving the apocalypse, this is about living truly apocalypse fancy.

missing_shipped.name: sharksuit
missing_shipped.description: A-one piece chainmail suit used by SCUBA divers for protection against shark bites.

missing_shipped.name: faraday sharksuit
missing_shipped.description: A one-piece chainmail suit used by SCUBA divers for protection against shark bites.  It has been conductively interconnected, protecting against electricity.

missing_shipped.name: wetsuit
missing_shipped.description: A full-body 3 mm thick neoprene wetsuit with nylon lining.

missing_shipped.name: yogurt starter culture
missing_shipped.description: A powder-like mix of cultured yogurt bacteria, good for fermenting yogurt.

missing_shipped.name: yoke and harness
missing_shipped.description: A bar and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along.

missing_shipped.name: reinforced yoke and harness
missing_shipped.description: Heavy steel beams and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along, reinforced to withstand the rigors of the apocalypse and ill-advised off-roading.  You would still need separate armor for said creature to wear.

missing_shipped.name: yoyo
missing_shipped.description: A simple yoyo on a string.  Now you can be bored with style.

missing_shipped.name: monolithic machine
missing_shipped.description: A very heavy sphere, presumably made almost entirely of gold.  The complex pattern etched across its surface implies that it might serve some exotic function.

missing_shipped.name: woven metallics
missing_shipped.description: Thin metallic strips with an ochre sheen, interlaid together into a flexible mesh.  You can't tell whether it's a circuit, a heat dissipation component, or a mechanical actuator.

missing_shipped.name: alien metal plating
missing_shipped.description: A slightly curved plate of white metal.  It readily collects low amounts of static charge.

missing_shipped.name: robotic innards
missing_shipped.description: A robotic assembly of unknown function.  Entirely made from tight-fitting metal plates, it somewhat resembles the interior of a mechanical clock.

missing_shipped.name: alien metal scrap
missing_shipped.description: A collection of tiny metal strips, spheres, and other geometric primitives taken from a disassembled alien machine.

missing_shipped.name: sensor assembly
missing_shipped.description: A carved sphere embedded with small black glass screens.  It's probably a sensor of some kind.

missing_shipped.name: tiny golden plate
missing_shipped.description: A very small rectangular strip of metal, presumably made of gold.  One side is etched with some barely noticeable but incredibly detailed artwork of something you don't recognize, possibly a diagram of sorts.  Sometimes you feel it resonating gently.

missing_shipped.name: zentai
missing_shipped.description: Short for 'zenshin taitsu', a zentai is a form-fitting full-body nylon and spandex garment.  Though it covers your face, you can see through the thin fabric.  With a couple of these and some friends, you could put on some kabuki or harass a rival sports team.

missing_shipped.name: zombie mask
missing_shipped.description: A flimsy leather zombie mask.  When zombies were still works of fiction.

missing_shipped.name: ZPAP M90 30-round magazine
missing_shipped.description: A 30-round box magazine for use with the ZPAP M90 rifles.

missing_shipped.name: cut zucchini
missing_shipped.description: A chopped-up summer squash.  The seeds have been removed.

missing_shipped.name: rouge fixbot
missing_shipped.description: This little robot has a round, scarlet body and a swiveling 'eye' with emotive, articulated arms above it.  It currently has a determined look as it trundles about on three bulbous limbs.

missing_shipped.name: haywire bot
missing_shipped.description: This little robot has a round, scarlet body and a swiveling 'eye' with emotive, articulated arms above it.  It rolls chaotically from limb to limb, beeping loudly.

missing_shipped.name: rouge medbot
missing_shipped.description: This little robot has a round, scarlet body and a swiveling 'eye' with emotive, articulated arms above it.  It currently has a determined look as it trundles about on three bulbous limbs.

missing_shipped.name: rouge robotic arm
missing_shipped.description: A massive robotic arm secured to the floor, hovering over some sort of conveyer belt.  It moves about via an articulated elbow, a rotating wrist, and over-articulated fingers.  It's rapidly moving about, its digits tracing alien symbols on various surfaces, wiggling between and forcing itself into a tight fist, as if fighting some synthetic arthritis.  Between grasps you spot an illuminated eye.

missing_shipped.name: Bot Printer
missing_shipped.description: A pillar of bleeping, blooping technology, crawling with a multitude of crawling robots, each whirring and whizzing around on prebuilt tracks that trace the device in confusing patterns.  Its massive mechanical mouth, which opens and shuts with incredible force, is constantly vomiting out weird little machines.

missing_shipped.name: Churning Ribcage
missing_shipped.description: Rib-cages of jagged steel cross back and forth between the massive printers.  An uncountable number of nearly microscopic robots zip back and forth, coating the entire surface, churning in beautiful symbols like intelligent alien predators sloshing through a sea of krill.

missing_shipped.name: Haywire Ribcage
missing_shipped.description: Rib-cages of jagged steel cross back and forth between the massive printers.  An uncountable number of nearly microscopic robots zip back and forth, coating the entire surface, churning in beautiful symbols like intelligent alien predators sloshing through a sea of krill.  Great glowing eyes have now formed, bathing the factory in light.

missing_shipped.name: Haywire Bot Printer
missing_shipped.description: A pillar of bleeping, blooping technology, crawling with a multitude of crawling robots, each whirring and whizzing around on prebuilt tracks that trace the device in confusing patterns.  Its massive mechanical mouth, which opens and shuts with incredible force, is constantly vomiting out weird little machines.

missing_shipped.name: rouge spotbot
missing_shipped.description: This little robot has a round, scarlet body and a swiveling flashlight 'eye' with emotive, articulated arms above it.  It currently has a determined look as it trundles about on three bulbous limbs.

missing_shipped.name: mercenary officer
missing_shipped.description: A figure in a high-tech suit, their outline contorted as though you were viewing them through a prism.  Their movements are strained but determined, pushing through apparent pain with feverish resolve, dead-set on reaching their target.

missing_shipped.name: breather
missing_shipped.description: This is some sort of unearthly pink flesh sac; moist and ridged with veins, it is otherwise without discernible exterior features.  Seemingly immobile and defenseless, it sits in place, swelling and collapsing upon itself as it breathes.

missing_shipped.name: breather
missing_shipped.description: A weird mass of immobile, breathing pink goo.  The other breathers seem to originate from this one.

missing_shipped.name: caustic amalgamation
missing_shipped.description: A gangly creature running on six legs, its form made irregular by the green pustules at the limbs' base, each feeding into a large vein leading to two blackened claws.  What must have been a seventh leg fused with the creature's head forming a jagged proboscis emerging from below its eyes, dripping a caustic liquid.

missing_shipped.name: leaping amalgamation
missing_shipped.description: A four-legged white creature about the size of a human, running with a decidedly feline gait, the three remaining limbs holding an almost-translucent skin membrane outstretched on its side and rear.  Much of its head is taken up by a beak like a raven's, which opens to reveal a set of jagged black teeth.

missing_shipped.name: brutish amalgamation
missing_shipped.description: A large, thickly armored creature built not unlike a bear, if a bear had a long, clubbed tail and two short limbs ending in black talons framing a vertical mouth on an otherwise smooth, featureless head.  On second thought, not that much like a bear at all.

missing_shipped.name: vigilant amalgamation
missing_shipped.description: An inflated white body carried by five dainty legs, waving its remaining two limbs constantly.  Each one is tipped by a head-sized compound eye, independently scanning the horizon for prey.

missing_shipped.name: charged amalgamation
missing_shipped.description: A short, crablike creature waddling around on six multi-jointed legs, its body dominated by a large glowing organ bulging from between the white armor plates.  A single raised appendage connects to the mass, its tip surrounded by brilliant white sparks.

missing_shipped.name: super soldier acidic ant
missing_shipped.description: A cow-sized, woolly brown ant.  Corrosive liquid seeping from her huge mandibles.  Given the relative strength of ants to their body size, you don't doubt that this one could shove cars around or rip through solid walls.

missing_shipped.name: beaver kit
missing_shipped.description: A small baby beaver.

missing_shipped.name: bald beaver kit
missing_shipped.description: This beaver kit lacks any fur covering its body, instead looking reminiscent of a plucked chicken.

missing_shipped.name: dambreaker kit
missing_shipped.description: An unnaturally large baby beaver with an array of bristles covering its back.

missing_shipped.name: dusted scarred zombie
missing_shipped.description: This heavily scarred moving corpse has been covered with a thick gray powder.

missing_shipped.name: fungalizing scarred zombie
missing_shipped.description: This heavily scarred moving corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

missing_shipped.name: giant solar beetle
missing_shipped.description: Giant beetle-like robot with a glistening blue plastic shell, its open elytra is covered with curved solar panels.  Despite it's robotic appearance, it motions like an organic creature.

missing_shipped.name: malnourished giant solar beetle
missing_shipped.description: Giant beetle-like robot with a scratched blue plastic shell, the exterior of its open elytra is covered with curved solar panels.  Despite weak attempts, it can't move.

missing_shipped.name: better half
missing_shipped.description: This doesn't look like you.  It looks like what you've dreamed you could be.  Why does your mind keep mistaking you for a bad copy of it?

missing_shipped.name: biollante sprig
missing_shipped.description: A short, fat stalk with broad leaves and tiny flower buds.

missing_shipped.name: biollante sprout
missing_shipped.description: A thick stalk that rises five feet from the ground, with heavy, broad leaves at its base.  Purple flower buds adorn the top.

missing_shipped.name: black rat
missing_shipped.description: The black rat, an omnivorous rodent with sheer black fur and a long, rough tail.  Harbinger of pestilence, famine, and mange, it will sometimes swarm over the dead or dying.

missing_shipped.name: blank body?
missing_shipped.description: This was some form of unnatural changeling creature, but now it's you.  It looks like you.  It moves like you.  It even smiles like you.

missing_shipped.name: sewer slime
missing_shipped.description: This moving, black glob emits a foul stench.  It has incorporated both the liquid and solid contents of the sewer water.

missing_shipped.name: dusted boomer
missing_shipped.description: This rotund and bloated corpse has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

missing_shipped.name: fungal stalk boomer
missing_shipped.description: This rotund and bloated corpse has grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

missing_shipped.name: pupating brute
missing_shipped.description: This muscular human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything from the neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

missing_shipped.name: pupating brute
missing_shipped.description: This muscular human corpse is wrapped in sticky black fibers that cover everything from the neck down.  Beneath the wrapping there is a strange rhythmic movement, grotesque to behold.

missing_shipped.name: tadpole
missing_shipped.description: Every part of this speckled, green-brown tadpole is thick and broad.  It must be from some larger species of frog.

missing_shipped.name: oversized butterfly
missing_shipped.description: An oversized butterfly with vibrant colored markings.  Unlike the other big insects of the Cataclysm this is a very peaceful nectivore.

missing_shipped.name: giant cocoon
missing_shipped.description: A caterpillar undergoing a metamorphosis.  Considering the size of the cocoon you have a feeling the emerging adult will be massive as well.

missing_shipped.name: giant butterfly
missing_shipped.description: A mutated butterfly larger than a human.  Despite its size it is very lightweight and feeds mainly on the nectar produced by triffid flowers.

missing_shipped.name: emperor butterfly
missing_shipped.description: An enormous butterfly with regal looking wings.  This giant of the sky flies cheerfully under the sun, leaving dust as it passes.

missing_shipped.name: languorous spectre
missing_shipped.description: The translucent shape of a cloaked human, crawling upon the ground.  It is featureless, slow, and mumbling words you think you might understand.  Might it speak with you?

missing_shipped.name: carrion grub
missing_shipped.description: A wriggling brown grub of unnatural origin, slithering along the ground and unnaturally pulsating.  As it moves along, it chews through any available flesh with surprising speed.

missing_shipped.name: black cat
missing_shipped.description: A black ball of fur with prominent green eyes staring right into your soul.

missing_shipped.name: black kitten
missing_shipped.description: An adorable, little furry ball of darkness with pronounced green eyes.

missing_shipped.name: shorthair cat
missing_shipped.description: A small domesticated predator gone feral in the absence of human stewardship.  Located near the old Isherwood cabin.

missing_shipped.name: liquid cat
missing_shipped.description: It is universally known that cats are liquid, but this cat's body is actually quivering while it walks around.  It also enjoys resting while twisting its body in ways that would break a normal cat's bones.

missing_shipped.name: void cat
missing_shipped.description: Seeing how unnaturally dark this black cat's fur is, you are certain this is no ordinary cat.  Its fur seems to absorb light from the surroundings.

missing_shipped.name: giant caterpillar
missing_shipped.description: The larval stage of a butterfly or a moth.  This one appears to be about your size so you can only imagine the size of the insect that it will grow into.

missing_shipped.name: giant caterpillar
missing_shipped.description: The larval stage of a butterfly or a moth.  This one appears to be about your size so you can only imagine the size of the insect that it will grow into.

missing_shipped.name: black-capped chickadee
missing_shipped.description: A tiny species of tit native to North America, with a distinctive black cap on its head.

missing_shipped.name: gray chick
missing_shipped.description: A tiny dull-colored chick, it could be from a number of different species.

missing_shipped.name: child
missing_shipped.description: Placeholder for children corpses.  If you see this, it's a bug.

missing_shipped.name: giant cicada
missing_shipped.description: A huge cicada the size of a person.  These insects are mostly harmless but may bite if attacked and produce a loud buzzing sound.

missing_shipped.name: cicada nymph
missing_shipped.description: The mutated larval form of a cicada.  It doesn't produce noise like the adults but its digging claws seem suited for scratching.

missing_shipped.name: waterfowl chick
missing_shipped.description: A tiny yellow and brown waterfowl chick, it could be from a number of different species.

missing_shipped.name: waterfowl chick
missing_shipped.description: A tiny yellow and brown waterfowl chick, it could be from a number of different species.

missing_shipped.name: coyote pup
missing_shipped.description: A cute coyote pup.  Despite the temptation, perhaps it is wise to refrain from petting it.

missing_shipped.name: grinning coyote pup
missing_shipped.description: A cute coyote pup.  Though, on a closer look, something is off about it.

missing_shipped.name: slavering coyote pup
missing_shipped.description: A cute coyote pup.  Though, on a closer look, something is off about it.

missing_shipped.name: giant crayfish larva
missing_shipped.description: A large crayfish larva already larger than non-mutated adults of its kind.

missing_shipped.name: colossal crayfish
missing_shipped.description: An enormous mutated gray crayfish with pincer claws and long antennae.

missing_shipped.name: dark reflection
missing_shipped.description: This only looks a little like you.  It's obviously not you.  So why does your mind keep mistaking it for you?

missing_shipped.name: motionless deer
missing_shipped.description: A paralyzed, emaciated deer.  It spasms as it notices your presence, terrified eyes darting around the muddy chamber when it fails to stand and flee.

missing_shipped.name: dermatik midwife
missing_shipped.description: A dermatik grown even larger, her wings and ovipositor chewed off by her sisters.  She now stands watch in the nest, tending to the unfortunate hosts dragged home and ensuring they don't perish before their purpose is fulfilled.

missing_shipped.name: daitya devourer
missing_shipped.description: This devourer type zombie is made from a mass of human and animal parts assembled by a katamari god or other thoughtless creator being.  When paused it seems as though small versions of this gigantic monstrous abomination strain to birth themselves from its bulk, while other limbs push the straining masses back inside.  Every so often you see one climb free and take a few steps away from the creature before getting snatched back inside.

missing_shipped.name: daitya clone
missing_shipped.description: A smaller version of the Daitya without clones straining to burst free from it's orifices.  Instead every opening on its body is filled with teeth.

missing_shipped.name: hekatonkheire devourer
missing_shipped.description: Zombified human bodies fused together into a colossus, with a multitude of heads and limbs sticking out of its bloated body ready to break free.  Dozens of arms grab at anything nearby and pull it apart once within the grip of multiple hands.

missing_shipped.name: melded task force
missing_shipped.description: A tangle of security personnel fused with their gear and with each other, warped limbs and flesh-covered equipment moving in strange unison.  Every so often you glimpse a pitch-black figure at its center, limbs mirroring the movements of the larger mass.

missing_shipped.name: dish-head
missing_shipped.description: This creature would look almost like a small human, except for its proportions.  Its emaciated body sits below a massive, bloated head.  In place of a face is a deep divot, almost like a satellite dish - surrounding it is a thin line of razor sharp, fang-like teeth.  When stopped, it stands eerily still.  When it moves, it takes several small measured steps at a time, rotating slowly to scan its surroundings, as if it were performing a practiced dance.

missing_shipped.name: unknowable dog
missing_shipped.description: You are completely unable to recall anything about what this dog looks like.  You know it's a dog, you know it's there, you know you can see it, but any further information about it isn't retained in your mind.

missing_shipped.name: cuspated dog
missing_shipped.description: This dog's snout and jaw have seemingly fused together, the skin and flesh ranging from completely gone to barely hanging on.  The boney mass as a whole has an incredibly sharp yet jagged point.  It stumbles around, barely keeping its hefty 'beak' from hitting the ground.

missing_shipped.name: howling dog
missing_shipped.description: The underbelly of this undead canine expands and contracts arrhythmically, almost like it's breathing.  Despite that, it is clearly in an advanced state of decomposition.  Its snout and throat appear far too large for its species, and the remains of its eyes appear much more analytical than its brethren.

missing_shipped.name: translucent dog
missing_shipped.description: This dog doesn't cast a shadow, and if you squint hard enough you can see right through it.  Its condition doesn't appear to do any harm to it, though it seems to cause trouble when it tries to groom itself.

missing_shipped.name: Loper
missing_shipped.description: This dog has undergone visible mutation.  While its body is larger than normal, its legs are noticeably elongated, muscular and covered in long cord-like fur.  It easily stands as tall as you and watches your every move closely with reflective eyes.

missing_shipped.name: Loper puppy
missing_shipped.description: An adorable, but unusual puppy.  It wags its tail happily but something about its legs seems off.

missing_shipped.name: Mauler
missing_shipped.description: This stocky dog has undergone visible mutation.  Its jaw has widened and features more teeth than any dog should ever have.  While its toothy grin is unnerving, its tail wags as energetically as ever.

missing_shipped.name: Mauler puppy
missing_shipped.description: An adorable, but unusual puppy.  It wags its tail happily but something about its mouth seems off.

missing_shipped.name: Thrasher
missing_shipped.description: This dog has undergone visible mutation.  Its paws are larger than normal and have developed long digging nails.  Its fur is extremely short, barely covering its leathery skin.

missing_shipped.name: Thrasher puppy
missing_shipped.description: An adorable, but unusual puppy.  It wags its tail happily but something about its paws seems off.

missing_shipped.name: wyrmhound
missing_shipped.description: This dog is so heavily mutated you weren't entirely sure of the original animal for a moment.  It has no fur at all, being covered entirely by scales instead, and its serpentine head has yellow eyes and a pair of vicious fangs near the front of its muzzle.  It is not looking at you like it wants you to pet it.

missing_shipped.name: wyrmhound puppy
missing_shipped.description: A heavily mutated small dog.  Almost all of its fur has been replaced by scales, and it has no ears.  Its eyes are an unsettling yellow color.

missing_shipped.name: scorched dog
missing_shipped.description: A charred and damaged corpse of a canid, covered in fused patches of burnt hide and flesh.

missing_shipped.name: scorched hulking dog
missing_shipped.description: A charred and damaged corpse of what you can only assume was once a horribly mutated dog.  Covering its entire body is a layer of fused and melted hide, giving it an armored appearance.

missing_shipped.name: triclopean dog
missing_shipped.description: A rather average looking dog until you notice the third eye, right on its forehead, covered by a thick eyelid.  Whenever its open, small particles of dust from the ground rise and swirl around it.

missing_shipped.name: waterfowl chick
missing_shipped.description: A tiny yellow and brown waterfowl chick, it could be from a number of different species.

missing_shipped.name: feral cop
missing_shipped.description: A maddened and crazed police officer infected by the fungus.  Their body armor is overgrown with fungal matter.  Though obviously in pain they don't seem any less keen to batter you to death with their baton.

missing_shipped.name: feral Marine
missing_shipped.description: This twitching, bloodied person is still clad in a ragged Marine uniform, the insignia of the Marines visible on their coat and a corresponding tattoo on their forearm.  Clutching a rifle in their quivering hands, you see them repeatedly pull the weapon's trigger, constantly muttering incoherently and yanking back on the gun's charging handle every time the rifle fails to fire.  Seemingly having lost the capability to comprehend that their weapon is empty, you'd feel relatively safe were it not for the gleaming bayonet still attached to the end of their firearm.

missing_shipped.name: feral officer
missing_shipped.description: This person, clad in the tattered uniform of a naval officer, twitches erratically as their bloodshot eyes dart about and their breaths come in ragged pants.  The Cataclysm has clearly done something horrible to this military professional, inaudible mutterings emanating from their lips as they creep about like a skittish animal.  In their quivering hands they clutch a service pistol, the officer's fingers nervously fidgeting with the weapon.  They may not be an undead corpse, but you doubt that they're any more rational than the zombies which now infest the world.

missing_shipped.name: feral prisoner
missing_shipped.description: This frenzied prisoner has somehow avoided turning into one of the undead thus far, though seeing how zombies seem to ignore this shiv-wielding, blood-stained maniac, they are likely not far off from that fate.

missing_shipped.name: feral crewman
missing_shipped.description: Spattered from head to toe in large swaths of dried viscera, the deep blue of this person's tattered naval uniform has been stained the color of rust.  Having seemingly had enough presence of mind to consider arming itself, this former crewman carries a crash axe in its shaking hands.  The veins on the back of their neck are visibly bulging, their eyes bloodshot, and a mass of crisscrossing blackened veins stand out against the pale skin of their face as they regard the area around them for perceived threats.

missing_shipped.name: feral crewman
missing_shipped.description: Still dressed in a grease spattered uniform, this crewman appears to have once been a naval engineer.  With tangled hair, oil stained working attire, and a lug wrench clenched in their fist, you assume that they were either assigned to shipside maintenance or responsible for servicing onboard aircraft.  Now all that's left of the crewman that this person once was is a madly twitching, psychopathic monster.

missing_shipped.name: feral crewman
missing_shipped.description: Clutching a stout mop in their quivering hands, this crewman was presumably assigned to basic deck sweeping in their final moments, before the Cataclysm struck and stripped them of their humanity.  Dressed in basic naval fatigues, you'd be forgiven for believing them to be another survivor.  However, their bloodshot eyes, blackened veins, and erratic twitching tell a far different story.

missing_shipped.name: feral crewman
missing_shipped.description: Clad in a grimy and tattered naval uniform, this former sailor clutches a massive wrench as some form of makeshift weapon.  At a distance, you could mistake them as being another survivor.  However, upon closer inspection you make note of how their veins are visibly bulging, their wide open eyes have a primal, animalistic quality to their gaze, and their breaths come in ragged, wheezing pants.  Whatever the Cataclysm has done to the military crewman that this twitching shell of their former self once was, you're certain that they're not fully human anymore.

missing_shipped.name: feral test subject
missing_shipped.description: In light, this feral is clearly visible but they blend into the darkness like a ghost, despite the orange jumpsuit they still wear.  They don't seem to have any problems seeing in the dark either.

missing_shipped.name: feral test subject
missing_shipped.description: Despite the myriad rips and tears in this feral's orange jumpsuit, they don't have a single scratch on them.  Only their bloodshot eyes and the way the zombies ignore them indicate something is wrong.

missing_shipped.name: feral test subject
missing_shipped.description: With bloodshot eyes and a ripped orange jumpsuit, this obviously-feral human wanders among the undead.  Their movements are uncanny, almost like an old-fashioned camera film that's been sped up.  All of their motions are jerky and unfocused but they make them at blinding speed.

missing_shipped.name: feral test subject
missing_shipped.description: This person, clad in the remnants of an orange jumpsuit, looks healthy.  Their eyes are bright, without any red markings; their hair has a pleasant shine; and their skin is practically glowing.  Only the twitching and the pipe held in one hand as they walk among the zombies would tell you that they've gone feral.

missing_shipped.name: feral test subject
missing_shipped.description: Despite their bloodshot eyes, this feral exhibits a level of awareness not seen among most of their fellows.  Their eyes purposefully scan their surroundings for danger, they carry a homemade spear, and they wear a set of armor they've cobbled together from bits of riot armor and lab supplies.  The remnants of an orange jumpsuit are visible under their improvised armor.

missing_shipped.name: feral test subject
missing_shipped.description: Clad in the remnants of an orange jumpsuit, this feral swings a pipe as they walk.  They hold it in one hand and move it like it's a stick, despite the  fittings on the end that must be increasing its weight.

missing_shipped.name: ferret
missing_shipped.description: Domesticated from the European polecat, this sleek and energetic mammal was commonly kept as a pet before the Cataclysm.

missing_shipped.name: ferret kit
missing_shipped.description: A young domesticated ferret, known as a kit.

missing_shipped.name: firefly larva
missing_shipped.description: An oversized larva of a firefly.  Shockingly large when compared to the adults of its kind.

missing_shipped.name: black sea bass
missing_shipped.description: A small, robust fish, the black sea bass is known for its dark, mottled color and meaty texture.

missing_shipped.name: Atlantic bluefin tuna
missing_shipped.description: One of the largest and fastest fish in the waters of New England, the bluefin tuna is a streamlined predator with a dark blue back and silvery sides.

missing_shipped.name: bluefish
missing_shipped.description: The bluefish, a moderately proportioned marine fish, is known for its aggressive nature and sharp teeth.  It sports a distinct blue-green coloration.

missing_shipped.name: bluegill
missing_shipped.description: A bluegill, an invasive species in Japan.  Commonly gutted and cooked whole.

missing_shipped.name: bowfin
missing_shipped.description: A bowfin.  These fish are related to gar but without the huge teeth, skin-rending scales, and aggression.

missing_shipped.name: brook trout
missing_shipped.description: A brook trout.  A fish made popular by father-son fishing trips, except for the part where you have to gut it.

missing_shipped.name: brown trout
missing_shipped.description: A brown trout.  A fish made popular by father-son fishing trips, except for the part where you have to gut it.

missing_shipped.name: brown bullhead
missing_shipped.description: A brown bullhead, a type of catfish.  Delicious when battered and fried.

missing_shipped.name: yellow bullhead
missing_shipped.description: A yellow bullhead, a type of catfish.  Delicious when battered and fried, though smaller than its brown cousin.

missing_shipped.name: burbot
missing_shipped.description: A relatively large fish that looks like a cross between a catfish and an eel, and is the only freshwater fish from the order that cods hail from.

missing_shipped.name: black crappie

missing_shipped.name: European carp

missing_shipped.name: great beaked toad

missing_shipped.name: foul toad

missing_shipped.name: golden monolith

missing_shipped.name: grasshopper nymph

missing_shipped.name: gray treefrog
