missing_shipped.description: A brown and tan speckled tadpole with a wide body and very broad, feather-shaped tail.

missing_shipped.name: mole
missing_shipped.description: Small subterranean mammals, they have cylindrical bodies, velvety fur, very small inconspicuous eyes and ears, reduced hindlimbs and short powerful forelimbs with large paws adapted for digging.

missing_shipped.name: waterfowl chick
missing_shipped.description: A tiny yellow and brown waterfowl chick, it could be from a number of different species.

missing_shipped.name: giant mosquito larva
missing_shipped.description: A large mosquito larva.  A bit more unsettling now that it isn't microscopic.

missing_shipped.name: oversized moth
missing_shipped.description: An oversized moth with its typical wood-like motifs.  It is as peaceful as the mutated butterflies found during the day.

missing_shipped.name: giant cocoon
missing_shipped.description: A caterpillar undergoing a metamorphosis.  Considering the size of the cocoon you have a feeling the emerging adult will be massive as well.

missing_shipped.name: giant moth fly
missing_shipped.description: A moth fly the size of a small dog.  It appears to pay you no mind.

missing_shipped.name: giant moth fly larva
missing_shipped.description: A large moth fly larva.

missing_shipped.name: giant moth
missing_shipped.description: A mutated moth larger than a human.  It silently flies with its huge wings after dusk looking for nocturnal flowers to feed upon.

missing_shipped.name: lunar moth
missing_shipped.description: A majestic moth painted in pale colors.  This giant of the night only comes out after the moon is out, leaving glittering dust.

missing_shipped.name: camouflaged mutant
missing_shipped.description: A mutated test subject, running on all fours at alarming speed.  Their short fur changes color to match the background in an instant, making you struggle to keep the thing in focus.  Their thin limbs end in long talons, and their mouth is held perpetually open by a set of knife-sized fangs.

missing_shipped.name: huge salmon
missing_shipped.description: A huge mutant salmon grown almost to the size of an alligator.

missing_shipped.name: leaper salmon
missing_shipped.description: A huge mutant salmon, one that outgrows even the other ones present.  On its sides, beneath the fins, are visible two flesh-colored tubes which propel water as it leaps.

missing_shipped.name: waterbed skulker
missing_shipped.description: Pink and translucent, with all of its otherworldly organs visible through its skin, this meter-high conical creature creeps along the seabed with its stubby, furry legs.  It retracts some sort of barbed filaments into an orifice at its rear as it aims at potential prey.

missing_shipped.name: nether fish symbiote
missing_shipped.description: A small fish symbiote that resembles a deformed, eyeless piranha.  It swims blindly in the yellow ichor, wriggling incessantly with malicious intent.

missing_shipped.name: spearfisher
missing_shipped.description: A strange quadrupedal creature with long, lanky limbs and a gaping maw.  A long sharp spike protrudes from its back, which occasionally launches from its joint to stab prey before slinking back in.

missing_shipped.name: strange bug
missing_shipped.description: This small, three legged bug-like creature curiously wriggles its 5 antennae.  Its body somewhat reminds you of a stink bug.  It looks like a fish out of water and is getting weaker by the minute.

missing_shipped.name: veiled butterfly
missing_shipped.description: There is barely anything there, but you do notice hints of a faint, translucent veiled creature that you can only describe as butterfly-like.  While strangely alluring, it seems unsuited to the atmosphere and is slowly falling apart.

missing_shipped.name: writhing root
missing_shipped.description: A small chunk of curious looking roots, constantly trying to grow and expand but failing miserably.  It has grown weak, as if incompatible with the very soil it is in.

missing_shipped.name: eldritch stomper
missing_shipped.description: Mostly covered in wet-looking, long strands that remind you firmly of hair, this abomination has a single but very pronounced leg.  It keeps its balance with its odd hair on the rear.  Yet it seems to shrivel and die with each gust of wind it is hit with.

missing_shipped.name: surgical bonebot
missing_shipped.description: A four-armed humanoid robot zipping around on bumpy, slow rollers.  At first glance it seems to be some sort of service or industrial machine, but closer inspect reveals it is entirely clad in a thick, bone-like material.  Although its "head" lacks any facial features, it bares a surgical mask and a plastic face shield.  Its limbs end in over-articulated hands, clicking, clacking, and rapidly rotating at the wrist.

missing_shipped.name: surgical bonebot
missing_shipped.description: A four-armed humanoid robot zipping around on bumpy, slow rollers.  At first glance it seems to be some sort of service or industrial machine, but closer inspect reveals it is entirely clad in a thick, bone-like material.  Although its "head" lacks any facial features, it bares a surgical mask and a plastic face shield.  Its limbs end in over-articulated hands, clicking, clacking, and rapidly rotating at the wrist.

missing_shipped.name: abyssal terror
missing_shipped.description: Once a former apex predator of the seas, now an undead nightmare, this zombified Great White shark terrorizes the waters with its relentless hunger and aggression.

missing_shipped.name: stalker octopus
missing_shipped.description: This octopus seems larger than you remember from visits to the aquarium and doesn't seem as slowed by land as would be expected.  Its body seems to mimic its surroundings.

missing_shipped.name: octopus spawn
missing_shipped.description: A young Cecaelia.  If one is out here, a very protective parent is likely nearby.

missing_shipped.name: giant tadpole
missing_shipped.description: Some kind of giant tadpole.  This speckled one has a body the size of a grapefruit and a thin, tapered tail.  It flits about the water in quick bursts.

missing_shipped.name: giant toad
missing_shipped.description: This toad has grown bigger than a human.  It looks uninterested in eating you but you better not give it a chance.

missing_shipped.name: gargantuan toad
missing_shipped.description: This toad is of truly enormous stature, larger than many cars.  You can't help but wonder if it could fit as many people inside.

missing_shipped.name: odd toad
missing_shipped.description: Wide as a watermelon and halfway up to your knee, this toad's size is alarming.  So too are its odd proportions.  It's as if it hasn't fully grown.

missing_shipped.name: vine turret
missing_shipped.description: A massive tangle of vines hanging from the ceiling, dripping with blood and acrid ichor.  A metal gun dangles from its vines, tangled in a mix of copper tubes, shielded wires, woody tendrils, and fleshy sinew.  The amalgamation of flesh and metal slowly rotates, scanning the area.

missing_shipped.name: pale reflection
missing_shipped.description: This looks nothing like you.  It's barely real.  So why does your mind keep mistaking it for you?

missing_shipped.name: palette frog
missing_shipped.description: You're quite sure that no frog this bright and garish could be native to New England.  Most of its skin is a light brown, but the large, squarish patches on its back and legs are of every different hue, all of them bright.

missing_shipped.name: staticskin frog
missing_shipped.description: Bioluminescent trails trace through the dark speckled patterns on this oversized frog's skin.  What would be cleanly defined spots on another frog, are instead fragmented collages of gray and black pigment over pale skin.  Its vestigial gills have grown into something else.  You can see them bulging the flesh under its mouth.

missing_shipped.name: giant tadpole
missing_shipped.description: A giant, gray-brown tadpole.  Its body is covered in irregular, chaotic speckles of pitch black and chalk white.

missing_shipped.name: strangely-patterned frog
missing_shipped.description: This large frog is covered in chaotic markings like a fractal river map over a background of TV static.  While most lose their gills during metamorphosis, this frog seems to have retained them, or something like them.

missing_shipped.name: taser tongue
missing_shipped.description: This pale, trash can-sized frog sports a series of faintly glowing spots among its chaotic skin patterns.  The glow seems most concentrated around its unusually bulky neck and mouth.  Its dark eyes scan for an appetizing target.

missing_shipped.name: spring peeper
missing_shipped.description: This diminutive frog has a distinctive chirping call and bands of darker skin that come to form a rough 'X' shape on its back.

missing_shipped.name: tadpole
missing_shipped.description: A tiny larval frog.  Almost solid black, this one is barely a speck in the water around it.

missing_shipped.name: tadpole
missing_shipped.description: This yellowish tadpole is covered in flecks of brown and cream coloring.  Its eyes rest close together on a notably pointed face.

missing_shipped.name: brown chick
missing_shipped.description: A tiny darkly-colored chick, it could be from a number of different species.

missing_shipped.name: plantborg
missing_shipped.description: At first glance this creature is clearly some sort of human-metal cyborg, but all of its "wiring" looks like plastic, plant-like tangles.  Its eyes glow with soft bioluminescence, and it moves with a speed and fluidity that betrays its robotic core.

missing_shipped.name: advanced plantborg
missing_shipped.description: At first glance this creature is clearly some sort of human-metal cyborg, but all of its "wiring" looks like plastic, plant-like tangles, massively engorged and clearly weighing the creature down.  Its eyes glow with soft bioluminescence.

missing_shipped.name: ancient red dragon
missing_shipped.description: A towering, hulking dragon, with tremendous, curving horns and shining red scales, its glowing maw peeled back in a hateful grimace as its eyes bore into yours.

missing_shipped.name: porcupine
missing_shipped.description: A dark brown large quill-covered rodent.

missing_shipped.name: domestic rabbit kit
missing_shipped.description: A tiny bunny with a cute wiggling nose, a cotton ball tail, and a body made of delicious flesh.

missing_shipped.name: dextrous raccoon
missing_shipped.description: Its paws have grown to be longer, and it seems capable of briefly standing on its hindlimbs.  You wonder if this sleazy beast is able to open doors yet.

missing_shipped.name: mutant rattlesnake
missing_shipped.description: A mutated timber rattlesnake, about three times as large as the norm.  While it isn't big enough to regard humans as potential prey, it is more aggressive and dangerous compared to a normal rattler.

missing_shipped.name: mutant rattlesnake snakelet
missing_shipped.description: A large mutated timber rattlesnake in its hatchling stage.  It will eventually grow a rattle and learn how to hunt.

missing_shipped.name: deathrattle serpent
missing_shipped.description: A primal fear strikes when the club-like tail of this massively warped snake shifts, an assortment of bones rattling softly.  Multiple sets of hollow fangs have erupted in its maw, which itself is flanked by skinless ropes of powerful muscle.  Its scales constantly shed off and regrow with unnatural speed.

missing_shipped.name: timber rattlesnake snakelet
missing_shipped.description: A timber rattlesnake in its hatchling stage.  It will eventually grow a rattle and learn how to hunt.

missing_shipped.name: Hub 01 HOUND
missing_shipped.description: A quadrupedal Hub 01 Hostile Overstimulation & Unmanned Neutralization Drone, armed with a taser and noise-generator to distract, disorient, and ultimately neutralize nearby enemies.

missing_shipped.name: refurbished autonomous TALON UGV Liberty Edition
missing_shipped.description: Once a Talon UGV bot converted to shoot fireworks at trespassers, this has been refurbished and uses it's M16A4 once more.  It still has the American flag decal from it's service as a trespass deterrent.

missing_shipped.name: M16A4 autonomous TALON UGV
missing_shipped.description: A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with an M16A4.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.

missing_shipped.name: mimic treefrog
missing_shipped.description: You've seen enough to gather that this is a frog with some very specialized camouflage.  Its skin appears able to reactively change texture and color to match its surroundings.  Like a morphing ghillie suit it can extend filaments to mimic individual leaves and blades of grass.  It is keen enough to match the swaying of brush in the wind.

missing_shipped.name: giant tadpole
missing_shipped.description: This tadpole's expanded size only accentuates its other unique feature.  Its tail fin is a vibrant gradient of crimson to yellow.

missing_shipped.name: shifting treefrog
missing_shipped.description: You've seen it wrinkle its skin into bark and disappear on a tree; settle on a toadstool and take its spots.  It's no trick of the light, this frog's skin shifts not just color but texture.

missing_shipped.name: shrapnel swarm
missing_shipped.description: Uncountable jagged spikes, cleaving reality as they fly through its invisible seams.

missing_shipped.name: shrew
missing_shipped.description: Small brown mole-like mammals, although its external appearance is generally that of a long-nosed mouse a shrew is not a rodent.

missing_shipped.name: Reclaimer
missing_shipped.description: A titanic, featureless mass of writhing flesh anchored to the ground and stretching as if invisible hands are trying to tear it apart.  It relentlessly reaches towards nearby corpses with its appendages, as if trying to take hold of them.

missing_shipped.name: reclaimer spawn
missing_shipped.description: A smaller, featureless mass of writhing flesh with appendages stretching towards nearby corpses to absorb them.

missing_shipped.name: dusted skeletal brute
missing_shipped.description: This moving corpse covered in twisted bone growths has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

missing_shipped.name: fungalizing bone brute
missing_shipped.description: This already horrific moving corpse covered in twisted bony growths has also grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

missing_shipped.name: fungal bone brute
missing_shipped.description: Fungi bloom from the crevices in the twisted bone growths that cover this creature.  Spores linger in the air around it.

missing_shipped.name: dusted skeletal zombie
missing_shipped.description: This moving corpse covered in knobby bone growths has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

missing_shipped.name: skeletal executioner
missing_shipped.description: The hands and forearms of this tall, bone-clad zombie have transformed into sword-like ossified blades.  Its jaw is partially fused with the bone mask covering its face, leaving sinister-looking gaps.  Its movements are stiff but precise.

missing_shipped.name: fungal stalk skeleton
missing_shipped.description: This already horrific moving corpse covered in bony growths has also grown a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the skull.

missing_shipped.name: fungal skeletal zombie
missing_shipped.description: Fungi bloom from the crevices in the twisted bone growths that cover this creature.  Spores linger in the air around it.

missing_shipped.name: dusted skeletal hulk
missing_shipped.description: This towering creature covered in plated bone has been heavily dusted with a thick gray powder.

missing_shipped.name: fungal stalk juggernaut
missing_shipped.description: Layers of plates of bone rise high above, ending in a short stalk of gray fungus bursting from the enormous bulging skull.

missing_shipped.name: zombie lich
missing_shipped.description: A twisted visage of the human body decked in bone from head to toe.  Its vague shape is reminiscent of some tabletop monster, and it walks and watches your actions with a cold and calculating demeanor.

missing_shipped.name: skeletal reaper
missing_shipped.description: This large, bone-armored zombie has scythe-like blades in place of its hands, resembling a praying mantis.  Its face is covered by a thick, ossified mask, with its only remaining facial features being eyes that ooze black goo.  Its movements are filled with unnatural rage.

missing_shipped.name: skeletal slasher
missing_shipped.description: The fingers of this bone-clad zombie have turned into ossified blades the size of large knives.  Most of the soft tissue on its head is gone, exposing a significantly thickened skull.

missing_shipped.name: five-lined skink
missing_shipped.description: A small species of skink.  The only native lizard of New England.

missing_shipped.name: five-lined skink hatchling
missing_shipped.description: A five-lined skink in its hatchling stage.

missing_shipped.name: skunk
missing_shipped.description: The common striped skunk, similar in size to opossum or domestic cats, these mammals can often be smelled before they are seen.

missing_shipped.name: sloth
missing_shipped.description: An animate blotch of conflicting shapes, when you look at or think of this, a desire to stop moving rises.

missing_shipped.name: colossal snail
missing_shipped.description: An enormous gastropod with a massive shell on its back.  It slowly crawls over the ground while leaving acid in its path.

missing_shipped.name: freshwater snail
missing_shipped.description: A tiny and shelled aquatic gastropod of either native or introduced stock.  Dangerous to eat raw but properly cooked and cleaned it may serve as a fine dish.

missing_shipped.name: giant snail
missing_shipped.description: A snail grown to human size.  Its mouth and underside dripping acid.

missing_shipped.name: spadefoot toad
missing_shipped.description: The eastern variety of the American spadefoot toad is a squat, round toad with vertical pupils.  Its body is colored a muddy mixture of browns, tans, and yellow-greens.  Their name comes from the keratinous projection on their hind legs that aids them in digging.

missing_shipped.name: tadpole
missing_shipped.description: A squat and wide-bellied tadpole with wide-set eyes.

missing_shipped.name: dusted raptor
missing_shipped.description: Heavily dusted with a thick gray powder, this small, winged predator darts through the air on three spongy wings that look like stretched human hands.  A sheer, jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet.

missing_shipped.name: fungal stalk raptor
missing_shipped.description: This small, winged predator darts through the air on three spongy wings that look like stretched human hands.  A sheer, jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet, joined by a short stalk of gray fungus reaching upward.

missing_shipped.name: detached spider leg
missing_shipped.description: The strangely branching leg of a mutated cellar spider that… fell?  crawled?  off of the main body when hurt.  It now flails about blindly, irregular clawed appendages grasping at anything that comes close.

missing_shipped.name: mommy long-legs
missing_shipped.description: This surprisingly shy giant cellar spider holds a head-sized ball of crawling spiderlings of different ages in its mandibles, carefully balancing on her long legs not to drop the precious cargo.  She seems uninterested in you.

missing_shipped.name: jumping spiderling
missing_shipped.description: A juvenile jumping spider, about the size of a beer bottle.

missing_shipped.name: trapdoor spiderling
missing_shipped.description: A juvenile trapdoor spider, about the size of a beer bottle.

missing_shipped.name: wolf spiderling
missing_shipped.description: A juvenile wolf spider, about the size of a beer bottle.

missing_shipped.name: star vampire
missing_shipped.description: Originally invisible, you can now see the myriad thin tentacles tipped with gnashing maws that make up this creature.  The small central body is dominated by an enormous fanged mouth from which emerges a near-constant high-pitched tittering.

missing_shipped.name: star vampire
missing_shipped.description: Originally invisible, you can now see the thick coiling tentacles tipped with rather flat maws that make up this creature.  The small central body is dominated by an enormous mouth from which emerges a near-constant high-pitched tittering.

missing_shipped.name: giant tadpole
missing_shipped.description: This giant, green tadpole would have been an oddity before the collapse.  Now it's simply part of the scenery.

missing_shipped.name: giant bullfrog
missing_shipped.description: A mutated bullfrog taller than you are.  It stares with amber eyes as it considers the easiest way to swallow you whole.

missing_shipped.name: colossal croaker
missing_shipped.description: Bloated to titanic size, rivaling a moose, this mutated bullfrog takes several seconds just to blink each vacant eye.  In place of the cognition it has lost, the beast has gained an even more voracious appetite and the might to sustain it.

missing_shipped.name: structural spur
missing_shipped.description: Misshapen spikes of concrete and rebar crumble upwards from the floor, held aloft by strands of visual distortion.  Sound around it is drowned and distorted into an incessant drone.

missing_shipped.name: swarm structure
missing_shipped.description: Your mind can't decide if this is a vast structure, or an endless swarm of tiny flying sharp things.  The only thing you know for sure is that it is far too large to fit in the space it occupies.

missing_shipped.name: tailed frog
missing_shipped.description: This very large, funky frog has an accentuated, paddle-like tail that accounts for half its body mass.  It is green with many brown spots scattering across its back.

missing_shipped.name: tainted shadow
missing_shipped.description: Your shadow is host to something alien.

missing_shipped.name: bloated zombie toad
missing_shipped.description: This zombified toad wobbles as it drags along its immense, inflated form.  A yellow-brown sludge dribbles from its mouth and seeps out from its bulging, cracking skin.

missing_shipped.name: death mask zombie toad
missing_shipped.description: The face and head of this enormous once-frog is encased in ossified tissue.  Its dead eyes peer out from this death mask of hardened bone, which curves into a jagged beak around its mouth.  Even its warts appear to have stiffened into dense osteoderms.

missing_shipped.name: warted monstrosity
missing_shipped.description: A festering toad the size of a dune buggy.  It struggles to pull its bulk towards you.  The warts covering its back appear fit to burst with yellow sludge, and more of the stuff flows freely from both ends of it.

missing_shipped.name: giant zombie toad
missing_shipped.description: The revivified remains of a giant mutant toad.  Its condition has left it slowed but no less dangerous.

missing_shipped.name: brown chick
missing_shipped.description: A tiny darkly-colored chick, it could be from a number of different species.

missing_shipped.name: M249 autonomous CROWS II
missing_shipped.description: A remote weapon system derived from the M153 CROWS II and enhanced with autonomous operation software.  This one is fitted with a 5.56 caliber M249 machine gun.

missing_shipped.name: painted turtle hatchling
missing_shipped.description: A painted turtle in its hatchling stage.

missing_shipped.name: common snapping turtle hatchling
missing_shipped.description: A common snapping turtle in its hatchling stage.

missing_shipped.name: twisted reflection
missing_shipped.description: This looks almost nothing like you.  Its form isn't even stable.  So why does your mind keep mistaking it for you?

missing_shipped.name: glowing mass of strings
missing_shipped.description: A multitude of thin, fluorescent purple strings violently writhe about the air.  Occasionally, individual strings lash out extremely far before retracting almost instantly.  The strings are so dense that they form a nearly solid, suffocating mass.

missing_shipped.name: unseen hunter
missing_shipped.description: There was nothing here a moment ago, but now you see the faintest outline of an otherworldly creature approaching you with jittery leaps.  Trying to focus on it reveals a pointed beak dripping translucent fluid and rows upon rows of bladed legs grasping the floor, before your eyes begin to burn and your head starts to spin.

missing_shipped.name: vinewalker
missing_shipped.description: This lanky, quadrupedal entity has a loosely humanoid torso, towering high over the ground on lanky, thorn-covered tendrils.  Its body is a jumble of rusting, metallic wire and dripping, plant-like tubes.  Its face is nothing but a clump of hanging wires and dead vines, slowly inflating and deflating like foul, external lungs.

missing_shipped.name: wailing treefrog
missing_shipped.description: Now the size of a dog, this tan, speckled tree frog will not stop making noise.  Its increased size has only boosted its volume.  It belts out sound in a relentless series of piercing, grinding chirps.

missing_shipped.name: giant tadpole
missing_shipped.description: A much larger than average tadpole.  Despite its unusual size, it is hard to make out any features from its dark, almost black, tint.

missing_shipped.name: unformed weaver
missing_shipped.description: It stalks thin slices of reality like gossamer threads, each a narrow conduit between worlds unknown and its kaleidoscopic maw.

missing_shipped.name: hanging limb
missing_shipped.description: Strands of shadow snap from their ordained positions, briefly reaching out before recoiling back into the darkness.

missing_shipped.name: hanging maw
missing_shipped.description: An explosion of glistening fangs, itself a small fragment of a greater horror.

missing_shipped.name: weaver juvenile
missing_shipped.description: The distressed movements of the juvenile reveal conjoined layers of flailing legs and fangs.

missing_shipped.name: skewered juvenile
missing_shipped.description: Layers of flailing limbs struggle against an impaled emerald lance.

missing_shipped.name: fungal wasp queen
missing_shipped.description: A mutated wasp queen that has been consumed by a sickly gray mold covering it's body.  Abandoning it's duty to laying eggs, it seemingly searches for anything to attack, as a mist of spores emit from it's mandibles.

missing_shipped.name: water scorpion nymph
missing_shipped.description: The nymph of a water scorpion, looks like a smaller version of its parents.

missing_shipped.name: cedar waxwing
missing_shipped.description: A small species of waxwing with a distinctive feathered crest and a black mask pattern on its face.

missing_shipped.name: gray chick
missing_shipped.description: A tiny dull-colored chick, it could be from a number of different species.

missing_shipped.name: labyrinth warlord
missing_shipped.description: A massive aperture eye tirelessly scans the labyrinth corridors in accordance to lost protocol, and mounted beneath it an arsenal bristles ready to unleash death on the unwary.  Its brazen armor lies contrast to the rust-stricken halls it traverses, but it remains impossible to know whether this is a machine purposefully built or if it has torn itself from the canvases of an imagined war.

missing_shipped.name: warlord leg
missing_shipped.description: One of the three legs of a labyrinth warlord, clad in thin brass plates.

missing_shipped.name: whispering fungi
missing_shipped.description: Large, yellow, coral-like fungi grow from this spot, their spires riddled with intersecting holes.  Despite lack of wind, it seems to wave at a set rhythm, occasionally pulsing out spores.  A chorus of weak, whistly voices, mixed with different accents and languages—some you recognize, others that seem like meaningless gibberish—emanates from it.

missing_shipped.name: cottontail rabbit kit
missing_shipped.description: A tiny and very cute cottontail rabbit kit.

missing_shipped.name: wood frog
missing_shipped.description: This frog wears a pattern of tans and browns, with a darker eye mask and a light cream underbelly.  Its coverings make for great camouflage among the dry leaves and tree bark.

missing_shipped.name: tadpole
missing_shipped.description: This mottled brown tadpole appears rather typical until you can get a glimpse from the side.  Then its high, peaked mouth and low round belly stand out in profile.

missing_shipped.name: many-legged frog
missing_shipped.description: This cream and brown frog looks more like a great insect in profile.  It has evidently mutated, growing many additional, spindly legs that rise high before attempting to bend back downwards.

missing_shipped.name: gray chick
missing_shipped.description: A tiny dull-colored chick, it could be from a number of different species.

missing_shipped.name: earthworm larva
missing_shipped.description: A white wriggling worm.

missing_shipped.name: worm snake
missing_shipped.description: A small burrowing reptile that's just enjoying its time hunting earthworms.

missing_shipped.name: worm snake snakelet
missing_shipped.description: A worm snake in its hatchling stage.  Not that much smaller than an adult, actually.

missing_shipped.name: Yrax apeirohedron
missing_shipped.description: Its uncountable surfaces flow against each other in a dazzling sea of gold.

missing_shipped.name: Yrax delta
missing_shipped.description: A kite shaped blade of metal, darting through air and foes by indiscernible means.

missing_shipped.name: Yrax quadraphract
missing_shipped.description: A gleaming, burnished gold, four legged structure the size of a small vehicle, but much taller; this looks vaguely robotic, but too smooth and perfect to fit in this world.  Its legs are smooth faceted figures, with no visible joints, and hold its gem-like body aloft with an eery, sculpted grace.  At the peak of the gem-body is a deep, goblet-shaped crown that slowly swivels about, pointing at nothing in specific.  Though nothing about its appearance is familiar to you, it nevertheless strikes you with a mixture of awe and dread.

missing_shipped.name: quadraphract leg
missing_shipped.description: A morphing lune of burnished gold attached to the greater structure.  Seemingly jointless it moves with a fluid grace, allowing the quadraphract to glide aboveground with a speed and agility that belies its size.

missing_shipped.name: Yrax sphenocorona
missing_shipped.description: Manipulator arrays seamlessly protract from asymmetric facets, their testing spaces undisturbed by the forces affixing it to the sky.

missing_shipped.name: Yrax triakis
missing_shipped.description: Short-snakelike limbs seamlessly extend from an aggressively faceted body.  Its movements keep it low to the ground, coiled like a trap waiting to spring.

missing_shipped.name: Yrax trifacet
missing_shipped.description: Three dual leg modules join with each lower vertex of a pyramidal body, in a abstract configuration that vaguely recalls an alien arthropod.  Devoid of any exterior signs that betray its artificial origin, it looks like it could fold itself into a perfectly featureless quartz pyramid.  It crawls with a gait like none you've seen before, its minute movements too fast for your eyes to track.

missing_shipped.name: tiger fungal wight
missing_shipped.description: This rotting tiger has lost its stumble, as large fungal bulbs seem to have extended its pawpads thoroughly.  Its head crackles when trying to turn, seemingly stuck facing forward.

missing_shipped.name: dusted acidic zombie

useall_png_only.name: eraser
useall_png_only.description: A small eraser used to clear up unwanted pencil handwriting.

useall_png_only.name: ESAPI ballistic plate
useall_png_only.description: A polygonal ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile, made of ceramic.  Its inner surface is coated with UHMW polyethylene and is labeled "TOP", while the outer surface is labeled "STRIKE FACE".  This is intended to be worn in a ballistic vest, and can withstand several high-energy rifle rounds before breaking.

useall_png_only.name: ESBI ballistic plate
useall_png_only.description: A polygonal ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile, made of ceramic.  "STRIKE FACE" is printed on its outer surface.  This is designed to be worn in the sides of a plate carrier, and can withstand several high-energy rifle rounds before breaking.

useall_png_only.name: espadrilles
useall_png_only.description: Originating from the Pyrenees and made from a rope sole and cloth, these shoes are perfect for the hot weather, sipping Sangria and dodging tourists.

useall_png_only.name: etched human skull
useall_png_only.description: A human skull covered with strange etchings.

useall_png_only.name: sapper
useall_png_only.description: A metal pole saw covered in faded orange paint and warning labels written in an unknown language.  The circular blade at the end is over an inch thick, its deeply dished grooves suggesting its purpose as a digging implement rather than a cutter.  The Exodii use these to chew through reinforced walls like concrete or solid steel, and it's been retrofitted to run on their bionic power.

useall_png_only.name: Caotel Sr2.2 (FAN)
useall_png_only.description: Nothing but ruins and ash-choked skies remained in the world where this exotic weapon was manufactured, and the Exodii, ever pragmatic, choose not to explore beyond what was necessary to perform a second, emergency escape.  Even a second of exposure to the Caotel's plasma fan is enough to flash-incinerate anything, but its state of disrepair limits the amount of time its destructive power can be sustained.

useall_png_only.name: Caotel Sr2.2 (Projectile)
useall_png_only.description: Nothing but ruins and ash-choked skies remained in the world where this exotic weapon was manufactured, and the Exodii, ever pragmatic, choose not to explore beyond what was necessary to perform a second, emergency escape.  A single discharge from the Caotel easily melts through conventional armor and flash-incinerates anything behind it, but its state of disrepair limits the number of shots it can fire in quick succession.

useall_png_only.name: breacher
useall_png_only.description: Some sort of large prybar of a make and manufacturer you've never seen before.  On the heavier end is a set of thick, crabclaw like shears connected to a hydraulic piston, capable of cutting or prying through metal with great force.  The Exodii use these for general purpose breaching and scrapping heavy machines, and it's been retrofitted to run on their bionic power.

useall_png_only.name: extension cord
useall_png_only.description: A long 30-foot (or about 10 m) orange extension cord for extending cables or connecting appliances.  Could be used on any appliance or other household electrical system.

useall_png_only.name: saline eye drops
useall_png_only.description: Sterile saline eye drops.  Can be used to treat dry eyes, or to wash out contaminants.

useall_png_only.name: refined ordnance-cartridge necklace
useall_png_only.description: An article of hand-produced apparel that George Washington himself could look down upon with an approving smile, the daintiness of this necklace's precious metal chain looks rather comical when compared against the gargantuan pendant that hangs from it: an expended casing from a grenade round, shotgun cartridge, or some other form of sizable munition.

useall_png_only.name: refined pistol-cartridge necklace
useall_png_only.description: The product of a gun nut and a fashionista proverbially shaking one another's hand, this plain, though elegant, necklace has been strung with a solitary, sparklingly polished casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition.

useall_png_only.name: refined rifle-cartridge necklace
useall_png_only.description: A gentlemanly article of craft-produced jewelry for the most spiffy ladies and gentlemen of the post-apocalypse, this plain chain of precious metal has been retrofitted with a fired rifle cartridge that hangs from it as a pendant.

useall_png_only.name: fanny pack
useall_png_only.description: A small fabric bag worn on the waist, with the pouch in front for easy access.  Once used as a visual shorthand for unstylish geeks and silly tourists, it was making a decent comeback before the apocalypse.

useall_png_only.name: chunk of fat
useall_png_only.description: A chunk of raw fat.  You could eat it as-is, but it is better used as an ingredient in other foods or projects.

useall_png_only.name: chunk of tainted fat
useall_png_only.description: A watery yellow glob of fat from some unnatural creature or other.  Something is… wrong with it.  It doesn't seem like normal fat.

useall_png_only.name: FBI ballistic vest
useall_png_only.description: A ranger green soft ballistic vest with MOLLE rigging used by federal law enforcement agencies.  Soft armor plates inside the vest provide solid defense against shrapnel and small-caliber rounds.  "FBI" is emblazoned across the front and back in large, yellow lettering, and it includes a pocket for storing evidence.  Use it to attach or detach pouches.

useall_png_only.name: feather
useall_png_only.description: A feather from a bird.  Useful for fletching arrows.

useall_png_only.name: feline sample
useall_png_only.description: A slurry of flexibility.

useall_png_only.name: felt patch
useall_png_only.description: A small, six-inch square patch of felt.

useall_png_only.name: fencing épée
useall_png_only.description: A weapon used for fencing, the most noble of all sports.  While not designed for combat the épée is the heaviest and stiffest of the fencing weapons, and therefore perhaps still useful in your situation.

useall_png_only.name: sharpened épée
useall_png_only.description: What was once a mostly-harmless fencing épée has had its electrical plunger assembly removed and has been crudely sharpened to a point.  Though it still lacks a cutting edge, it is now considerably more lethal, yet still familiar to the practiced fencer.

useall_png_only.name: fencing foil
useall_png_only.description: A weapon used for fencing, the most noble of all sports.  Unfortunately, a fencing foil is rather useless as a weapon due to its flexible shaft and dull tip.

useall_png_only.name: sharpened foil
useall_png_only.description: What was once a mostly-harmless fencing foil has had its electrical plunger assembly removed and has been crudely sharpened to a point.  Though it still lacks a cutting edge, it is now somewhat more lethal, yet still familiar to the practiced fencer.

useall_png_only.name: fencing jacket
useall_png_only.description: A padded jacket with a zipper on the back, used by fencers to prevent accidents.

useall_png_only.name: fencing mask
useall_png_only.description: A tough hood made of steel mesh used by fencers.

useall_png_only.name: fencing pants
useall_png_only.description: A pair of reinforced pants used by fencers to prevent injuries.  They don't cover the lower leg.

useall_png_only.name: fencing saber
useall_png_only.description: A weapon used for fencing, the most noble of all sports.  Not designed for combat the saber at least bears an edge and so outperforms the foil, though still lacks the weight of the épée.

useall_png_only.name: sharpened saber
useall_png_only.description: What was once a mostly-harmless fencing saber has had its rounded tip snapped off and has been crudely sharpened to a point.  Though it still lacks a cutting edge, it is now considerably more lethal, yet still familiar to the practiced fencer.

useall_png_only.name: misshapen fetus
useall_png_only.description: A deformed human fetus.  Eating this would be the most vile thing you can think of, and just might cause you to mutate.

useall_png_only.name: fiber mat
useall_png_only.description: A large mat woven from fibrous material.  You could use it as a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a surface for butchering.  Too thin to be used as a comfortable sleeping mat.  It's rolled and ready for carrying.

useall_png_only.name: boiled fiddleheads
useall_png_only.description: Boiled fiddleheads.  Not bad, but would be better sauteed in butter.

useall_png_only.name: fiddleheads
useall_png_only.description: A handful of immature fern fronds, still curled up like the head of a fiddle.  Delicious when cooked, but consuming them raw can cause food poisoning.

useall_png_only.name: sauteed fiddleheads
useall_png_only.description: Fiddleheads sauteed in fat.  Tender and delicious.

useall_png_only.name: field stone
useall_png_only.description: A medium, flattish, heavy rock, big enough and flat enough to be used as a block in field stone walls.

useall_png_only.name: automotive filter
useall_png_only.description: A steel can containing filter paper designed for automotive use.

useall_png_only.name: qualitative filter paper
useall_png_only.description: A piece of filter paper for separating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 2 microns, separating more solids out than quantitative filter paper, but the process takes longer.  It's intended to be disposable, but you could probably use it for some time before it's unusable.

useall_png_only.name: quantitative filter paper
useall_png_only.description: A piece of filter paper for separating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 20 microns, separating less solids out than qualitative filter paper, but the process is much faster.  It's intended to be disposable, but you could probably use it for some time before it's unusable.

useall_png_only.name: bow fire drill
useall_png_only.description: A simple item for starting fires with friction between a notched plank and wooden shaft.  The shaft is spun rapidly with a sawing motion by a bowstring wrapped around it.  Very slow to acquire a usable ember.

useall_png_only.name: fire gauntlets (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A heavy pair of gloves, used by firefighters and metalworkers for heat protection.

useall_png_only.name: firecracker
useall_png_only.description: A solitary firecracker with a short fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse it will explode, so throw it quickly!

useall_png_only.name: pack of firecrackers
useall_png_only.description: A pack of 25 firecrackers with a starter fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse they will begin to explode, so throw them quickly!

useall_png_only.name: survivor giant firefly lamp
useall_png_only.description: Some enterprising survivor has decided to turn this terrarium into a light source, using what appear to be a giant firefly and triffid vegetation.

useall_png_only.name: firefighter helmet
useall_png_only.description: A distinctive helmet worn by firefighters.  More than just a piece of firefighting equipment, it serves as a badge of honor and respect.

useall_png_only.name: firefighter belt
useall_png_only.description: A stout firefighter's belt.  Useful for keeping your bunker gear up, it also doubles as an equipment belt with a reinforced loop for holding a large tool.

useall_png_only.name: fillet of fish
useall_png_only.description: An uncooked fish fillet.  Makes a passable meal raw.

useall_png_only.name: fish and spinach bagel
useall_png_only.description: A delicious fish bagel with spinach and eggs.

useall_png_only.name: cooked fish
useall_png_only.description: A cooked fish fillet.  Very nutritious.

useall_png_only.name: fish sample
useall_png_only.description: A slurry of transformation.

useall_png_only.name: fish sandwich
useall_png_only.description: A delicious fish sandwich.

useall_png_only.name: fishing hook
useall_png_only.description: A simple metal fishing hook.

useall_png_only.name: improvised fishing hook
useall_png_only.description: An improvised fishing hook carved from wood or bone.

useall_png_only.name: two-piece fishing rod (packed)
useall_png_only.description: A commercial two-piece fishing rod that has been disassembled for ease of transport and storage.

useall_png_only.name: telescoping fishing rod (packed)
useall_png_only.description: A commercial telescoping fishing rod that has been retracted for ease of transport and storage.

useall_png_only.name: fishing waders
useall_png_only.description: Waterproof plastic fishing waders with a single large front pocket.

useall_png_only.name: flag jumpsuit
useall_png_only.description: A jumpsuit embroidered with a pattern of the American flag.  Provides decent storage and is not very encumbering.

useall_png_only.name: swimsuit
useall_png_only.description: A simple swimsuit.

useall_png_only.name: M9-7 flamethrower
useall_png_only.description: A large flamethrower with substantial gas reserves.  The steel frame, with canvas accoutrements and aluminum cylinders, are all colored olive drab, like so many other pieces of equipment from the Vietnam War era.

useall_png_only.name: flaregun
useall_png_only.description: A plastic single shot pistol that can be loaded with signal flares.

useall_png_only.name: flashbang
useall_png_only.description: A military police-style flashbang.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse.  You will then have two seconds before it detonates with intense light and sound, blinding, deafening, and disorienting anyone nearby.

useall_png_only.name: flashlight pouch
useall_png_only.description: A tiny pouch designed to keep your flashlight accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.

useall_png_only.name: sealed yeast culture
useall_png_only.description: A sealed jar holding sanitized yeast wort.  You may harvest the yeast inside when it's done culturing.

useall_png_only.name: flatbread
useall_png_only.description: Simple unleavened bread.

useall_png_only.name: flint and steel
useall_png_only.description: A piece of flint paired with a hardened high carbon steel striker.  Use it to spark a flame.

useall_png_only.name: paper cartridge pouch
useall_png_only.description: A covered leather pouch, worn at the waist to store and protect prepared blackpowder cartridges.

useall_png_only.name: flip-flops (pair)
useall_png_only.description: Simple sandals.  Somewhat difficult to run in.

useall_png_only.name: expensive flip-flops (pair)
useall_png_only.description: These are upmarket "luxury" flip-flops.  Very difficult to run in.

useall_png_only.name: flotation vest
useall_png_only.description: A brightly-colored vest designed to keep you upright and floating in water.

useall_png_only.name: makeshift flotation vest
useall_png_only.description: A flotation vest made of inflated animal skins.

useall_png_only.name: flu shot
useall_png_only.description: A pharmaceutical flu shot designed for mass vaccinations, still in its packaging.  Purported to provide immunity to influenza, for the flu season for which it was developed.

useall_png_only.name: flute
useall_png_only.description: A simple silver-plated flute.

useall_png_only.name: FN 5.7mm pistol
useall_png_only.description: Firing the armor-piercing 5.7x28mm round, this lightweight handgun was developed for NATO use as a sidearm capable of penetrating body armor.  Its proprietary and nonprolific ammunition kept it comparatively rare among both civilian and militant use, but the gun's ability to ignore most forms of conventional ballistic armor can't be argued with.  Given that its tiny bullets have next to no stopping power, its armor-penetrating capability comes at a considerable trade-off.

useall_png_only.name: Belgian battle rifle
useall_png_only.description: Originally designed during the Cold War, this gun is probably the most successful battle rifle ever designed.  Despite being labeled as obsolete, its tunable gas system ensures both reliability and low recoil, allowing it to keep up even among modern competitors.  This is a semi-automatic clone built by a domestic manufacturer.

useall_png_only.name: faux gras
useall_png_only.description: Though this meal is technically not foie gras, you have a feeling neither the French nor animal rights groups are likely to criticize it now.

useall_png_only.name: inflatable boat
useall_png_only.description: This rubber rowboat (with oars included) is deflated for storage.  Activate it with an air pump in your inventory to inflate and launch it.

useall_png_only.name: rain poncho
useall_png_only.description: A lightweight plastic rain poncho with a hood.  It folds into a very compact form when not in use.

useall_png_only.name: food processor
useall_png_only.description: A kitchen appliance capable of slicing, chopping, shredding, grinding, pureeing, and mixing.

useall_png_only.name: disconnected foot locker recharging station
useall_png_only.description: A universal recharging station integrated into a steel storage compartment.  When plugged in and powered, it will steadily charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.

useall_png_only.name: football
useall_png_only.description: An oval-shaped ball made of leather and string, it's easily thrown but does little damage.  You could take it apart into leather if you wanted.

useall_png_only.name: football armor
useall_png_only.description: Heavy polycarbonate armor for your upper torso.  Normally worn by football players.

useall_png_only.name: foot rags (pair)

useall_png_only.name: Henry Big Boy .44 rifle
useall_png_only.description: This fine lever-action rifle is chambered in the powerful .44 Magnum cartridge and features a sleek octagonal barrel with a tube fed magazine.  Go get 'em cowboy!

useall_png_only.name: small game lever-action rifle
useall_png_only.description: A .22 Long Rifle lever-action rifle, which holds 16 rounds of ammo.  While quite useful against small game, its effectiveness isn't as great against the undead.

useall_png_only.name: heroin
useall_png_only.description: An extremely strong opioid narcotic derived from morphine.  Incredibly addictive, the risk of overdose is extreme, and the drug is contraindicated for nearly all medical purposes.

useall_png_only.name: Browning Hi-Power .40 S&W
useall_png_only.description: The Browning Hi-Power is a semi-automatic handgun developed shortly before the Second World War.  Widely issued since then, it remains in use by India, Canada, and Australia.  This is a commercial variant produced by Browning Arms in .40 S&W.

useall_png_only.name: Browning Hi-Power 9x19mm handgun
useall_png_only.description: The Browning Hi-Power is a semi-automatic handgun developed shortly before the Second World War.  Widely issued since then, it remains in use by India, Canada, and Australia.  This is a commercial variant produced by Browning Arms in 9x19mm Parabellum.

useall_png_only.name: hickory nuts
useall_png_only.description: A handful of hard nuts from a hickory tree, still in their shells.

useall_png_only.name: Handful of shelled hickory nuts
useall_png_only.description: A handful of raw, hard nuts from a hickory tree, with the shells removed.

useall_png_only.name: hickory root
useall_png_only.description: A root from a hickory tree.  It has an earthy smell.

useall_png_only.name: censer
useall_png_only.description: A small bronze vessel used to burn incense and other aromatic substances.  Its adorned with a variety of natural and knotwork designs.

useall_png_only.name: burial shroud
useall_png_only.description: A cloak of thin, faded cloth that was used to wrap a corpse.  Its deep blue, and embroidered has been embroidered with a starmap in silver thread.

useall_png_only.name: funeral crown
useall_png_only.description: A golden circlet adorned with filigree leaves and pearls.  The remnants of a white silk veil remain attached to the crown.

useall_png_only.name: HK417 rifle
useall_png_only.description: A German battle rifle with a 13" barrel and telescopic stock.  It is a gas-operated, rotating bolt rifle with a short-stroke piston design similar to that of the G36.

useall_png_only.name: G3 battle rifle
useall_png_only.description: A semi-automatic, domestically produced clone of an early battle rifle developed after the end of WWII.  Known as the PTR 91, it is a fantastically reliable, cheap to produce rifle that continues to serve in conflict regions.  Though the action is legendary, its handling characteristics and harsher recoil leave something to be desired.

useall_png_only.name: H&K G80 railgun
useall_png_only.description: A highly advanced infantry weapon that magnetically propels a ferromagnetic projectile using an alternating current.  Markings and serials imply it was manufactured by Heckler & Koch, but the maturity of the implemented technologies makes such a claim suspect.  Powered by UPS.

useall_png_only.name: MP5 pistol
useall_png_only.description: A semi-automatic copy of the famous MP5 series, domestically produced for the US market.  Like the MP5, its roller delayed blowback action offers smooth shooting and precision, setting it apart from other submachine guns and pistol caliber carbines.  This model is configured as a pistol to avoid inconvenient and costly NFA regulations.  A welded-on section of M1913 rail offers convenient mounting for aftermarket optics, but precludes the use of claw mounts.

useall_png_only.name: H&K MP5K-PDW submachine gun
useall_png_only.description: The Heckler & Koch MP5 is one of the most widely-used submachine guns in the world, and has been adopted by special police forces and militaries alike.  Its high degree of accuracy and low recoil are universally praised.  The MP5K-PDW model features a shorter barrel, a built-in foregrip, and a side folding stock for vehicle or aircraft crew use.

useall_png_only.name: H&K MP5SD submachine gun
useall_png_only.description: The H&K MP5SD offers subsonic performance in almost the same footprint as the H&K MP5, retaining its handiness.  The large suppressor cuts down on muzzle flash greatly, aiding in night operations.  It has also seen some popularity with SWAT teams, as it lowers the risk of fire and explosions in illegal laboratories.  With body armor in more common use, the MP5SD has waned in popularity among special forces due to its decreased terminal performance.

useall_png_only.name: H&K USC 45 carbine
useall_png_only.description: A compact, lightweight carbine chambering the .45 ACP pistol round.  Resembling the popular UMP submachine gun in both its blowback operating system and lightweight polymer frame construction, this civilian variant is distinguished by its skeletonized stock and 16 inch barrel, leaving it unable to accommodate standard UMP parts.

useall_png_only.name: hm12 dazzle rifle
useall_png_only.description: This prototype 'energy weapon' was apparently manufactured by Hub 01.  It somewhat resembles an oversize radar gun, mounted on a rectangular frame of white sheet metal.  It will temporarily stun robots, if you manage to hit their sensors with a clean shot.

useall_png_only.name: hoe
useall_png_only.description: A farming implement.  You can use it to turn tillable land into a slow-to-cross pile of dirt, or dig a shallow pit.

useall_png_only.name: holographic sight
useall_png_only.description: An advanced optic with an adjustable circular hologram reticle superimposed on the field of view.  Used extensively by military forces, it increases accuracy and weight.  This is a step up from a red dot sight.

useall_png_only.name: holster
useall_png_only.description: A leather strap worn on the hip for holding pistol-sized guns.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

useall_png_only.name: picture

useall_png_only.name: homemade bomb
useall_png_only.description: A homemade explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with stable explosives and scrap metal, equipped with a long fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Once you do, it should explode after about 20 seconds.

useall_png_only.name: homemade burrito
useall_png_only.description: A traditional Mexican dish of meat, beans or rice, and vegetables spread on a corn tortilla and rolled into a tube shape.  The fresh ingredients make this one taste way better than those gas station knockoffs.

useall_png_only.name: homemade demolition charge
useall_png_only.description: An improvised demolition charge.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  20 seconds after lighting the fuse, it will explode, so get away!

useall_png_only.name: homeopathic pill

useall_png_only.name: honeydew

useall_png_only.description: What's better than a hot dog?  A hot dog smothered in ground meat and chopped onions, of course!

useall_png_only.name: .380 ACP pistol-caliber carbine
useall_png_only.description: A pistol-caliber carbine chambered in .380 ACP.  It is more powerful and accurate than an equivalent pistol but the .380 ACP round is nonetheless fairly weak.  Accepts 10-round magazines, which are not shared with any .380 ACP pistol unlike many other similar pistol-caliber carbines.

useall_png_only.name: Hi-Point C-9 pistol

useall_png_only.name: Hi-Point CF-380 pistol

useall_png_only.name: heavy survivor suit

useall_png_only.description: A battery that uses a huge plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound.  It was used in military mech-suits, was highly experimental, and had no civilian applications.  Although it stores a stupendous amount of power, it cannot be recharged.

useall_png_only.name: heavy crossbow
useall_png_only.description: A HUGE medieval crossbow from Germany with a very slow, difficult reloading process.  Its tension is so powerful that you feel it shake after firing.

useall_png_only.name: piece of raw human brain
useall_png_only.description: A chunk of brain from a human.  Eating this may cause kuru, but you probably won't live long enough to care about that anyway.

useall_png_only.name: icon
useall_png_only.description: A small picture, about the size of an ID card, symbolizing a religious figure.  On the back, there is text that faintly reads 'New England Church Community'.

useall_png_only.name: visitor's pass
useall_png_only.description: A visitor's pass to some sort of facility.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at a card reader, if you can find one.  It also lists the addresses of nearby facilities; activate it to add their locations to your map.

useall_png_only.name: IFAK pouch
useall_png_only.description: A fabric pouch designed to contain a personalized trauma kit.  These supplies are used to address immediate life-threatening conditions.

useall_png_only.name: improvised tire arm guards (pair)

useall_png_only.name: improvised tire leg guards (pair)
useall_png_only.description: Leg guards made of thick chunks of tire held together with duct tape.

useall_png_only.name: volleyball
useall_png_only.description: A standard regulation volleyball.

useall_png_only.name: inflatable section
useall_png_only.description: An inflatable boat section.

useall_png_only.name: insect sample
useall_png_only.description: A slurry of stability.

useall_png_only.description: A canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five seconds it will begin to expel a volatile gas that is highly toxic to insect life forms.

useall_png_only.name: makeshift insecticidal gas grenade
useall_png_only.description: A makeshift canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five seconds it will begin to expel a volatile gas that is highly toxic to insect life forms.

useall_png_only.name: insta-salad
useall_png_only.description: A dried salad with water added, not very tasty but still a decent substitution for real salad.

useall_png_only.name: individual patrol officer kit
useall_png_only.description: A first aid kit designed for patrolling police officers, contents selected for dealing with hemorrhaging injuries such as gunshot wounds.  Comes in a sealed pouch.

useall_png_only.name: cast-iron pot
useall_png_only.description: This hefty black pot is made from cast iron and coated in a sturdy enamel.

useall_png_only.name: IWI Tavor X95
useall_png_only.description: The Tavor is an Israeli series of bullpup rifles designed and produced by Israel Weapon Industries.  This is the Tavor X95, a civilian-legal rifle lacking any full-auto capability, and sporting a 16.5" barrel.  Chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO, this rifle feeds from STANAG magazines.

useall_png_only.name: bottle jack
useall_png_only.description: A portable hydraulic bottle jack used for lifting vehicles.

useall_png_only.name: makeshift jack
useall_png_only.description: A poorly-constructed improvised scissor jack used for lifting vehicles if you're brave enough to use it.

useall_png_only.name: scissor jack
useall_png_only.description: A compact scissor jack used for lifting vehicles.

useall_png_only.name: army jacket
useall_png_only.description: A vintage article of military surplus with an adjustable waist drawstring, or at least a civilian reproduction of one — it's resplendent with a cotton liner, an integral hood tucked away in a zip-up pouch in the collar, and epaulettes upon the shoulders.

useall_png_only.name: combat blouse
useall_png_only.description: A sleek blouse in a camouflage pattern with angled breast pockets and lots of loop velcro for affixing patches.  You might call it a jacket but it's really a blouse.  It has a pocket for your pen!

useall_png_only.name: chef's jacket
useall_png_only.description: A double-breasted uniform to protect against the heat of the kitchen.

useall_png_only.name: emergency jacket
useall_png_only.description: A bright, cheaply made FEMA-issue windbreaker jacket with a hood.  One size, fits none.  Helps keep you unfrozen & visible for rescuers.

useall_png_only.name: flannel jacket
useall_png_only.description: A jacket made from flannel, favored by outdoorsy types.

useall_png_only.name: jean jacket
useall_png_only.description: A jacket made from denim.

useall_png_only.name: armored jean jacket
useall_png_only.description: A denim jacket reinforced with metal plates.  Adequately protective, but not very sturdy.

useall_png_only.name: hardened armored jean jacket
useall_png_only.description: A denim jacket reinforced with hardened steel plates.  Highly protective, but not very sturdy.

useall_png_only.name: leather jacket
useall_png_only.description: A jacket made from leather, offering more protection than your average cotton or denim jacket.

useall_png_only.name: occult bone armor
useall_png_only.description: A black jacket made from thick leather and covered with intricately carved bones.  You've never seen patterns like those before, each time you look at them you spot a new one as if they were changing on their own.

useall_png_only.name: armored motorcycle jacket
useall_png_only.description: A thick motorcycle jacket with metal plates drilled onto various areas for increased protection.

useall_png_only.name: hardened armored motorcycle jacket
useall_png_only.description: A thick motorcycle jacket with hardened metal plates drilled onto various areas for highly increased protection.

useall_png_only.name: tire motorcycle jacket
useall_png_only.description: A motorcycle jacket reinforced with chunks of thick rubber tire.  Thick and highly resistant to blunt force.

useall_png_only.name: light jacket
useall_png_only.description: A thin cotton jacket with a hood.  Good for brisk weather.

useall_png_only.name: varsity jacket
useall_png_only.description: A cotton varsity jacket, the type that the jocks in a highschool or a college would wear.

useall_png_only.name: windbreaker
useall_png_only.description: A light synthetic jacket with a hood.  Not very warm, but will keep out the rain.

useall_png_only.name: javelin bag
useall_png_only.description: An open medieval-looking bag, designed to store javelins within easy reach.

useall_png_only.name: jeans
useall_png_only.description: A pair of jeans with two deep pockets.

useall_png_only.name: armored jeans
useall_png_only.description: A pair of jeans reinforced with hard plastic knee pads and metal sheets.  The end product is not very sturdy and somewhat cumbersome, but protective.

useall_png_only.name: hardened armored jeans
useall_png_only.description: A pair of jeans reinforced with hard plastic knee pads and hardened steel sheets.  Although its high protection outweighs its encumbrance, it's not really sturdy.

useall_png_only.name: ripped jeans
useall_png_only.description: A pair of jeans that has been ripped over the knees.  It may have been fashionable before Cataclysm, but it's just a pair of sub-par jeans now.

useall_png_only.name: skinny jeans
useall_png_only.description: A pair of skinny jeans with four pockets.

useall_png_only.name: vintage jeans
useall_png_only.description: A pair of vintage jeans that has started to lose its color.  It appears to be slightly heavier and thicker; but hey, don't let that stop you from wearing the fashion of the olden days!

useall_png_only.name: sports jersey
useall_png_only.description: A lightweight, breathable shirt made from synthetic fabric, designed for athletic performance and team identification.

useall_png_only.name: ji

useall_png_only.name: slice of birthday cake

useall_png_only.name: jika-tabi (pair)

useall_png_only.description: An oddball in the Exodii's oddball selection of armaments - This robust, shoulder mounted weapons platform started life not as a weapon, but as a ceremonial firework cannon, mounted in droves atop of parade tanks the size of buildings by some globe spanning military culture. useall_png_only.name: kilt

useall_png_only.name: cleaver
useall_png_only.description: generic item template

useall_png_only.name: National Guard bayonet

It has an apocalypse-proof full-tang, double-edged high steel blade terminating in a spear point.  The no-frills design makes for both a good fighting knife and bayonet, a fact that was appreciated when reserve stocks of these were issued out to National Guardsmen.

useall_png_only.name: Bayonet
useall_png_only.description: The current issue Army bayonet, before the Cataclysm anyways.  It is thick, heavy, and surprisingly sharp.  This bayonet also functions as a wire cutter, and a mediocre saw for cutting through aircraft fuselage.  That the handle and tang can be completely disassembled from the blade is surely a fact of great comfort to the soldier, survivalist, and you.

useall_png_only.name: USMC bayonet
useall_png_only.description: A modern bayonet in use with the US Marine Corps, adopted in an effort to improve USMC hand-to-hand fighting capabilities.  The bayonet is optimized to function as a fighting knife, sporting an ergonomic handle that will minimize hand fatigue during combat.  The blade tip is sharper in profile than other bayonets to assist in penetrating body armor, and also features a small serrated section to provide for some utility.

useall_png_only.name: folding knife

useall_png_only.name: micro conceal carry pistol

useall_png_only.name: 7-round auto-loading combat shotgun
useall_png_only.description: A semi-automatic smooth-bore shotgun, this weapon features respectable ergonomics and room for 7 shotshells within its tubular magazine.  Suitable both for competition shooting and offensive combat roles, this firearm is faster to shoot than a traditional pump-action model, with the caveat that it's harder to maintain than its manually operated siblings as it relies on an internal gas system to cycle rounds rather than the user's own physical input.

useall_png_only.name: semi-automatic anti-materiel rifle
useall_png_only.description: A mahoosive rifle of military pedigree, fitted with a telescopic gun scope peeking over its giant cocking mechanism and resting upon a bipod to control recoil from the equally big .50-caliber munitions it is designed for.  Originally employed for detonating unexploded ordnance in combat conditions and defeating light vehicular and structural targets, in the post-Cataclysm it serves as an admirable conduit of kinetic energy to the biggest and baddest of the new world's critters.

useall_png_only.name: M11 pistol

useall_png_only.name: HK417 marksman's rifle
useall_png_only.description: A gas-operated, rotating bolt rifle accurate to 1.5 MOA with standard ammunition, and featuring an aluminum upper receiver for reduced weight.

useall_png_only.name: M134D-H Minigun
useall_png_only.description: The M134D-H Minigun is a (relatively) lightweight heavy rotary machine gun.  Its six barrels are rotated by an electric motor, powered by UPS or vehicle.  If you could find enough ammo for it, it would become a devastating weapon.  It must be mounted on a vehicle before use.

useall_png_only.name: M14 EBR-RI rifle
useall_png_only.description: A highly modified version of the M14 rifle designed to cover both CQB and designated marksman roles.  A very powerful and versatile rifle, if somewhat heavy.

useall_png_only.name: service handgun
useall_png_only.description: The general-issue military handgun of the United States army before the Cataclysm, this is a sizable pistol that fires 9x19mm cartridges.  Based off successful civilian designs and capable of taking magazines of various round capacities, the gun features a plastic polymer frame which helps to reduce overall weight.

useall_png_only.name: compact service handgun
useall_png_only.description: A more petite version of the United States army's general issue sidearm, this is a modestly-sized pistol firing 9x19mm rounds.  Making use of the same magazines as its larger brother, the weapon features a shorter barrel and frame which helps to reduce its overall profile and make it more concealable as a result.

useall_png_only.name: Springfield rifle
useall_png_only.description: A powerful military rifle chambered in .30-06, developed to replace the US Army's older Krag rifle.  It served as the main American rifle in World War I, was used alongside the M1 Garand in World War II, and was used as a sniper rifle as late as the Vietnam War.

useall_png_only.name: BAR rifle
useall_png_only.description: This heavy rifle was designed near the end of World War I, and provided fire support for the US Army from World War II all the way to the Vietnam War.  Too much firepower to serve as a battle rifle, but not enough to be an ideal light machine gun, it still found a niche on the battlefield.

useall_png_only.name: American battle rifle
useall_png_only.description: This civilian variant of an American battle rifle is essentially a rifle from World War 2 with a detachable magazine stuck in it that was sold to the military as a cheap, do-all rifle that could replace many other weapon systems.  While it delivered none of those things, it was an acceptable rifle, if marginally inferior to its contemporaries.

useall_png_only.name: M1 carbine
useall_png_only.description: A light rifle developed during the Second World War to provide a less cumbersome weapon for soldiers that didn't need the firepower of the M1 Garand.  Firing the .30 Carbine cartridge, it provides more firepower than a pistol and is easier to carry than most other rifles.

useall_png_only.name: M2010 ESR
useall_png_only.description: A bolt-action, box-magazine-fed sniper rifle chambered in the powerful .300 Winchester Magnum round.  The M2010 had completely replaced the M24 rifle series by 2017.

useall_png_only.name: M74 rocket launcher
useall_png_only.description: An American rocket launcher designed in the 1970s to replace WWII-era flamethrowers still in use in Vietnam.  It has four barrels sharing the 66mm caliber of the M72 LAW.

useall_png_only.name: M240 machine gun
useall_png_only.description: The M240 is a medium machine gun used by the US military, replacing the older M60.  Quite inaccurate and difficult to control, the M240 is designed to fire many rounds very quickly.

useall_png_only.name: .50-caliber heavy machine gun
useall_png_only.description: Essentially a giant steel box with a long barrel peering from one end and dual spade grips mounted upon the other, this venerable machine gun design served the United States military since the First World War, mounted on everything from tanks to patrol boats to aircraft, and even tripod-mounted for stand-alone use.  Part and parcel with its size and munition payload of .50-caliber ammo belts, however, is the fact that, to operate it, one must mount it upon suitable furniture, terrain features, or vehicles.

useall_png_only.name: M2 carbine
useall_png_only.description: An improved version of the M1 carbine offering full-auto capability, the M2 carbine was rare and coveted among collectors even before the world ended.  Takes M1 carbine magazines.

useall_png_only.name: M320 standalone launcher
useall_png_only.description: Heckler & Koch's M320 grenade launcher offers the functionality of larger launchers in a very small package at the cost of decreased accuracy.  This one is combined with a buttstock for standalone operation.

useall_png_only.name: M3 recoilless rifle

useall_png_only.name: M3E1 recoilless rifle

useall_png_only.name: M79 launcher

useall_png_only.name: second skin

The liquid appears bound to the resonating collar at your neck; the inside of the collar reads "CAREFUL CHOKING HAZARD!  THIS WAY DOWN".  The ooze flows freely, covering your entire body but never crossing the gorget to get to your head.

useall_png_only.name: SADM mininuke

useall_png_only.description: The common AR-15 platform, with its stock removed and buffer tube covered by a thick, padded sleeve that allows the user to brace it like a rifle. useall_png_only.name: Desert Eagle pistol

useall_png_only.name: M27 assault rifle

useall_png_only.name: M4 carbine

useall_png_only.name: Mosin carbine
useall_png_only.description: A later produced and substantially shortened version of Imperial Russia's original service rifle, this variant of the Mosin features a notably more compact barrel and an integral side-folding bayonet.  Produced during the latter days of the Second World War for the Soviet Union, the weapon exhibits less overall stopping power than its full-length older brother thanks to the former's stubbier barrel.  Despite the arm being somewhat weaker than its forefather, the 7.62x54mm round that it chambers still packs a hefty punch, whilst its smaller size helps to make the weapon wieldier.

useall_png_only.name: Mosin battle rifle
useall_png_only.description: Developed by the Russian Empire prior to the onset of the First World War, the Mosin is a bolt-action military battle rifle chambered for 7.62x54mm rounds.  Powerful, unwieldy, and prolific across the world as military surplus, this sizable rifle is a Soviet updated version of the venerable Mosin.

useall_png_only.name: 6-round combat shotgun
useall_png_only.description: The faithful friend of law-enforcement officers, military personnel, and zombie-hunting action heroes alike, this quaint firearm with its over 20 inch long barrel, 6-round magazine tube, and iconic pump-action design is as simple as it is effective.  One of the most popular firearm designs in all of history, this weapon can be reliably counted upon to do the job whether one's simply looking to hunt, or to, with the right loads, turn the heads of the living dead into a chunky zombie puree.

useall_png_only.name: 5-round hunting shotgun, 20 gauge
useall_png_only.description: Classic all-purpose shotgun, adapted to use 20 bore shells.  While being somewhat weaker than classic 12 bore, 26 inch of barrel length allow it to kick reasonable punch, without being as heavy as it's bigger brothers.

useall_png_only.name: 5-round small game shotgun
useall_png_only.description: This shotgun is a bit leaner and smaller than the others, being in .410 instead of the usual 12 gauge.  While the small caliber is more intended for small game, it will still kill zombies a-okay.

useall_png_only.name: 9-round combat shotgun
useall_png_only.description: A military oriented spin on the classic pump-action shotgun recipe, this firearm features an extended magazine tube capable of fielding nine rounds of 12 gauge shotshells.  Sporting a heavier barrel and a bayonet lug, it makes for a highly intimidating weapon, as well as a satisfying answer to most of the nasties you're liable to find in the post-apocalypse.

useall_png_only.name: 5-round pistol grip shotgun
useall_png_only.description: This shotgun features no stock, and a sling on the pump to help you hold onto it.  While legally speaking it's not a shotgun, it acts and shoots just like one, minus the stock.

useall_png_only.name: magazine-fed pump shotgun
useall_png_only.description: A classic pump-action shotgun, all save for the fact that the manufacturer has modified it to use detachable box magazines instead of a standard shotgun tube.

useall_png_only.name: 8-round auto-loading shotgun
useall_png_only.description: A semi-automatic smooth-bore shotgun, this weapon features respectable ergonomics and room for 8 shotshells within its tubular magazine.  Suitable both for competition shooting and offensive combat roles, this firearm is faster to shoot than a traditional pump-action model, with the caveat that it's harder to maintain than its manually operated siblings as it relies on an internal gas system to cycle rounds rather than the user's own physical input.

useall_png_only.name: motorcycle police boots (pair)
useall_png_only.description: Custom-made knee-high leather boots issued to motor officers.  Warm, durable and quite tough.

useall_png_only.name: tiny electric motor
useall_png_only.description: A tiny electric motor just the right size for providing a gentle boost for a bicycle, or similarly light vehicles.

useall_png_only.name: motorcycle armor

useall_png_only.name: motorcycle boots (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of durable boots used by dirt bikers and motorcyclists.

useall_png_only.name: motorcycle jeans
useall_png_only.description: A pair of thick jeans interwoven with Kevlar for added durability and sporting integrated kneepads and flank protection, typically worn by motorcyclists to protect from road rash.

useall_png_only.name: vehicle heater
useall_png_only.description: Set of tubes, that move heat from the engine into the vehicle cabin, heating it up.

useall_png_only.name: small vehicle heater
useall_png_only.description: Set of tubes, that move heat from the engine into the vehicle cabin, heating it up.

useall_png_only.name: mozzarella cheese

useall_png_only.name: sporter AR rifle

useall_png_only.name: modern varmint rifle

useall_png_only.name: Barrett precision rifle
useall_png_only.description: A box magazine-fed bolt-action precision rifle developed by the Barrett Arms Company, firing the .338 Lapua cartridge.  A civilian copy of more versatile military weapons, this rifle is a remarkably well-crafted piece of anti-personnel engineering despite lacking the sheer modularity of its Marshal sister, and is still capable of engaging targets at extreme distances.

useall_png_only.name: MRE spread bag
useall_png_only.description: A small, sturdy, plastic and aluminum container of multi-layered construction, with detailed nutritional information about its contents.

useall_png_only.name: MRE package
