useall_png_only.name: handful of mulberries

useall_png_only.name: multi-cooker - cooking
useall_png_only.description: A professional-grade multi-cooker, with a battery slot for camping trips or tailgating.  There is a dish cooking inside it.

useall_png_only.name: multimeter
useall_png_only.description: A gadget that is a little bigger than a handheld calculator, with a digital display and two pointed probes connected by wires.  It can measure not just voltage, but current in amps, and resistance in ohms, as well as test for electrical continuity.

useall_png_only.name: multitool

useall_png_only.name: mummy jumpsuit

useall_png_only.name: piece of raw mutant lung

useall_png_only.name: Exodii battle rifle
useall_png_only.description: The most popular gun to use the 12.3ln cartridge was, of course, the PA md. 71.  Its predecessor, the md. 68, was viewed by many as a sort of failure: although it was reliable and powerful, it was too heavy to be used as a good infantry weapon, and not really heavy enough to be a good support gun.  Enough were made, though, that during the zombie apocalypse, it gained a great deal of resurgent popularity as a light emplacement gun that used readily available ammunition.  It perfectly served the purposes of the Exodii, who had far less concern about its unwieldiness.

SoyPelusa ran a highly successful crowdfunding campaign for their signature protein bar, dubbed "DaiZoom."

A person can live on one of these bars, three times a day, presumably forever.  After backers received their product, a single flaw was found: most consumers found starvation preferable to the flavor.  Warehouses of the product went unsold as the company went bankrupt, providing the perfect opportunity for FEMA to scoop them up and stock the evac shelters.

useall_png_only.description: A type of helmet that was developed in the late 15th century.  Evolving from the sallet and armet, it includes a bevor to protect the neck.  Activate it to lower the visor.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel nasal helm
useall_png_only.description: An early medieval helmet with a projection guarding the nose, to better protect the face without obstructing vision.  Proper Viking gear, unlike the stereotypical horned helm.  This one is made in modern times out of steel.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel turban helmet
useall_png_only.description: A middle eastern helmet, cylindrical on the top with protection for the nose and ears but nothing lower.  This one is made in modern times out of steel.

useall_png_only.name: tempered knee guards (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of thin knee guards, forged from steel.  Can be comfortably worn over chainmail for extra protection.

useall_png_only.name: tempered knee guards (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of thin knee guards, forged from steel.  Can be comfortably worn over chainmail for extra protection.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel survival knife
useall_png_only.description: This massive knife features a hollow handle with a compass built into the pommel and a row of fearsome-looking saw teeth along the back of its blade.  Time to go Rambo on this apocalypse.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel trench knife
useall_png_only.description: This stout combat knife features a steel guard to protect the user's knuckles.  The guard can also be used for striking or blocking.  This one is made of tempered steel, and you feel you could hold a trench against an army of zombies with it.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel light close helm
useall_png_only.description: A type of helmet that was developed in the late 15th century.  Evolving from the sallet and armet, it includes a bevor to protect the neck.  Activate it to raise the visor.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel light close helm (raised)
useall_png_only.description: A type of helmet that was developed in the late 15th century.  Evolving from the sallet and armet, it includes a bevor to protect the neck.  Activate it to lower the visor.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel mirror armor
useall_png_only.description: Mirror armor earns its name from its distinct shape and polished sheen.  Round and rectangular steel plates are fastened together to protect all four sides of the torso.  It can be worn on top of other armor like chainmail and brigandines.  Masterfully crafted with tempered steel, this set features a prominent circular plate on the front that has been polished to a mirror-like sheen, flanked with supporting plates intricately joined to fit the body, all meticulously decorated.  Will protect you from serious harm, as well as the evil gazes of the undead.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel mitten gauntlets (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of leather mittens with chainmail protecting the fingers and palm, and steel plating over the back of the hand, fingers, and wrist for additional protection.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel pike
useall_png_only.description: A very long wooden shaft tipped with a masterfully tempered steel pike head.  The blade is razor-sharp and perfectly tapered.  The pinnacle of polearm craftsmanship.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel rapier
useall_png_only.description:
A thin sword with an ornate hand guard.  It looks like the preferred weapon of gentlemen and swashbucklers.  Light and quick, it makes any battle a stylish battle.

Made of tempered steel, this is a masterpiece.  The grip, the balance, the blade, all perfect.  This is the peak of the swordsmith's craft.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel sabaton
useall_png_only.description: A flexible set of jointed lames that can be worn over footwear for additional protection, traditionally worn by mounted knights.

useall_png_only.name: tempered splint vambraces (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of vambraces made of tough fabric sandwiched between alternating strips of steel.  Can be comfortably worn over chainmail for extra protection.

useall_png_only.name: quesadilla
useall_png_only.description: A tortilla filled with cheese and lightly grilled.

useall_png_only.name: quiver

useall_png_only.name: birchbark quiver

useall_png_only.name: large quiver

useall_png_only.name: large birchbark quiver
useall_png_only.description: A large quiver woven from strips of birchbark, worn on the back, that can hold 60 arrows or bolts.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.

useall_png_only.name: simple cloth quiver
useall_png_only.description: A simple quiver made out of cloth that can be adjusted to hold various types of arrows, bolts, and spears of different lengths.  Takes slightly longer to pull ammunition from than a regular quiver.  Use insert to store arrows, bolts, fishing spears, or atlatl spears.

useall_png_only.name: multi-function quiver
useall_png_only.description: A large cotton quiver capable of easily storing 16 arrows.  It includes a bag and straps to store a takedown bow, as well as a small pouch for archery accessories.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts and activate to holster/draw your bow.

useall_png_only.name: red carpet
useall_png_only.description: A roll of red carpet.

useall_png_only.name: rabbit sample
useall_png_only.description: A slurry of luck.

useall_png_only.name: radiation badge
useall_png_only.description: A plastic badge with an embedded filmstrip.  The text on the badge says the filmstrip changes color as it is exposed to radiation, and never goes back to how it initially looked.  Wear on your lapel so you can notice if it changes.

useall_png_only.name: RC car
useall_png_only.description: A remote-controlled car.  Fun for all ages.

useall_png_only.name: RC car (on)
useall_png_only.description: A remote-controlled toy car.  It is turned on and draining its batteries just like a real electric car!  Use a remote control to drive it around.

useall_png_only.name: RC car wheel set
useall_png_only.description: A small set of wheels for a radio-controlled car.  Could be improvised with caster wheels if given rubber treads for grip.

useall_png_only.name: tactical radio pouch
useall_png_only.description: A pouch designed to keep your radio accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.

useall_png_only.name: RC control
useall_png_only.description: A remote control for an RC car, with a joystick to steer the car and colorful buttons that don't seem to do anything.  Perhaps they were for the deluxe model?

useall_png_only.name: Taurus Raging Bull
useall_png_only.description: The Taurus Raging Bull is a 5-shot revolver chambered in .454 Casull.  It has impressive stopping power.

useall_png_only.name: Taurus Raging Judge Magnum
useall_png_only.description: The Taurus Raging Judge Magnum is a 6-shot revolver chambered in .454 Casull.  It can fire .410 shotshells and .45 Colt cartridges as well.

useall_png_only.name: pouch
useall_png_only.description: A makeshift bag, cobbled together from rags.  Really gets in the way, but provides a decent amount of storage.

useall_png_only.name: metal rake
useall_png_only.description: A sturdy metal rake, a must-have during autumn.

useall_png_only.name: plastic rake
useall_png_only.description: A cheap plastic rake.  Will break quite quickly if used for anything other than raking leaves.

useall_png_only.name: medium steel rapier
useall_png_only.description:
A thin sword with an ornate hand guard.  It looks like the preferred weapon of gentlemen and swashbucklers.  Light and quick, it makes any battle a stylish battle.

Made with medium steel and with a grip made of leather wrapped in steel wire, this weapon is comfortable in your hand, though the balance isn't perfect and the edge could be sharper.

useall_png_only.name: rapier
useall_png_only.description: A blunted, cheap replica of a thin sword with an ornate handguard.  It looks like the preferred weapon of gentlemen and swashbucklers.  Light and quick, it makes any battle a stylish battle.

useall_png_only.name: raptor sample
useall_png_only.description: A slurry of evolution.

useall_png_only.name: rashguard shirt
useall_png_only.description: A long-sleeved rashguard shirt.  Commonly used to protect against rashes from abrasion or sun exposure.

useall_png_only.name: rat sample
useall_png_only.description: A slurry of survival.

useall_png_only.name: handful of bamboo shoots
useall_png_only.description: Raw woody bamboo shoots, they require some preparation before they can be eaten safely.

useall_png_only.name: raw bottle gourd
useall_png_only.description: A vegetable from the gourd family, bottle gourds were brought to the Americas by the first Native American settlers crossing the Bering strait.  It can be further prepared to produce a hard, watertight shell, usable as a biodegradable liquid container.  Eating it doesn't look worth it.

useall_png_only.name: burdock
useall_png_only.description: Burdock, a bitter thistle-like vegetable.  Can be eaten raw or cooked.

useall_png_only.name: dandelion
useall_png_only.description: A handful of freshly-picked yellow dandelions.  In their current raw state they are quite bitter.

useall_png_only.name: raw pelt
useall_png_only.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing animal.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

useall_png_only.name: raw hide
useall_png_only.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from an animal.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

useall_png_only.name: razor blade
useall_png_only.description: A double-edged razor blade.

useall_png_only.name: taped razorblade
useall_png_only.description: A double-edged razor blade with one side taped to allow its use as a basic tool.

useall_png_only.name: shaving razor
useall_png_only.description: A razor blade on a comfortable handle.  Much easier to shave with than a loose razor.

useall_png_only.name: razorclaw roe
useall_png_only.description: A clump of razorclaw eggs.  A post-Cataclysm delicacy.

useall_png_only.name: radio car box
useall_png_only.description: A small box with an image of a toy car printed on the front.  The text written on the side says it comes with a remote control and batteries included.

useall_png_only.name: 5.56x45mm bullpup rifle
useall_png_only.description: This is a semi-automatic bullpup rifle with a lightened body due to the use of polymers and aluminum, using standard magazines of the AR-15 platform and a 5.56x45mm NATO cartridge.

useall_png_only.name: reading light (off)
useall_png_only.description: A little clip-on LED light, meant for reading books in the dark.

useall_png_only.name: reading light (on)
useall_png_only.description: A little clip-on LED light, meant for reading books in the dark.  This one is turned on.

useall_png_only.name: rebreather oxygen regenerator cartridge
useall_png_only.description: A replaceable oxygen regenerator cartridge for a rebreather.

useall_png_only.name: signal receiver
useall_png_only.description: A module designed to receive many forms of signals.  Useful for crafting communications equipment.

useall_png_only.name: recharging station
useall_png_only.description: A universal recharging station designed to operate on vehicle power.  While on, it will steadily charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.  The system can only be installed onto existing storage compartments, and is controlled from a dashboard or electronics control unit.

useall_png_only.name: reciprocating saw
useall_png_only.description: A battery-powered tool, commonly known by the generic trademark Sawzall, that uses an electric motor to push a straight sawblade back and forth to rapidly cut wood or metal.  It is useful for heavy demolition and construction work, but poorly suited to precision tasks.

useall_png_only.name: salvaged RMES marksman laser
useall_png_only.description: Formerly belonging to an RMES mech-suit, this powerful long-range laser rifle was never designed for human hands.  You might be able to make it work if you deployed it or mounted it to a vehicle, though, and its long range and potency could be pretty handy if you can keep it powered.

useall_png_only.name: modern recurve bow
useall_png_only.description: A modern fiberglass bow that can be used effectively by those of somewhat above-average strength.

useall_png_only.name: red dot sight
useall_png_only.description: A red dot optic meant to be attached to the top of the weapon, replacing the iron sights.  Increases accuracy and weight.

useall_png_only.name: red pen
useall_png_only.description: A disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Has the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This one is red.

useall_png_only.name: red phosphorous powder
useall_png_only.description: An allotrope of the element phosphorous.  It's what you use to light matches, but can also be used in the synthesis of methamphetamine.  You could use it to make bombs, and if you were truly desperate you might even be able to use it in small portions as a propellant for bullets.

useall_png_only.name: exodii naval rifle
useall_png_only.description: Originally designed for naval defense of a small island country, this gun served Exodii as long as they existed, being one of its reliable tools in later stages of world decay.  Cheap ammunition, a simple mechanism, and immense power output would make it a great weapon for any survivor who is able to carry nearly a hundred kilo of its weight and is in need to penetrate a small bunker.  Unless your body is compatible with Exodii Standard Combat Bodyframe, you can only use it with a heavy-duty tripod, and only while prone.  Due to the size of a top-mounted magazine, the user needs to use a scope mounted on the side of a gun.

useall_png_only.name: matchbox
useall_png_only.description: A small box of matches with a coarse strike surface on the side for lighting them.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.

useall_png_only.name: composite bow (light)
useall_png_only.description: A traditionally-constructed bow made from wood, horn and sinew.  It has a moderate draw weight.

useall_png_only.name: Olympic style target bow
useall_png_only.description: A highly refined, modern bow, but not all that useful, as the draw weight is very low.

useall_png_only.name: pane of reinforced glass
useall_png_only.description: A small pane of bulletproof glass, it looks to be a little over two inches thick.

useall_png_only.name: sheet of reinforced glass
useall_png_only.description: A large sheet of bulletproof glass, it looks to a little over two inches thick.

useall_png_only.name: bolt-action hunting rifle
useall_png_only.description: Featuring a handsome set of wooden furnishings, a classic design, and a no nonsense .270 caliber chambering, this is a powerful hunting rifle.  With a tried and proven pedigree dating back over 60 years, millions of such rugged arms have been made, exported, and used throughout the United States and the world at large.  Where hunting is concerned, this is a highly capable and well proven weapon in all respects.  Fortunate, given that your prey in these dark days may turn out to be a little bit more feisty than typical White-Tailed deer, moose, and black bears.

useall_png_only.name: Remington 700 .30-06 rifle
useall_png_only.description: A very popular and durable hunting or sniping rifle.  Popular among SWAT and US Marine snipers.  Highly damaging, but perhaps not as accurate as the competing Browning BLR.

useall_png_only.name: hunting rifle
useall_png_only.description: A very accurate rifle chambered for the powerful .308 round.

useall_png_only.name: 5-round hunting shotgun
useall_png_only.description: A classic shotgun in nearly every respect; big, bulky, and intimidating, guns such as this one have been made for over a century in one form or another, coming in both pump-action and semi-automatic models.  Serving both competition-shooting, law-enforcement, and hunting roles, this firearm is sporting a standard-capacity 5-round magazine tube.  Despite the firearm's low magazine space, what it lacks in capacity it makes up for in sheer close-range effectiveness and stopping power.

useall_png_only.name: 7-round riot shotgun
useall_png_only.description: A brother of more typical hunting style shotguns, this particular model was most often seen utilized for self-defense or law-enforcement purposes.  Featuring a shortened 18.5 inch barrel and extended 7-round magazine tube, it's a very versatile and reliable weapon.

useall_png_only.name: repeating crossbow
useall_png_only.description: A custom-made crossbow with a clever mechanism that loads and fires bolts in a single motion.  It has a wooden magazine that holds up to 10 bolts.

useall_png_only.name: revolving shotgun
useall_png_only.description: A shotgun modified to use a revolver cylinder mechanism, it can hold 6 cartridges.

useall_png_only.name: 7.62x51mm bullpup rifle
useall_png_only.description: This is a semi-automatic bullpup rifle with a lightened body due to the use of polymers and aluminum, using standard magazines of the heavy automatic rifle and a 7.62x51mm cartridge.

useall_png_only.name: cooked rice
useall_png_only.description: A hearty serving of cooked long-grain white rice.

useall_png_only.name: .45 Colt/410 pipe rifle
useall_png_only.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

useall_png_only.name: rifle case
useall_png_only.description: A long soft rifle case.  Provides storage for long arms and rifles.  Includes a small pocket, strap and handle.

useall_png_only.name: double rifle case
useall_png_only.description: A long soft rifle case.  Provides storage for 2 long arms and rifles.  Includes 3 accessory pockets and a strap.

useall_png_only.name: leather double rifle case
useall_png_only.description: A long soft leather rifle case.  Provides storage for 2 long arms and rifles.  Includes 3 accessory pockets and a strap.

useall_png_only.name: flintlock musket
useall_png_only.description: For once, something *good* came back from the dead.  This ancient design lacks the fire-rate of modern weapons, but packs as much punch as the best of 'em and rewards the skilled shooter with easily-crafted ammunition.

useall_png_only.name: engagement ring
useall_png_only.description: This ring is an intricate gold band with a small cluster of diamonds set in the center.  Before the world broke down, this ring would've cost a small fortune.

useall_png_only.name: small game lever-action rifle
useall_png_only.description: A .22 Long Rifle lever-action rifle, which holds 15 rounds of ammo.  While quite useful against small game, its effectiveness isn't as great against the undead.

useall_png_only.name: caseless automagnum
useall_png_only.description: Designed for style rather than practicality, the Rivtech RM103A is an impressive-looking pistol with less-than-impressive results.  Too short to properly utilize Rivtech's proprietary 8mm caseless ammunition, this status symbol is still a capable sidearm.  Accepts stick magazines.

useall_png_only.name: caseless scout rifle
useall_png_only.description: Intended to function as a long-range sharpshooter support weapon for the military, the Rivtech RM11B scout rifle was designed for durability and accuracy under less than ideal circumstances.  Its bullpup layout, digital scope, and two round burst mode allow it to deliver precise long-range takedowns, utilizing the proprietary Rivtech 8mm caseless round.  Accepts stick magazines.

useall_png_only.name: caseless hunting shotgun
useall_png_only.description: Designed by Rivtech and utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, this caseless pump-action shotgun was designed for hunting big game, with durability and ease of use as priorities.

useall_png_only.name: RM13 combat armor
useall_png_only.description: A full-body suit of sleek black military armor representing the pinnacle of powered armor technology.  A battery pack is slotted into the lower back, while the upper back houses connections for the built-in rebreather system.  Use it to turn it on.

useall_png_only.name: RM13 battery pack
useall_png_only.description: A simple, heavy, black battery pack labeled "RM13".

useall_png_only.name: RM20 caseless autoshotgun
useall_png_only.description: Designed by Rivtech and utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, this caseless automatic combat shotgun was designed with durability and overwhelming power in mind.

useall_png_only.name: compact caseless shotgun
useall_png_only.description: Designed by Rivtech and designated the RM228 PDW, chambering the powerful 20x66mm caseless shotgun cartridge, this gun was designed for the civilian personal defense market with durability and ease of use as priorities.  While lauded for its small size and light weight, its hefty price tag kept it out of the reach of casual collectors.

useall_png_only.name: DARPA flamethrower
useall_png_only.description: A modernized flamethrower, using alloy components and composite pressure tanks.  Despite having been replaced by the M202 FLASH, due to the questionable effectiveness of the flamethrower in modern combat, it appears that someone, somewhere, needed a flamethrower for the modern age, as the date code on many of the components is within the past five years.  While this resembles the Vietnam War era M9-7, the wand ignition system has been improved with a piezoelectric one, in addition to the material improvements of the system overall.

useall_png_only.name: caseless assault rifle
useall_png_only.description: Originally produced for military use, the Rivtech RM51 assault rifle was designed for durability and ease of use under less than ideal circumstances, with its considerable bulk minimized by a compact and ergonomic layout.  Accepts box magazines.

useall_png_only.name: caseless LMG
useall_png_only.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM614 light machine gun was designed for durability and extreme volume of sustained fire under the worst possible circumstances.  Accepts RMXB500 box and RMGD250 drum magazines.

useall_png_only.name: caseless battle rifle
useall_png_only.description: Originally produced for military use, the Rivtech RM88 battle rifle was designed for durability and extreme firepower under less than ideal circumstances, with a heavy ported barrel for maximum controllability.  Accepts box and RMGD250 drum magazines.

useall_png_only.name: Hub 01 prototype greaves (pair)
useall_png_only.description: 3D printed leg guards, consisting of thick knee pads and a pair of large, flexible polymer plates for securing around the calves to protect the tibias of each leg.  Two straps on each plate can be tightened or loosened to fit different leg sizes.  Despite the rough finish, it doesn't impede your movement, and fits comfortably against your body.

useall_png_only.name: Hub 01 prototype vambraces (pair)
useall_png_only.description: 3D printed arm guards, made of large and flexible polymer sheets wrapped around the forearm.  The end of each sheet features a clip and drawstring, to fit the armor to any size.  Despite the rough finish, it fits securely, and feels quite comfortable.

useall_png_only.name: Hub 01 environmental suit
useall_png_only.description: A lightweight environmental suit incorporating Kevlar-lined boots and gloves, worn by Hub personnel in their rare forays aboveground.  Colored brown and blue, the white seal of Hub 01 is embroidered on both of its upper arms.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.

useall_png_only.name: Hub 01 environmental suit (casual)
useall_png_only.description: A lightweight environmental suit incorporating Kevlar-lined boots, worn by Hub personnel in their rare forays aboveground.  Colored brown and blue, the upper portion has been tied around the waist casually.

useall_png_only.name: Hub 01 FSP
useall_png_only.description: The Hub 01 Fire Support Platform, or just the FSP.  Like the Hybrid Weapons Platform, it combines black-finished aluminum, blue polymer furniture, and a number of proprietary bolts and fasteners for a sci-fi aesthetic.  The barrel is stamped with "40x46mm LV", and the magwell looks like it accepts some truly MASSIVE magazines, which the gun appears to be capable of emptying in semi-automatic or fully-automatic fashion.

useall_png_only.name: Hub 01 ballistic greaves (pair)
useall_png_only.description: 3D printed leg guards, consisting of thick knee pads and a pair of large, flexible polymer plates for securing around the calves to protect the tibias of each leg. useall_png_only.name: Hub 01 ballistic vambraces (pair)
useall_png_only.description: 3D printed arm guards, made of large and flexible polymer sheets wrapped around the forearm.  These ones include aramid arm sleeves that do a great job of slowing down bullets and preventing them from shredding your arms.

useall_png_only.name: Hub 01 soldier greaves (pair)

useall_png_only.name: Hub 01 soldier vambraces (pair)
useall_png_only.description: 3D printed arm guards, sporting a professional finish and stellar ergonomics.  With thick bullet-resistant arm sleeves, flexible but extremely tough thermoplastic plates, and special attention given to areas reflexively used to protect the face from attacks, it provides first-rate protection against all the horrors that the apocalypse has brought to bear.

useall_png_only.name: Hub 01 turnout greaves (pair)

useall_png_only.name: Hub 01 turnout vambraces (pair)

useall_png_only.name: varmint rifle
useall_png_only.description: A lightweight and modular pistol caliber hunting carbine, firing the low power .22 LR cartridge.  Before the Cataclysm, a mix of high customizability, cheap ammunition, and low recoil made this a very popular rifle among civilian shooters.

useall_png_only.name: full-auto varmint rifle
useall_png_only.description: A handy and lightweight rifle, modified to fire semi and full auto.

useall_png_only.name: Ruger-57 handgun
useall_png_only.description: Produced by the Ruger gun company, this full-sized pistol makes use of the 5.7x28mm cartridge.  One of the first pistols to both make use of the unusual round and achieve market success within the civilian world, it opened the door for accessible 5.7mm shooting due to its low price and reliable design.

useall_png_only.name: Ruger American Ranch Rifle
useall_png_only.description: A compact, magazine-fed, bolt-action hunting rifle designed and manufactured with cost-effectiveness at the peak of concerns, the Ruger American Ranch Rifle series caters to shooters on a budget.  Factory chambered for the powerful, though short-range, .450 Bushmaster cartridge, the weapon was able to stand toe-to-toe with all native North American game despite its minimalist design.

useall_png_only.name: .22 caliber revolver
useall_png_only.description: A comparatively dainty revolver, chambered for 8 tiny rounds of .22 LR.

useall_png_only.name: conceal-carry five-shooter
useall_png_only.description: A compact, double-action-only revolver designed for easy concealment, with a stainless steel cylinder and aluminum frame.

useall_png_only.name: Ruger Guide rifle
useall_png_only.description: This is a popular and sturdy long-range rifle that has been in production by the Ruger gun company for several decades.  Using a bolt-action feed system, the rifle features a four round capacity of .30-06 cartridges and has the capability to dispatch said rounds with a level of accuracy that would make comparable hunting rifles blush.

useall_png_only.name: Ruger Mini-14 carbine
useall_png_only.description: A small, lightweight semi-auto carbine designed for civilian and police use.  Its superb accuracy and low recoil makes it more suitable than full-auto rifles for some situations.

useall_png_only.name: Ruger target pistol
useall_png_only.description: A light and handy .22 LR handgun from Ruger, this handgun is one of the most popular .22 handguns ever created.

useall_png_only.name: Ruger Precision Rifle
useall_png_only.description: Originally introduced to the Ruger gun corporation's family of high-end marksman rifles in 2015, the Ruger Precision Rifle is a modern and highly modular long-range bolt-action weapon.  By incorporating a unique in-line recoil path that manages recoil from the rear of the receiver to the buttstock, as opposed to traditional bedding, the rifle offers maximal accuracy potential, while the arm's additional bells and whistles, an incorporated marksman's trigger, muzzle brake, and this particular rifle's powerhouse chambering of .300 Win Mag, help to make the most from any long-range engagement.

useall_png_only.name: Ruger LCP pistol
useall_png_only.description: One of the best-selling modern day 'pocket pistols', the LCP is an affordable, polymer framed pistol chambered in .380 ACP.  Despite the round's relatively low power, the pistol's low weight and short sight radius make for moderately poor handling.

useall_png_only.name: Glock carbine

useall_png_only.name: RX12 jet injector
useall_png_only.description: A Rivtech RX12 jet injector, a small pistol-shaped device used to inject advanced fast-healing chemicals through the skin without using a needle.  A label on the side warns against using more than two doses per hour.

useall_png_only.name: sheet metal sabatons (pair)

useall_png_only.name: Saiga-410
useall_png_only.description: The Saiga-410 is a semi-automatic shotgun designed on the same Kalashnikov pattern as the AK-47 rifle.  It reloads with a magazine, rather than one shell at a time like most shotguns.

useall_png_only.name: Exodii Sapra grenade launcher
useall_png_only.description: The Sapra '36 is a short smoothbore bolt-action grenade launcher, fitted with a 5-round box magazine and a large, efficient muzzle brake.  Designed in the interwar period following the proliferation of Brogyeki '23, the Sapra was intended to assist in riots, ambushes and assaulting in urban operations, where explosives applied in quick succession could make short work of targets.  To further assist in riot operations, the Sapra can be fitted with a bayonet, a frivolity that the Exodii almost immediately discarded.  Unlike the Brogyeki, the Sapra is incapable of chambering the longer 27.3x110 Diyua shells.  The Exodii have replaced the stock with an aluminum alloy chassis, leaving behind the original wood ones as they became damaged.

useall_png_only.name: smoked sausage
useall_png_only.description: A hefty sausage that has been cured and smoked for long term storage.

useall_png_only.name: cooked sausage

useall_png_only.name: single-shot target rifle
useall_png_only.description: A bolt-action precision rifle with the potential for impressive accuracy, this particular weapon makes use of the powerful .338 Lapua cartridge and is decked in a handsome set of wooden furniture, providing the rifle with a classical mystique.  Unfortunately, the weapon's single-round magazine and a lack of factory iron sights, which makes target acquisition an exercise in futility unless a gunsight is installed, make the rifle limited in its post-Cataclysm utility.

useall_png_only.name: small game single shot rifle
useall_png_only.description: A .22 Long Rifle rifle that chambers just one shot.  Its main use is for the youth, and not much else.  God help you if you hope to use this thing to a meaningful effect.

useall_png_only.name: bronze wood saw
useall_png_only.description: A simple wood saw made of bronze.  Not as great as its steel equivalent, but it's good enough.

useall_png_only.name: saxophone

useall_png_only.name: civilian FN SCAR-H rifle
useall_png_only.description: A highly accurate and modular battle rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  This one is a civilian model, limited to semi-auto.

useall_png_only.name: FN SCAR-H rifle
useall_png_only.description: A highly accurate and modular battle rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  The 'H' in its name stands for heavy, as it uses the powerful .308 round.

useall_png_only.name: FN SCAR-H sniper rifle
useall_png_only.description: Sniper Support Rifle, this semi-auto variant of SCAR-H is designed for a long-range precision application, to be used by dedicated marksman.  Includes extended barrel, bipod, and a few additional attachment for greater comfort of a user.

useall_png_only.name: FN SCAR-L
useall_png_only.description: A highly accurate and modular assault rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  The 'L' in its name stands for light, as it uses the lightweight 5.56 NATO round.

useall_png_only.description: A pair of short scissors designed with kids in mind.  You can use them to cut things such as fabric or plastic apart, although they are probably subpar compared to other alternatives.

useall_png_only.name: medical scissors
useall_png_only.description: A pair of medical scissors, typically used by nurses or paramedics to cut bandages or fabric.

useall_png_only.name: wavy scissors
useall_png_only.description: A pair of wavy artistic scissors.  You can theoretically use them to cut things but you should probably not get your hopes too high.

useall_png_only.description: A colorfully-printed score card.

useall_png_only.name: scrambler grenade

useall_png_only.name: felt scraps
useall_png_only.description: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of felt, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of, but they can be recycled into some wool fiber if you really want.

useall_png_only.name: mesh screen
useall_png_only.description: A roll of fine mesh screen for bug barriers on porches.

useall_png_only.name: diving cylinder (open)
useall_png_only.description: A high-pressure 232 bar diving tank that can contain up to 12 L of a compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  It is currently open.  Activate it to close it.

useall_png_only.name: war scythe
useall_png_only.description: A pole weapon with a curving single-edged blade.  Its blade bears some superficial resemblance to that of an agricultural scythe from which it likely evolved.

useall_png_only.name: Italian seasoning

useall_png_only.name: survival bow

useall_png_only.name: shark plushie
useall_png_only.description: A somewhat large, mass produced shark plushie.  Meant to provide comfort to people of all ages.

useall_png_only.name: breech-loading reproduction rifle

useall_png_only.name: shears

useall_png_only.name: sheath

useall_png_only.name: set of ring stand clamps
useall_png_only.description: A small box with a jumbled assortment of clamps for mounting on ring stands.  There seems to be some sort of rule that all of them are missing at least one wing nut for tightening; twist ties, duct tape, and other random stuff has been used to compensate.

useall_png_only.name: stapler
useall_png_only.description: A desk tool for fastening sheets of paper together.

useall_png_only.name: steel plate
useall_png_only.description: A steel armor plate, specifically engineered for use in a bullet-resistant vest.

useall_png_only.name: chunk of steel
useall_png_only.description: A misshapen chunk of steel.  Makes a decent weapon in a pinch, and is also useful for some crafting recipes.

useall_png_only.name: lump of steel
useall_png_only.description: A heavy, formed piece of steel.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

useall_png_only.name: steel frying pan
useall_png_only.description: A steel frying pan.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is used for cooking.

useall_png_only.name: steel plating
useall_png_only.description: A piece of vehicle armor plating made of steel.

useall_png_only.name: stethoscope
useall_png_only.description: A medical listening tool.  Use it to listen to things.  Closely.

useall_png_only.name: stewed tripe
useall_png_only.description: Stomach lining, cut up and stewed for an hour in broth.  Better than it sounds.

useall_png_only.name: AUG assault rifle
useall_png_only.description: An assault rifle chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO and accepting AUG magazines

useall_png_only.name: scout rifle
useall_png_only.description: This is a versatile, all-purpose hunting rifle.  To this end, it is exceedingly lightweight, contains an inbuilt polymer bipod, and fits a spare magazine inside the stock for fast reloading.  While these features made for a hunting rifle too universal for widespread adoption, they might yet fulfill a vital scouting niche for survivors in the post-Cataclysm world.

useall_png_only.name: STEM kit box
useall_png_only.description: A small box with an image of children building things.

useall_png_only.name: stock pot
useall_png_only.description: A large pot with 20 gauge walls and a thick aluminum bottom, used for making soup stocks.  You could fit a whole turkey in there, with a bit of shoving.

useall_png_only.name: stockings (pair)
useall_png_only.description: Long cotton socks that reach above the knees to help protect from the cold.

useall_png_only.name: tentacle sleeves (pair)
useall_png_only.description: Long cotton tubes sized to fit over tentacles and help protect them from the cold.

useall_png_only.name: tentacle stockings (pair)
useall_png_only.description: Six long cotton tubes sized to fit over tentacles and help protect them from the cold.

useall_png_only.name: pot great helm
useall_png_only.description: An enclosed helmet made from a stock pot with a 'T' crudely carved into the front and a blanket stuffed inside to cushion it.  There are strings tied to the handles to help fasten it to your body, but it's extremely limiting and smothering.

useall_png_only.name: stomach
useall_png_only.description: The stomach of a woodland creature.  It is surprisingly durable.

useall_png_only.name: large boiled stomach
useall_png_only.description: A boiled stomach from an animal, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

useall_png_only.name: large stomach
useall_png_only.description: The stomach of a large woodland creature.  It is surprisingly durable.

useall_png_only.name: stone chisel
useall_png_only.description: A short, primitive chisel made from hard stone, usually used for primitive woodworking.

useall_png_only.name: stone chopper
useall_png_only.description: A rock with sharpened edges, produced by knapping.  Works as a crude cutting and butchering tool, if nothing else is available.

useall_png_only.name: stone pouch
useall_png_only.description: A medium-sized pouch for storing rocks, with straps for attaching it to your belt or other webbing.

useall_png_only.name: straw doll
useall_png_only.description: An old straw doll, made to look like a woman in a dress.

useall_png_only.name: straw fedora
useall_png_only.description: A straw fedora hat, comfortable and stylish.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.

useall_png_only.name: straw hat
useall_png_only.description: A hat woven out of straw.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.

useall_png_only.name: pile of straw
useall_png_only.description: A pile of dry grass.  Can be used to craft a straw bed if there is nothing else to sleep on.

useall_png_only.name: straw sandals (pair)
useall_png_only.description: Sandals made from straw rope.  Not very comfortable, but can keep your feet safe.

useall_png_only.name: zarad chainmail suit
useall_png_only.description: A fully customized chainmail suit.  Unlike your native Earth's steel chainmail, these oval links are much thinner and noticeably denser, giving this suit a ceremonial or decorative quality.

useall_png_only.name: lamba khud helm
useall_png_only.description: An unusual-looking conical helm.  The perfectly smooth steel cap covers the top of the head and the ears, forming a tall cone with a spike at the top.  Chainmail covers the rest of the head, leaving only the face open.  It is padded with a modern synthetic fabric.

useall_png_only.name: do-āyneh cuirass
useall_png_only.description: Somewhat resembling your Earth's mirror armor, this otherworldly cuirass is made up of two round metal plates on the chest and back, lashed together by steel chains around the torso and shoulder.  It covers less than Earth's ancient cuirass, but is notably thicker.

useall_png_only.name: dental floss
useall_png_only.description: Twenty-five yards of finely waxed thread wound up inside a plastic container.  Perfect for picking bits of smoked meat out of your teeth.  Disassemble to use the thread for something else.

useall_png_only.name: striped pants
useall_png_only.description: A pair of pants with horizontal black and white stripes.

useall_png_only.name: stuffed clams
useall_png_only.description: Quahog clams stuffed with bread crumbs and fried.

useall_png_only.name: suit
useall_png_only.description: A full-body cotton suit.  Makes the apocalypse a truly gentlemanly experience.

useall_png_only.name: sunflower
useall_png_only.description: The top of a sunflower, with yellow petals and some seeds that have yet to be eaten by animals.

useall_png_only.name: suppressor
useall_png_only.description: A suppressor reduces the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels.

useall_png_only.name: crude rocket launcher
useall_png_only.description: An improvised, direct ignition launcher for home-made rockets.  Essentially, a thick-walled steel pipe, equipped with a pilot light, several batteries and a simple circuit board.  Effective only at medium range, barely.

useall_png_only.name: survival marker
useall_png_only.description: A sharpened piece of charcoal used as an improvised pencil.  Almost guaranteed to get your hands all covered in charcoal.  Activate it to write something down.

useall_png_only.name: survival match
useall_png_only.description: A solid strike anywhere match.  One and done.

useall_png_only.name: leather-padded pants
useall_png_only.description: A pair of tough canvas pants with sections from leather pants affixed, excluding the joints.  Offers mild protection without compromising mobility too much, but a lot of the pockets have been removed to make room for the leather.

useall_png_only.name: leather-padded shirt
useall_png_only.description: Armor made of combined pre-Cataclysm clothing.  Sections from leather clothing are tightened and affixed to a thick cotton shirt, excluding the joints.

useall_png_only.name: leather-padded sleeves
useall_png_only.description: Armor made of combined pre-Cataclysm clothing.  Sections from leather clothing are tightened and affixed to the sleeves of a thick cotton shirt, excluding the joints.

useall_png_only.name: leather-padded sleeveless shirt
useall_png_only.description: Armor made of combined pre-Cataclysm clothing.  Sections from leather clothing are tightened and affixed to a thick cotton shirt.  The sleeves have been cut off.

useall_png_only.name: handmade utility belt
useall_png_only.description: A custom-built leather belt covered with pouches, with a sheath to carry a smaller blade, a holster to carry a pistol and a loop for holding larger tools.  Perfect for quick access to the apocalypse essentials.

useall_png_only.name: handmade combat suit
useall_png_only.description: A form-fitting coverall jumpsuit consisting of stab-weave Kevlar and ripstop Nylon woven in layers to provide substantial protection from bites and cuts.  Has reinforced pockets sewn on for storage.  Lacking a rubber sealant, it is still reasonably breathable, and therefore offers only modest protection against chemical attacks despite its synthetic fabric construction.

useall_png_only.name: tempered steel combat machete
useall_png_only.description: This common gardening tool has been tempered to dramatically improve its performance as a weapon.

useall_png_only.name: retractable telescope
useall_png_only.description: A homemade collapsible telescope, perfect for a pirate.  Too large and inaccurate to use as a weapon scope, but carrying it in your inventory will double the distance that is mapped around you during your travels.

useall_png_only.name: survivor suit
useall_png_only.description: A hand-built combination armor made from a bulletproof vest and a reinforced leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

useall_png_only.name: handmade harness
useall_png_only.description: A custom-built light harness covered with pouches and including an integral tactical sling for a small rifle or other such weapon.  Durable and carefully crafted to be comfortable to wear.  Activate to holster/draw your weapon.

useall_png_only.name: suspenders
useall_png_only.description: A pair of black suspenders, which reach over the wearer's shoulders and hook to their waist.  Gives a wonderful western feel!

useall_png_only.name: holster suspenders
useall_png_only.description: A pair of leather suspenders with a holster placed near the stomach.

useall_png_only.name: leather suspenders
useall_png_only.description: A pair of leather suspenders, which reach over the wearer's shoulders and hook to their waist.  Gives a wonderful western feel!

useall_png_only.name: sustainment pouch
useall_png_only.description: A large, drawstring & buckle pouch originally designed to hold 3 MREs, and part of the official MOLLE II rucksack system.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt, vest, or rucksack.

useall_png_only.name: .44 revolver
useall_png_only.description: A stainless steel, six-shot, double-action revolver with a matte black plastic handle manufactured by Smith & Wesson.  Though hardly the most powerful handgun in the world anymore, it could still blow a zombie's head clean off.

useall_png_only.name: .38 conceal carry revolver
useall_png_only.description: This .38 revolver is quite small and lightweight, due to its short barrel and aluminum material.

useall_png_only.name: .500 Magnum revolver
useall_png_only.description: The definition of 'overkill', this behemoth handgun puts large .44 caliber revolvers to shame with its sheer size, power, and immense chambering.  Firing the appropriately named .500 Magnum cartridge, the most powerful handgun round in the world, the weapon has seen work in both sport shooting and hunting roles.  A pistol for those of the 'bigger is better' mentality, a high recoil junky's personal dream, and an all-around useless military sidearm, should the urge to assault the Cataclysm in fine style grip you, this giant provides you with 5 rounds with which to reduce a zombie into an afterthought.

useall_png_only.name: 10mm/.40 revolver
useall_png_only.description: A classic six-shooter revolver chambered for 10mm and .40 rounds.

useall_png_only.name: 7-shot .357 revolver
useall_png_only.description: A revolver chambered in .357, with a 6 inch barrel and 7 shots.

useall_png_only.name: swage and die set
useall_png_only.description: A set of swages and dies for metalsmithing.  These loops and metal blocks are used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

useall_png_only.name: .380 conceal carry handgun
useall_png_only.description: A very small and lightweight handgun, firing the .380 ACP cartridge.

useall_png_only.name: sweater
useall_png_only.description: A warm wool sweater.

useall_png_only.name: sweatshirt
useall_png_only.description: A thick cotton shirt.

useall_png_only.name: piece of raw sweetbread
useall_png_only.description: A piece of the thymus or pancreas of an animal.  These are a delicacy, if prepared properly.

useall_png_only.name: cooked piece of sweetbread
useall_png_only.description: Normally a delicacy, but this style of preparation is missing something.

useall_png_only.name: swim briefs
useall_png_only.description: A pair of blue swim briefs.  Commonly used by male competitive swimmers.

useall_png_only.name: swim cap
useall_png_only.description: A tightly fitted, skin-tight head garment made of Lycra.  Commonly used by recreational and competitive swimmers.

useall_png_only.name: swim fins (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of rubber flippers worn on the feet, which improve swimming speed while greatly impeding the wearer's ability to walk.

useall_png_only.name: scrap greatsword
useall_png_only.description: A large wooden sword with scrap metal hammered over it into something pretending to be an edge.  The extra weight almost completely front-loads the balance, and it hurts your wrists just to wield.

useall_png_only.name: metal fencing sword
useall_png_only.description: Calling this a rapier is a stretch.  It's robust and very pointy, but more akin to a long metal spike with a handguard than the elegant swords of the Renaissance.

useall_png_only.name: nord
useall_png_only.description: A nail sword, or nord for short.  This wooden sword has a dozen nails sticking out at jagged angles from the edge of the blade, making it much better at chopping than slashing.

useall_png_only.name: welded sword
useall_png_only.description: A vicious single-edged sword made out of sheet metal layered twice over itself then welded together.  It's not as robust as a proper forged sword, but the edge is wickedly sharp.

useall_png_only.name: zweitimber
useall_png_only.description: A plank with a handle and a whittled-down point, left large enough to require two hands.  Still not much good for slashing, but far better than the plank on its own.

useall_png_only.name: tabi (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of split toe black tabi socks.  Usually worn as a part of traditional Japanese clothing.  The big toe is separated from the others by the fabric to be comfortably worn with thonged footwear.

useall_png_only.name: gi tabi (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of split toe white tabi socks, as used by martial arts practitioners.  Usually worn as a part of traditional Japanese clothing.  The big toe is separated from the others by the fabric to be comfortably worn with thonged footwear.

useall_png_only.name: AI bolt-action sniper rifle
useall_png_only.description: A high-precision bolt-action sniper rifle, in service with special operations members of the US Navy prior to the Cataclysm.  Firing the powerful .338 Lapua cartridge, the weapon feeds from detachable five round Accuracy International magazines.

useall_png_only.name: bolt-action anti-materiel rifle
useall_png_only.description: Serving both anti-materiel and high-priority sniping roles in their service with various militaries, bolt-action rifles, such as this one, were known for their long ranges of engagement, recoil, and armor-defeating ordinance.  Essentially a step below light cannonry, as far as shoulder-arms are concerned, this weapon's mix of power and accuracy meet hands to ensure that, before the Cataclysm, one shot was synonymous with one very, very dead target.

useall_png_only.name: tactical jacket
useall_png_only.description: A hefty camouflage jacket rattling with a spade of zippers, press-studs, and attachment points, featuring a high mandarin collar, Velcro cuffs, plates for ID tags, and enough pockets to make your internal Militiaman weep for joy.

useall_png_only.name: taco
useall_png_only.description: A traditional Mexican dish composed of a corn tortilla folded or rolled around a meat filling.

useall_png_only.name: tactical grenade pouch
useall_png_only.description: A pouch designed to hold one military grenade, keeping it both accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.

useall_png_only.name: tactical holster
useall_png_only.description: A sturdy holster designed to be worn vertically, to keep a small profile on a tactical vest.  This makes it a little more awkward to draw from than a normal holster.

useall_png_only.name: tactical shotshell pouch
useall_png_only.description: A pouch designed to hold shotgun shells or .308 rounds, keeping them accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.

useall_png_only.name: tac vest
useall_png_only.description: This light vest is meant to carry your magazines, shells and pistols.  They are popular among law enforcement, but less so than combination tactical vests incorporating Kevlar.

useall_png_only.name: portion of tainted bone marrow
useall_png_only.description: A wet, green chunk of spongy goop extracted from a rotten bone.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.

useall_png_only.name: takedown recurve bow
useall_png_only.description: A modern fiberglass bow that can be taken down for storage.  For use by those of somewhat above-average strength.  Use it to disassemble it for storage.

useall_png_only.name: takedown recurve bow (folded)
useall_png_only.description: A modern fiberglass bow that has been taken down for storage.  For use by those of somewhat above-average strength.  Use it to assemble it into shape.

useall_png_only.name: tallit katan
useall_png_only.description: A shirt with four tassels worn by observant Jews in deference to Deuteronomy 22:12, which commands the wearing of fringes on the corner of one's garments.

useall_png_only.name: tallow
useall_png_only.description: A smooth, white block of cleaned and rendered animal fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

useall_png_only.name: tampon
useall_png_only.description: A small cotton tampon with a plastic applicator.

useall_png_only.name: piece of tanbark
useall_png_only.description: A sheet of tannin-rich bark from a tree, useful for tanning leather.

useall_png_only.name: tank top
useall_png_only.description: A sleeveless cotton shirt.  Very easy to move in.

useall_png_only.name: tanned hide
useall_png_only.description: A folded 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of leather made from carefully tanned animal hide.  Can be cut up or used as is.

useall_png_only.name: tanned pelt
useall_png_only.description: A folded sheet of fur made from carefully tanned animal pelt.  Can be cut up or used as is.

useall_png_only.name: tanning leather hide (obsolete)
useall_png_only.description: A treated animal hide that is undergoing the chemical processes required to become leather.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

useall_png_only.name: tanning fur pelt (obsolete)
useall_png_only.description: A treated animal pelt that is undergoing the chemical processes required to become fur.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

useall_png_only.name: tattered garments
useall_png_only.description: Time and the elements have reduced them to a mound of filthy ribbons.

useall_png_only.name: .45/.410 shotshell revolver
useall_png_only.description: A stainless steel 5 shot revolver, capable of firing .410 shells or 45 Colt cartridges.

useall_png_only.name: auto-loading bullpup shotgun
useall_png_only.description: Looking more like some form of sci-fi prop gun than an actual firearm, this weapon uses a system of three different magazines to field 15 12-gauge shotgun shells within a comparatively compact design.  As the weapon's trigger assembly is situated forwards of the chamber and magazines in what is termed as a 'bullpup' design, the firearm's notably more compact than its peers despite having a higher capacity when compared against more classically designed shotguns.

useall_png_only.name: stun gun
useall_png_only.description: A high-powered stun gun.  Use this item to attempt to electrocute an adjacent enemy, temporarily paralyzing them.

useall_png_only.name: green tea leaves
useall_png_only.description: Dried leaves of a tropical plant.  You can boil them into green tea, or you can just eat them raw.  They're pretty gross and not too filling that way, though.

useall_png_only.name: black tea leaves
useall_png_only.description: Dried leaves of a tropical plant.  You can boil them into tea, or you can just eat them raw.  They're pretty gross and not too filling that way, though.

useall_png_only.name: work coveralls
useall_png_only.description: A fully covering jumpsuit made of waterproof canvas.  Offers solid protection from everyday dangers on the job and plenty of storage pockets.

useall_png_only.name: heavy work coveralls
useall_png_only.description: A thick, fully covering jumpsuit made of waterproof canvas lined with extra fabric for warmth in brisk weather.  Offers solid protection from everyday dangers on the job and plenty of storage pockets.

useall_png_only.name: work pants
useall_png_only.description: A pair of gray canvas work pants.

useall_png_only.name: work t-shirt
useall_png_only.description: A gray work t-shirt with a small front pocket.

useall_png_only.name: teleport pad
useall_png_only.description: A kit for a teleporter trap, consisting of a teleporter and a solar cell that is triggered when stepped upon.

useall_png_only.name: telescoping umbrella (collapsed)
useall_png_only.description: A telescoping umbrella which has been collapsed down for easy storage.  May be used to keep dry when extended and wielded.

useall_png_only.name: telescoping umbrella (extended)
useall_png_only.description: A telescoping umbrella currently in its extended form, useful for keeping dry when wielded.  May be collapsed down for easy storage.

useall_png_only.name: tent
useall_png_only.description: A small personal tent in a storage bag.  It's just big enough to fit one person comfortably.

useall_png_only.name: glass terrarium
useall_png_only.description: A glass container meant to hold plants and/or insects.  They come in a variety of sizes.

useall_png_only.name: thermal electric balaclava
useall_png_only.description: A snug cloth mask with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

useall_png_only.name: thermal electric socks (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of socks with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

useall_png_only.name: thermal electric suit
useall_png_only.description: A full-body suit of thin thermal underwear equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

useall_png_only.name: thigh-high boots (pair)
useall_png_only.description: Very long leather boots that reach past the knees, they are cumbersome to wear.

useall_png_only.name: throwing axe
useall_png_only.description: A lightweight hatchet made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and light weight make it unsuitable for use as a tool.

useall_png_only.name: throwing knife
useall_png_only.description: A thin, flat knife made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.

useall_png_only.name: throwing stick
useall_png_only.description: A stick carved into a shape suitable for throwing at a target.  It's not a boomerang, so don't expect it to return to your hand.

useall_png_only.name: bow tie
useall_png_only.description: A simple black bow tie.  Best worn with a suit.

useall_png_only.name: clip-on tie
useall_png_only.description: A clip-on necktie with blue and silver stripes.  It's quick and easy to put on, and really, who's going to know the difference?

useall_png_only.name: tights
useall_png_only.description: A snug cloth garment which clings tightly to the legs and feet to protect them from the cold.

useall_png_only.name: tin snips
useall_png_only.description: A pair of tin snips, resembling a sturdy pair of scissors with beefy blades designed to cut through thin sheets of soft metal.  These cannot cut through thick metals like a hacksaw can, but are better suited to precision work and leave a cleaner edge.

useall_png_only.name: tinder
useall_png_only.description: Flammable material, finely divided for easy combustion.

useall_png_only.name: ember carrier
useall_png_only.description: A small container for holding tinder, with holes punched in it to provide a controlled airflow.  It can nurture a smoldering ember for a long time, to start fires without modern tools.

useall_png_only.name: tinfoil hat
useall_png_only.description: A sheet of aluminum foil that has been molded into a form-fitting hat.  Perfect for protecting yourself from the government, Illuminati, aliens, and THEM.

useall_png_only.name: tiny welding tank
useall_png_only.description: A tiny acetylene tank.  It can pressurize up to 1 liter of welding gas.

useall_png_only.name: 27" bicycle tire
useall_png_only.description: A bicycle tire for fitting to a bicycle rim.

useall_png_only.name: 27" off-road bicycle tire
useall_png_only.description: A wide, studded bicycle tire intended to be fitted to a bicycle rim for off-road biking.

useall_png_only.name: 17" car tire
useall_png_only.description: A standard 17" car tire for fitting to a medium steel rim.

useall_png_only.name: 16" racing tire
useall_png_only.description: A slick 16" racing car tire for fitting to a medium steel rim.

useall_png_only.name: 16" motorbike tire
useall_png_only.description: A 16" motorbike tire for fitting to a steel motorbike rim.

useall_png_only.name: 20" off-road motorbike tire
useall_png_only.description: A 20" off-road motorbike tire for fitting to a steel motorbike rim.

useall_png_only.name: 24" wide tire
useall_png_only.description: A wide tire for fitting to a wide steel rim.

useall_png_only.name: 24" off-road wide tire
useall_png_only.description: A wide tire for fitting to a wide steel rim.  It's studded to provide better grip off-road at the cost of some performance on pavement.

useall_png_only.name: toaster
useall_png_only.description: A small two-slice toaster, can be used to toast toast and few other things.

useall_png_only.name: toasted pastry
useall_png_only.description: A toaster pastry that has been toasted, delicious!

useall_png_only.name: toilet paper
useall_png_only.description: A luxurious remnant of civilization.

useall_png_only.name: Tokarev handgun
useall_png_only.description: A symbol of Soviet pride and favored sidearm of Red Army officers, this is a compact pistol firing the punchy 7.62x25mm cartridge.  featuring an uncomfortable grip angle reminiscent of brandishing an unusually irate capital L at one's opponents, it is nevertheless a commendably accurate and durable handgun.

useall_png_only.name: tomato
useall_png_only.description: A juicy red tomato.  It gained popularity in Italy after being brought back from the New World.

useall_png_only.name: tonfa
useall_png_only.description: A hard plastic truncheon commonly employed by police.  Originally an Okinawan weapon, it consists of a stick with a perpendicular handle attached a third of the way down its length.

useall_png_only.name: wooden tonfa
useall_png_only.description: A stout wooden truncheon of the sort commonly employed by police.  Originally an Okinawan weapon, it consists of a stick with a perpendicular handle attached a third of the way down its length.

useall_png_only.name: kitchen tongs
useall_png_only.description: A pair of long, metal tongs.  They are commonly used for cooking.

useall_png_only.name: tool belt
useall_png_only.description: A common belt with pockets, loops and sheaths to store up to seven tools or blades.  Widely used by handymen and electricians.

useall_png_only.name: tactical tool pouch
useall_png_only.description: A low profile pouch designed to keep your tools accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a vest or can be strapped directly to your chest.

useall_png_only.name: electric toothbrush
useall_png_only.description: A plastic electric toothbrush.

useall_png_only.name: top hat
useall_png_only.description: The only hat for a gentleman.  Look exquisite while laughing in the face of danger!

useall_png_only.name: torch
useall_png_only.description: A large stick wrapped in rags that are soaked with flammable material.  When lit, it produces a fair amount of light.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

useall_png_only.name: burnt out torch

useall_png_only.name: tree spile
useall_png_only.description: A hollow metal cylinder which is inserted in a tree crust in order to slowly harvest its sap.  Can be used on a maple tree between late winter and early spring to harvest maple sap.

useall_png_only.name: trenchcoat

useall_png_only.name: steampunk trenchcoat

useall_png_only.name: tricorne
useall_png_only.description: A classic design, the "tricorne", or three-cornered hat, simply pins a large and floppy brim out of the way, though this example adds well-embroidered designs and is oiled against water.  Whether you're the "guvnah" of a settlement, or the captain of a post-apocalyptic crew, this is the hat for you.

useall_png_only.name: sac of triffid fungicide
useall_png_only.description: A triffid sac filled with what appears to be a triffid-produced antifungal agent.  It will likely already work as an antifungal compound for more offensive applications, but requires further refining before it can be used as a medical drug.

useall_png_only.name: hedge trimmer (off)
useall_png_only.description: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  A long line of sharp-edged teeth extends from the engine; turning the trimmer on will make them rapidly vibrate.  The poor man's chainsaw as far as the zombies are concerned.

useall_png_only.name: hedge trimmer (on)
useall_png_only.description: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  It is currently on, ready to do some zombie topiary; use this item to turn it off.

useall_png_only.description: A length of thin string with some affixing tools on either end.  It must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage to function.  Its purpose is to trip up trespassers, causing them to stumble and possibly hurt themselves slightly.

Powerful, dependable, and elegantly built, Japan's 20th-century infantry rifle may yet find service guarding the lives of her former enemies.

useall_png_only.name: 7.7mm sniper rifle
useall_png_only.description: A precision weapon issued to Japanese forces part way through the Second World War and proving to be little more than an off-the-rack 7.7mm battle rifle fitted with a telescopic sight, the rifle, despite being only marginally different from its closer-range cohorts, was a formidable implement upon the battle fields of the Pacific theatre.

Internally, it is nearly identical to the cult classic H&K P7.  Its fixed barrel design makes it potentially more accurate than many other pistols, though this may be difficult to realize with its average trigger and short sight radius.

useall_png_only.name: Walther training pistol
useall_png_only.description: A dainty training pistol offered by the Walther Arms company, making use of the .22 LR cartridge, for training on a pistol very similar to more powerful pistols.

Developed due to the high production costs of its predecessor, the Luger P08, the P38 is also chambered in 9mm Parabellum.  This early DA/SA locked-breech design would introduce features later seen on more modern firearms such as the Beretta 92 series, and served Germany until 2004.

useall_png_only.name: Walther PPK pistol
useall_png_only.description: One of the most famous handguns of the 20th century.  Your name is not Bond, but you might find this little gun still useful.

useall_png_only.name: wasp stinger
