Masterfully crafted with tempered steel, this set features a prominent circular plate on the front that has been polished to a mirror-like sheen, flanked with supporting plates intricately joined to fit the body, all meticulously decorated.  Will protect you from serious harm, as well as the evil gazes of the undead.

useall_png_only.name: tempered splint vambraces (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of vambraces made of tough fabric sandwiched between alternating strips of steel.  Can be comfortably worn over chainmail for extra protection.

useall_png_only.name: handmade harness
useall_png_only.description: A custom-built light harness covered with pouches and including an integral tactical sling for a small rifle or other such weapon.  Durable and carefully crafted to be comfortable to wear.  Activate to holster/draw your weapon.

useall_png_only.name: tac vest
useall_png_only.description: This light vest is meant to carry your magazines, shells and pistols.  They are popular among law enforcement, but less so than combination tactical vests incorporating Kevlar.

useall_png_only.name: leather vambraces (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of light leather arm guards, made for archery.

useall_png_only.name: diving socks (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of 3 mm split-toe neoprene diving socks with thin rubber soles.

useall_png_only.name: thick diving boots (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of 5 mm thick neoprene diving boots with thick soles.

useall_png_only.name: diving gloves (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of flexible neoprene-silicone rubber gloves, suitable for underwater use.

useall_png_only.name: thick diving gloves (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of thick neoprene-silicone rubber gloves, suitable for underwater use.

useall_png_only.name: wetsuit hood
useall_png_only.description: A 3 mm neoprene hood, commonly worn by divers.

useall_png_only.name: thick wetsuit hood
useall_png_only.description: A 5 mm thick neoprene hood, commonly worn by divers in cold weather.

useall_png_only.name: wetsuit jacket
useall_png_only.description: A long-sleeved neoprene jacket.  Keeps you warm and protected from the elements.

useall_png_only.name: wetsuit pants
useall_png_only.description: A pair of light and stretchy neoprene pants.  Good for surfing and other water sports.

useall_png_only.name: thin wetsuit pants
useall_png_only.description: A pair of light and stretchy thin neoprene pants.  Good for surfing and other water sports.

useall_png_only.name: wetsuit shorts
useall_png_only.description: A pair of light and stretchy neoprene shorts.  Good for use on the beach.

useall_png_only.name: wetsuit technical shorts
useall_png_only.description: A pair of stretchy neoprene shorts with large pockets.  Can be worn alone or adjusted to be worn over a wetsuit.

useall_png_only.name: wetsuit technical shorts (loose)
useall_png_only.description: A pair of stretchy neoprene shorts with large pockets.  Can be worn alone or adjusted to be worn over a wetsuit.

useall_png_only.name: spring suit
useall_png_only.description: A long-sleeved spring wetsuit with pink color details and cleavage-enhancing, hip-accentuating construction.  Not as protective as a full-body suit, but also less restrictive.

useall_png_only.name: sleeveless spring suit
useall_png_only.description: A sleeveless spring wetsuit with an ocean blue color and cleavage-enhancing, hip-accentuating construction.  Not as protective as a full-body suit, but also less restrictive.

useall_png_only.name: thick wetsuit
useall_png_only.description: A full-body 5 mm thick neoprene wetsuit with nylon lining.

useall_png_only.name: wetsuit shirt
useall_png_only.description: A short-sleeved neoprene shirt.  Good for use on the beach.

useall_png_only.name: wetsuit long-sleeved shirt
useall_png_only.description: A long-sleeved neoprene shirt.  Good for surfing and other water sports.

useall_png_only.name: thin wetsuit long-sleeved shirt
useall_png_only.description: A thin long-sleeved neoprene shirt.  Good for surfing and other water sports.

useall_png_only.name: handmade winter suit
useall_png_only.description: A stuffy coverall jumpsuit consisting of durably woven cotton lined with fur and a canvas outer layer.  Waterproof, and sturdier than pre-Cataclysm winter clothing, with numerous storage pockets.  However, it is noticeably encumbering and wearing it outside of cold weather is pretty much out of the question.

useall_png_only.name: handmade faux fur winter suit
useall_png_only.description: A stuffy coverall jumpsuit consisting of durably woven cotton lined with faux fur and a canvas outer layer.  Waterproof, and sturdier than pre-Cataclysm winter clothing, with numerous storage pockets.  However, it is noticeably encumbering and wearing it outside of cold weather is pretty much out of the question.

useall_png_only.name: boxer briefs
useall_png_only.description: The age-old question, boxers or briefs?  Your answer?  Yes.

useall_png_only.name: boxer shorts
useall_png_only.description: Men's boxer shorts.  More fashionable than briefs and just as comfortable.

useall_png_only.name: boy shorts
useall_png_only.description: Female underwear similar to men's boxer shorts, but much more close-fitting.

useall_png_only.name: heavy survivor suit
useall_png_only.description: A heavy, hand-built combination armor made from a reinforced bulletproof vest and a metal-plated leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.

useall_png_only.name: flame-resistant socks (pair)
useall_png_only.description: A snug-fitting pair of stockings made from thin and lightweight Nomex fabric.

useall_png_only.name: socks (pair)
useall_png_only.description: Socks.  Put 'em on your feet.

useall_png_only.name: wool socks (pair)
useall_png_only.description: Warm socks made of wool.

useall_png_only.name: sports bra
useall_png_only.description: A sturdy nylon bra to provide additional support during physical movement.  Typically worn when exercising, it clings to the skin and is easy to wear.

useall_png_only.name: handmade combat suit
useall_png_only.description: A form-fitting coverall jumpsuit consisting of stab-weave Kevlar and ripstop Nylon woven in layers to provide substantial protection from bites and cuts.  Has reinforced pockets sewn on for storage.  Lacking a rubber sealant, it is still reasonably breathable, and therefore offers only modest protection against chemical attacks despite its synthetic fabric construction.

useall_png_only.name: yellow carpet
useall_png_only.description: A roll of yellow carpet.

useall_png_only.name: growing wild koji mold (obsolete)
useall_png_only.description: Some cooked rice sprinkled with ash and wrapped into a corn husk.  If left alone for a while, it will most likely grow koji mold.

useall_png_only.name: growing wild koji mold
useall_png_only.description: Some cooked rice sprinkled with ash and wrapped into a corn husk.  If left alone for a while, it will most likely grow koji mold.

useall_png_only.name: grown wild koji mold
useall_png_only.description: Some cooked rice sprinkled with ash and wrapped into a corn husk.  It has grown patches of koji mold inside; disassemble this item to extract it.

useall_png_only.name: handful of young leaves
useall_png_only.description: Some young leaves from miscellaneous plants.  They're tender enough to eat, but not very tasty on their own.

useall_png_only.name: deterrent laser weapon
useall_png_only.description: a very small laser weapon.

useall_png_only.name: deterrent laser weapon
useall_png_only.description: The V29 laser pistol was one of the first handheld laser weapons.  It is larger than most traditional handguns, but has no recoil whatsoever.

useall_png_only.name: ferro-hydraulic cannon
useall_png_only.description: The V29 laser pistol was one of the first handheld laser weapons.  It is larger than most traditional handguns, but has no recoil whatsoever.

useall_png_only.name: zinc
useall_png_only.description: A slightly brittle metal.  Apart from being an essential mineral that the body needs, it reacts readily with acids, alkalis, and other non-metals.  It can be crushed to make zinc powder and used in the production of batteries, among other things.

useall_png_only.name: long plastic zipper
useall_png_only.description: A long zipper made from plastic, usually found on clothing.

useall_png_only.name: short plastic zipper
useall_png_only.description: A short zipper made from plastic, usually found on footwear or clothing pockets.

useall_png_only.name: zubon
useall_png_only.description: Plain white zubon for use in martial arts.

useall_png_only.name: super soldier ant
useall_png_only.description: A cow-sized, hairy red ant.  Bulging pincers extend from her jaws.  Given the relative strength of ants to their body size, you don't doubt that this one could shove cars around or rip through solid walls.

useall_png_only.name: giant antlion larva
useall_png_only.description: This huge grub has powerful mandibles and a hungry look.  It hides in the dirt and awaits its prey.

useall_png_only.name: pulsating chunk of unknown material
useall_png_only.description: This formless, pitch-black mass wriggles and pulses on the ground as it reshapes itself before your eyes.  It slowly drags itself towards you with many tendrils of varied sizes.  As it gets closer to you, its pulsing intensifies as if it reacted to you.

useall_png_only.name: resonating chunk of unknown material
useall_png_only.description: This formless, pitch-black mass wriggles violently and noisily on the ground as it reshapes itself before your eyes.  It slowly drags itself towards you with many tendrils of varied sizes sparkling with electricity.  As it gets closer to you, its wriggling intensifies and its sparks grow brighter as if it reacted to you.

useall_png_only.name: chunk of unknown material
useall_png_only.description: This formless, pitch-black mass wriggles on the ground as it reshapes itself before your eyes.  It slowly drags itself towards you with many tendrils of varied sizes.  As it gets closer to you, its wriggling intensifies as if it reacted to you.

useall_png_only.name: scarred zombie
useall_png_only.description: A deformed human body, its skin transformed into one thick, calloused envelope of scar tissue.

useall_png_only.name: blood sacrifice
useall_png_only.description: A defiled human body, once living.  Tortured to death long ago, it remains chained to the altar, the putrescent flays of its peeled skin quivering like so much flotsam upon a murky pond.

useall_png_only.name: breather
useall_png_only.description: This is some sort of unearthly pink flesh sac; moist and ridged with veins, it is otherwise without discernible exterior features.  Seemingly immobile and defenseless, it sits in place, swelling and collapsing upon itself as it breathes.

useall_png_only.name: breather
useall_png_only.description: A weird mass of immobile, breathing pink goo.  The other breathers seem to originate from this one.

useall_png_only.name: armored centipede
useall_png_only.description: A huge mutated centipede covered in interlocking chitinous plates of metallic gray, reminding you more of a runaway train car than any living animal.  Its mandibles end in jagged points, seemingly specialized to hunt prey at least as well-armored as itself.  You really don't want to try if you'd fare better.

useall_png_only.name: creeper hub
useall_png_only.description: A thick stalk, rooted to the ground.  It rapidly sprouts thorny vines in all directions.

useall_png_only.name: creeper vine
useall_png_only.description: A thorny vine, twisting wildly as it grows with incredible speed.

useall_png_only.name: ancient red dragon
useall_png_only.description: A towering, hulking dragon, with tremendous, curving horns and shining red scales, its glowing maw peeled back in a hateful grimace as its eyes bore into yours.

useall_png_only.name: giant dragonfly naiad
useall_png_only.description: A predatory, aquatic dragonfly larva, normally barely a centimeter long and feeding on small fish, grown to the size of a catfish.  Underneath its sharp mandibles you can see that its folded lower jaw has changed into something resembling a barbed spear.

useall_png_only.name: photonic eigenspectre
useall_png_only.description: The endless details of this figure are mercifully obscured by the viscous light coursing 'through' it.  It cannot contain anything, but the smears of light follow the shapes of stomach and intestines, and are splattered across what must be the lips and chin.

useall_png_only.name: shifting eigenspectre
useall_png_only.description: This distorted figure is a kaleidoscope of borders.  Every part of a human, flattened into place, warps wildly from second to second.  The word your mind conjures to describe it is 'rotating', though you're not sure why.

useall_png_only.name: shifting eigenspectre
useall_png_only.description: This distorted figure is a kaleidoscope of borders.  Every part of a human, flattened into place, warps wildly from second to second.  The word your mind conjures to describe it is 'rotating', though you're not sure why.

useall_png_only.name: titanic eigenspectre
useall_png_only.description: There is somehow more of this figure than the others.  Every side of every surface is on display, but each of those seems like the thin edge of a larger shape.  There is an eternity here, where a scientist used to be.

useall_png_only.name: crayfish
useall_png_only.description: This crustacean looks like a tiny lobster, but is actually a completely different species.  If you could get ahold of a bunch more of these, a hefty pot of boiling water, and some spicy seasonings…

useall_png_only.name: American eel
useall_png_only.description: An American eel.  They used to be quite common in these parts until the dams were built.  They'll get a second chance now that those aren't running.

useall_png_only.name: lobster
useall_png_only.description: A dark greenish crustacean in its natural habitat.  These were once considered pests barely worth eating, then some marketing genius started selling them to people as a delicacy and they took off in popularity… and price.

useall_png_only.name: frog mother
useall_png_only.description: A large, bulbous creature with an extremely large mouth and small, stubby legs with no feet.  Drenched in an oily greenish-black substance, its flesh seems to rapidly decompose and reconstitute itself, and it is covered in large, white pustules that seem ready to pop.

useall_png_only.name: fungal wall
useall_png_only.description: A veritable wall of fungus, grown as a natural defense by the fungal spire.  New spores erupt from the surface every few seconds, and tendrils constrict around it, pulling new mass into its shape.  They move with an inexorable strength that could snap limbs.

useall_png_only.name: generator
useall_png_only.description: Your precious generator, noisily humming away.  Defend it at all costs!

useall_png_only.name: giant appendage
useall_png_only.description: A gigantic, probing appendage blindly feeling the area around it.  All of your senses scream at you that it's the size of a truck, and yet it only takes up about as much space in the world as you do.  It seems to be jutting through a portal, suggesting that it's merely a smaller extension of something much larger.

useall_png_only.name: graboid
useall_png_only.description: This huge subterranean creature is a far cry from its earthworm ancestors.  Despite only seeing its head, you can tell its grown to a mind-boggling size.  While the image may be quite unsettling, it doesn't appear to pay you any mind.

useall_png_only.name: gracken
useall_png_only.description: This is some form of eldritch monstrosity; an uncouth black being with smooth, oily skin and unpleasant horns that curve inward toward each other.  Tall and thin, the shadows cling unnaturally to its vaguely defined humanoid form as it shuffles along, its hands twitching and spasming so rapidly as to appear a little more than a black blur of claws.  Despite the night-terror esque appearance, it doesn't appear aggressive.

useall_png_only.name: inflatable dragon
useall_png_only.description: A giant inflatable dragon for Halloween decorations.

useall_png_only.name: impossible shape
useall_png_only.description: A twisted shape floating in midair; its angles don't seem to quite add up - it hurts to look at.  Is it inanimate?  Alive?  Something else?  You can't make heads or tails of it at all, but you can see through it - not as if it were transparent, but as if it isn't quite fully here.

useall_png_only.name: leech blossom
useall_png_only.description: A resplendent alien fern, crowned with flowers colored deep indigo.  It appears to be the centerpiece of this otherworldly bloom.

useall_png_only.name: leech pod cluster
useall_png_only.description: The translucent egg pods of an alien plant, firmly attached by luminous rhizomes.  You can barely distinguish a root drone floating within a cloudy substance.

useall_png_only.name: signal tree
useall_png_only.description: A trunk reaches tall into the sky, its topmost branches glowing with yellow light.  A low drum periodically shakes its vicinities.

useall_png_only.name: root drone
useall_png_only.description: A small bulb with a beak-like protuberance, skittishly roaming about under three tendril rhizomes.  Dripping and glistening, it resembles a newborn animal rather than a sapling grown from seeds.

useall_png_only.name: root runner
useall_png_only.description: This clump of woody vegetation hastily clambers around in a lizard-like fashion.  Three translucent scale-leaves stand tall on the backside of the creature, and the thin ridges within them periodically glow through some unknown means.  It's seemingly a symbiote of the nearby alien ferns, and looks ready to defend them with its life.

useall_png_only.name: leech stalk
useall_png_only.description: A resplendent and voluminous alien fern.  A faint buzzing sound emanates from it, and the shadow cast by its canopy continuously glows with electric charge.

useall_png_only.name: unfolded impossibility
useall_png_only.description: This is the entirety of the infinite chamber you are in, which perfectly contains itself.  If you look very closely, you might see yourself looking back.  You are sure that at any other time, seeing this would crack your brain like an eggshell.  But you understand it just fine right now.  And you can see it breathing.

useall_png_only.name: great mantis
useall_png_only.description: This ferocious cow-sized mantis stalks the fields of New England.  It's probably capable of killing a moose with its powerful arms.

useall_png_only.name: gigantic meat cocoon
useall_png_only.description: A rigid, off-white lump of flesh the size of a small car constricted by bands of rope-sized pulsing black veins that tie it to the floor below.  The whole thing is shuddering constantly, and gives off an otherworldly stench.

useall_png_only.name: large meat cocoon
useall_png_only.description: A mass of pink flesh the size of a fridge squirming constantly, black veins anchoring it to the ground.  Occasionally a malformed limb pushes against the skin from the inside, before a churn of the cocoon pushes it back.  Not ready yet, it seems.

useall_png_only.name: small meat cocoon
useall_png_only.description: A sack of pink flesh sitting in the middle of a net of black roots.  At irregular intervals it shudders as something (or multiple somethings?) inside changes position.  You're not sure you want to know what's inside.

useall_png_only.name: tiny meat cocoon
useall_png_only.description: A small, wet sack of pink skin, with something dog-sized moving around underneath the surface.  Black roots anchor it to the ground.

useall_png_only.name: memory
useall_png_only.description: The silhouette of a human body, reaching towards you like it needs help.  It has no eyes, but you can still feel it staring through you.

useall_png_only.name: ungulate mutant
useall_png_only.description: A gigantic mutated test subject, still wearing the tattered remains of an orange jumpsuit.  They walk on four warped legs ending in hooves, and their head is dominated by a glistening, tangled crown of antlers that scratch the ceiling.

useall_png_only.name: arthropod mutant
useall_png_only.description: A horribly mutated experimental subject.  Their original body - still wearing an orange jumpsuit - flops around lifelessly, carried by twelve segmented legs covered in hairy chitin erupting from their back.  At the base of the front pair of legs, an almost-human scalp gives way to a dozen irregularly-sized eyes and a set of mandibles, and from their hind end a stinger not unlike a scorpion's emerges.

useall_png_only.name: giant carp
useall_png_only.description: This thing looks like a carp, but huge and very, very angry.  Death is the gift of the carp god.

useall_png_only.name: bestial mutant
useall_png_only.description: A towering mutated test subject, covered in thick fur and the torn bottom part of a jumpsuit.  Their legs end in large padded feet not unlike a dog's, but they still manage to stand upright, freeing up their clawed hands to tear you apart.

useall_png_only.name: shelled mutant
useall_png_only.description: An enormous mutant hidden beneath a gray segmented shell, crawling on a carpet of innumerable tentacles covered with suckers.  They hold three thicker, branching limbs high on their front end, each dotted with dozens of unblinking eyeballs.

useall_png_only.name: giant salmon
useall_png_only.description: A mutated salmon roughly the size of a person.  Quite dangerous to the inexperienced angler.

useall_png_only.name: prototype robot
useall_png_only.description: This robot's single, glowing eye surveys the landscape periodically as it performs the endless slaughter dictated by a misinterpreted and cruel routine.  Between half-built plates, you can see the machinery and cables that animate it, and yet it moves deftly as it switches between one target and the next.

useall_png_only.name: M16A4 autonomous TALON UGV
useall_png_only.description: A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with an M16A4.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.

useall_png_only.name: autonomous TALON UGV Liberty Edition
useall_png_only.description: A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with a fireworks cannon in place of its usual M16A4.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.  This one has been plastered with an American flag decal.

useall_png_only.name: shadow
useall_png_only.description: An animate shadow.  Looking like nothing more than an errant patch of normal shadow, it draws your attention by the way it moves subtly and whispers softly in the back of your mind.  Strange intrusive thoughts accompany the quiet murmur, trying to forcefully supplant your own.

useall_png_only.name: shifting mass
useall_png_only.description: An animate blotch of conflicting symmetries, erratically hovering through the air.  It's not even real enough to hold a stable shape, and its entire form is constantly in flux.  You can see through it - not as if it were transparent, but as if it isn't quite fully here.

useall_png_only.name: fungal juggernaut
useall_png_only.description: Fungi bloom from the crevices in the ossified plates of this ponderous bone titan, and it seems even its eyes are lost to it.  A dust of spores lands on the ground with every sluggish stomp of its heavy legs.

useall_png_only.name: zaptor
useall_png_only.description: This small, winged predator darts through the air on three thinly-haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  A jagged spike with a pulsing electrical glow juts out from the point where the wings meet.

useall_png_only.name: shadow raptor
useall_png_only.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature.  You can make out the outline of three flapping wings connected to a jagged, pointed object.

useall_png_only.name: unstable flesh-raptor
useall_png_only.description: This small, winged predator darts through the air on three thinly-haired wings that look like stretched human hands.  A jagged spike juts out from the point where the wings meet, and a bloated, fleshy belly hangs beneath.  A sharp smell of rotten eggs hangs around it.

useall_png_only.name: titan stag beetle
useall_png_only.description: This stag beetle rivals an armored personnel carrier in size, bearing horns that could fell a tree and chitin thick enough to ignore most bullets.  Its bulky shell looks nigh-impenetrable, and the cracks have sealed with a foul paste.

useall_png_only.name: tadpole constrictor
useall_png_only.description: The only resemblance this creature bears to a tadpole is its slick black-green skin and slender body.  Its three appendages, resembling long tentacles or pseudopods, propel it across the ground at maddening speed.  It has no outward sensory organs or a mouth, and steam rises from its skin as if it is burning away its own lifeforce to catch you.

useall_png_only.name: M202A1 autonomous TALON UGV
useall_png_only.description: A TALON unmanned ground vehicle equipped with an M202A1 FLASH.  It is a small tracked UGV with an array of motors and sensors covering its weapon mount.

useall_png_only.name: vortex
useall_png_only.description: A twisting spot in the air, with some kind of morphing mass at its center.

useall_png_only.name: swirling vortex
useall_png_only.description: A shimmering sphere floating just above the ground, it seems to "breathe", faint ripples of dust being pulled in and pushed back out.

useall_png_only.name: armored zombie
useall_png_only.description: Despite being encased in a what was once a nigh-impenetrable combat exoskeleton, something still managed to kill this soldier.

useall_png_only.name: trapped tendril
useall_png_only.description: A great tendril of mutated flesh and sharpened bone.  Emerging from a crevice in the ruined floor, hundreds of human limbs seek freedom and writhe incessantly from underneath its grotesque carapace.  As enormous as it may be, you feel certain that this is just part of a much bigger creature, for when it moves, you can feel this whole ruin tremble, as though an unseen giant is struggling against the weight of its concrete tomb.

useall_png_only.name: gangrenous crawler
useall_png_only.description: A nightmarish, spidery abomination born from human gore.  It deftly crawls between the walls and ceiling with limbs grown from its own disjointed ribs.

useall_png_only.name: gangrenous flesh
useall_png_only.description: Covered in grievous wounds, this wretch's gray skin has bloated to near-rupture with putrid gas.  Between lumps of unrecognizable gore, a human head lamely follows your movements with empty, black eyes.

useall_png_only.name: gangrenous impaler
useall_png_only.description: A corpse hideously twisted into an insect-like form.  A hollow tendril reaches out from its open thorax.

useall_png_only.name: spasming lump
useall_png_only.description: A great pile of merged bodies and mutated flesh.  It spasms in an arrhythmic and desperate manner.

useall_png_only.name: hanging innards
useall_png_only.description: Great snakes of flesh hang from the ceiling above, madly thrashing and reaching about.

useall_png_only.name: flesh wall
useall_png_only.description: A great lump of mutated flesh.  It resembles the innards of some gigantic creature, and is covered in a grid of diminutive veins.

useall_png_only.name: zombie necro-boomer
useall_png_only.description: At first this creature looks like nothing more than a grotesque and oleaginous husk, bloated and punctured by jet-black pustules.  When approached, its glowing red eyes and an aching grin take form; its skin tears and its guts teem with unmatched fecundity, as its gaze inspires fear of nothing less than cosmic, inhuman ecstasy.

useall_png_only.name: scissorlimbs
useall_png_only.description: A nightmarish spider of gore standing tall among the ruins, keeping silent watch of the blighted landscape.  Its spindly limbs of bone slip between the rubble with otherworldly speed.

useall_png_only.name: shady zombie
useall_png_only.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature, as if light itself were too repulsed to touch it.  All you can make out is its shambling, human-shaped outline.

useall_png_only.name: shadowcat
useall_png_only.description: An uncanny shadow envelops this creature, as if light itself were too repulsed to touch it.  All you can make out is the outline of a large, shambling cat.

useall_png_only.name: debug monster
useall_png_only.description: This monster exists only for testing purposes.

useall_png_only.name: broken card reader
useall_png_only.description: A smartcard reader that doesn't seem to be functioning.  Probably because there's no more blinking red LED.

useall_png_only.name: distorted image
useall_png_only.description: The landscape looks warped and distorted here, as if had been unnaturally stretched above a thin membrane.

useall_png_only.name: double glazed window
